```{r setup, include=FALSE}
latex_safe_table <- function(table_data) {
  if (!is.data.frame(table_data)) {
    return(table_data)
  }

  table_data %>%
    mutate(
      across(
        where(is.character),
        ~ str_replace_all(.x, fixed("<br>"), "; ")
      )
    )
}

display_rename_text <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x)) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  x <- as.character(x)
  is_missing <- is.na(x)
  x[is_missing] <- ""

  replacements <- c(
    "\\texttt{average\\_B2}" = "precision equivalent",
    "renormalised-average-B2" = "renormalised precision equivalent",
    "Renormalised-average-B2" = "Renormalised precision equivalent",
    "renormalised log average B2" = "renormalised log precision equivalent",
    "Renormalised log average B2" = "Renormalised log precision equivalent",
    "renormalised average B2" = "renormalised precision equivalent",
    "Renormalised average B2" = "Renormalised precision equivalent",
    "average\\_B2" = "precision equivalent",
    "average_B2" = "precision equivalent",
    "average.B2" = "precision equivalent",
    "Average B2" = "Precision equivalent",
    "average B2" = "precision equivalent",
    "B2 perception equivalents" = "precision equivalents",
    "B2 perception equivalent" = "precision equivalent",
    "B2 perception-equivalents" = "precision equivalents",
    "B2 perception-equivalent" = "precision equivalent",
    "B2 perceptions" = "precision equivalents",
    "B2 perception" = "precision equivalent",
    "Perception equivalents" = "Precision equivalents",
    "Perception equivalent" = "Precision equivalent",
    "Perception-equivalents" = "Precision equivalents",
    "Perception-equivalent" = "Precision equivalent",
    "perception equivalents" = "precision equivalents",
    "perception equivalent" = "precision equivalent",
    "perception-equivalents" = "precision equivalents",
    "perception-equivalent" = "precision equivalent",
    "B2 values" = "precision equivalents",
    "B2 value" = "precision equivalent",
    "NoInfo" = "Silent",
    "Noinfo" = "Silent",
    "PartInfo" = "Interval",
    "Partinfo" = "Interval",
    "No / Part" = "Silent / Interval",
    "No/Part" = "Silent / Interval",
    "No information" = "Silent",
    "no information" = "silent",
    "No info" = "Silent",
    "no info" = "silent",
    "Partial information" = "Interval",
    "partial information" = "interval",
    "Part info" = "Interval",
    "part info" = "interval"
  )

  for (pattern in names(replacements)) {
    x <- str_replace_all(x, fixed(pattern), replacements[[pattern]])
  }

  x[is_missing] <- NA_character_
  x
}

uses_information_gap_label <- function(table_id) {
  str_detect(
    table_id,
    regex(
      paste(
        "marginal",
        "renormalised_average_b2_condition_model_coefficients",
        "average_b2_renormalised(_log_social)?_wooldridge_model_fit",
        "^b2_(aggregate_halo|first_task|order_effect)",
        "^individual_b2_.*halo",
        sep = "|"
      ),
      ignore_case = TRUE
    )
  )
}

display_rename_information_gap_text <- function(x) {
  x <- display_rename_text(x)
  if (is.null(x)) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  replacements <- c(
    "Environmental and Social treatments" =
      "Environmental and Social information gaps",
    "Environmental treatment" = "Environmental information gap",
    "Social treatment" = "Social information gap",
    "within each treatment" = "within each information gap",
    "within the same treatment" = "within the same information gap",
    "within treatment" = "within information gap",
    "for each treatment" = "for each information gap",
    "For each treatment" = "For each information gap",
    "by treatment" = "by information gap",
    "split by treatment" = "split by information gap",
    "conditional on treatment" = "conditional on information gap",
    "which treatment" = "which information gap",
    "Which treatment" = "Which information gap",
    "on treatment, information condition" =
      "on information gap, information condition",
    "treatment, information condition" =
      "information gap, information condition",
    "treatment and information condition" =
      "information gap and information condition",
    "Treatment x information-condition" =
      "Information Gap x information-condition"
  )

  for (pattern in names(replacements)) {
    x <- str_replace_all(x, fixed(pattern), replacements[[pattern]])
  }

  x
}

display_rename_caption <- function(x, rename_treatment = FALSE) {
  if (rename_treatment) {
    display_rename_information_gap_text(x)
  } else {
    display_rename_text(x)
  }
}

display_rename_table <- function(table_data, rename_treatment = FALSE) {
  if (!is.data.frame(table_data)) {
    return(table_data)
  }

  text_renamer <- if (rename_treatment) {
    display_rename_information_gap_text
  } else {
    display_rename_text
  }

  table_data <- table_data %>%
    mutate(
      across(
        where(~ is.character(.x) || is.factor(.x)),
        ~ text_renamer(as.character(.x))
      )
    )

  names(table_data) <- text_renamer(names(table_data))

  if (rename_treatment) {
    names(table_data) <- recode(
      names(table_data),
      Treatment = "Information Gap",
      Imprecise = "Information Gap",
      `Imprecise characteristic` = "Information Gap",
      .default = names(table_data)
    )
  }

  table_data
}

blank_stars_column_title <- function(table_data) {
  names(table_data)[names(table_data) == "Stars"] <- " "
  table_data
}

latex_math_postprocess <- function(latex_table) {
  replacements <- c(
    "ME\\_S > ME\\_E" = "$\\mathrm{ME}_S > \\mathrm{ME}_E$",
    "ME\\_E > 0" = "$\\mathrm{ME}_E > 0$",
    "ME\\_S > 0" = "$\\mathrm{ME}_S > 0$",
    "theta\\_S > theta\\_E" = "$\\theta_S > \\theta_E$",
    "theta\\_E > 0.5" = "$\\theta_E > 0.5$",
    "theta\\_S > 0.5" = "$\\theta_S > 0.5$",
    "theta\\_E != 0.5" = "$\\theta_E \\neq 0.5$",
    "theta\\_S != 0.5" = "$\\theta_S \\neq 0.5$",
    "theta\\_S != theta\\_E" = "$\\theta_S \\neq \\theta_E$",
    "WTP-min > 0" = "WTP-min $>$ 0",
    "WTP min > 0" = "WTP min $>$ 0",
    "WTP min < 0" = "WTP min $<$ 0",
    "min > 0" = "min $>$ 0",
    "min < 0" = "min $<$ 0",
    "<0.001" = "$<0.001$"
  )

  for (pattern in names(replacements)) {
    latex_table <- str_replace_all(
      latex_table,
      fixed(pattern),
      replacements[[pattern]]
    )
  }

  latex_table
}

apply_latex_column_widths <- function(latex_table, column_widths) {
  if (is.null(column_widths)) {
    return(latex_table)
  }

  column_spec <- paste0("p{", column_widths, "}", collapse = "")
  tabular_match <- str_match(
    latex_table,
    "\\\\begin\\{(tabular|longtable)\\}(\\[[^]]+\\])?\\{[^\\n]+\\}"
  )

  if (is.na(tabular_match[1, 1])) {
    return(latex_table)
  }

  table_environment <- tabular_match[1, 2]
  table_options <- if (is.na(tabular_match[1, 3])) "" else tabular_match[1, 3]
  replacement <- paste0(
    "\\begin{",
    table_environment,
    "}",
    table_options,
    "{",
    column_spec,
    "}"
  )

  str_replace(
    latex_table,
    fixed(tabular_match[1, 1]),
    replacement
  )
}

apply_latex_table_options <- function(latex_table,
                                      latex_font_size = NULL,
                                      latex_tabcolsep = NULL) {
  table_options <- c(
    if (!is.null(latex_font_size)) latex_font_size,
    if (!is.null(latex_tabcolsep)) {
      paste0("\\setlength{\\tabcolsep}{", latex_tabcolsep, "}")
    }
  )

  if (length(table_options) == 0) {
    return(latex_table)
  }

  if (str_detect(latex_table, fixed("\\begin{longtable}"))) {
    option_block <- paste(table_options, collapse = "\n")

    return(
      latex_table %>%
        str_replace(
          fixed("\\begin{longtable}"),
          paste0("{\n", option_block, "\n\\begin{longtable}")
        ) %>%
        str_replace(
          fixed("\\end{longtable}"),
          "\\end{longtable}\n}"
        )
    )
  }

  str_replace(
    latex_table,
    fixed("\\centering"),
    paste(c("\\centering", table_options), collapse = "\n")
  )
}

apply_latex_landscape <- function(latex_table, latex_landscape = FALSE) {
  if (!latex_landscape) {
    return(latex_table)
  }

  paste0(
    "\\begin{landscape}\n",
    latex_table,
    "\n\\end{landscape}"
  )
}

apply_latex_float_environment <- function(latex_table,
                                          latex_float_environment = "table",
                                          latex_float_width = NULL) {
  if (latex_float_environment == "table") {
    return(latex_table)
  }

  if (is.null(latex_float_width) || !nzchar(latex_float_width)) {
    latex_float_width <- "\\textwidth"
  }

  if (!str_detect(latex_table, fixed("\\begin{table}"))) {
    stop(
      "A subtable export requires a non-longtable LaTeX table environment.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  latex_table %>%
    str_replace(
      fixed("\\begin{table}[!tb]"),
      paste0("\\begin{subtable}{", latex_float_width, "}")
    ) %>%
    str_replace(
      fixed("\\begin{table}"),
      paste0("\\begin{subtable}{", latex_float_width, "}")
    ) %>%
    str_replace(
      fixed("\\end{table}"),
      "\\end{subtable}"
    )
}

export_table <- function(table_data,
                         table_id,
                         caption = NULL,
                         latex_caption = NULL,
                         digits = NULL,
                         escape = TRUE,
                         column_widths = NULL,
                         latex_font_size = NULL,
                         latex_tabcolsep = NULL,
                         latex_longtable = FALSE,
                         latex_landscape = FALSE,
                         latex_float_environment = c("table", "subtable"),
                         latex_float_width = NULL,
                         ...) {
  latex_float_environment <- match.arg(latex_float_environment)

  if (latex_float_environment == "subtable" && latex_longtable) {
    stop(
      "Subtable exports cannot also use `latex_longtable = TRUE`.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  tex_path <- file.path(overleaf_table_dir, paste0(table_id, ".tex"))
  latex_label <- str_replace_all(table_id, "_", "-")
  rename_treatment <- uses_information_gap_label(table_id)
  display_table_data <- display_rename_table(
    table_data,
    rename_treatment = rename_treatment
  )
  caption <- display_rename_caption(caption, rename_treatment = rename_treatment)
  latex_caption <- display_rename_caption(
    latex_caption,
    rename_treatment = rename_treatment
  )
  table_ncol <- if (is.data.frame(display_table_data)) ncol(display_table_data) else NULL

  if (!is.null(column_widths) && length(column_widths) != table_ncol) {
    stop(
      "`column_widths` must have one width for each table column.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  latex_table <- knitr::kable(
    latex_safe_table(display_table_data),
    format = "latex",
    booktabs = TRUE,
    digits = digits,
    caption = if (is.null(latex_caption)) caption else latex_caption,
    label = latex_label,
    longtable = latex_longtable,
    escape = escape,
    position = "!tb",
    ...
  )
  latex_table <- latex_table %>%
    as.character() %>%
    latex_math_postprocess() %>%
    apply_latex_column_widths(column_widths) %>%
    apply_latex_table_options(
      latex_font_size = latex_font_size,
      latex_tabcolsep = latex_tabcolsep
    ) %>%
    apply_latex_float_environment(
      latex_float_environment = latex_float_environment,
      latex_float_width = latex_float_width
    ) %>%
    apply_latex_landscape(latex_landscape)

  writeLines(latex_table, tex_path, useBytes = TRUE)

  knitr::kable(
    display_table_data,
    digits = digits,
    caption = caption,
    escape = escape,
    ...
  )
}

is_missing_value <- function(x) {
  x_chr <- trimws(as.character(x))
  is.na(x_chr) | tolower(x_chr) %in% missing_values
}

fmt_num <- function(x, digits = 3) {
  ifelse(is.na(x), "", formatC(x, format = "f", digits = digits))
}

fmt_p <- function(x) {
  case_when(
    is.na(x) ~ "",
    x < 0.001 ~ "<0.001",
    TRUE ~ formatC(x, format = "f", digits = 3)
  )
}

fmt_pct <- function(x, digits = 1) {
  ifelse(is.na(x), "", paste0(formatC(x, format = "f", digits = digits), "%"))
}

average_regression_star_label <- function(p_value) {
  case_when(
    is.na(p_value) ~ "",
    p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
    p_value < 0.01 ~ "**",
    p_value < 0.05 ~ "*",
    TRUE ~ ""
  )
}

signed_direction <- function(estimate) {
  case_when(
    is.na(estimate) ~ NA_character_,
    abs(estimate) < sqrt(.Machine$double.eps) ~ "Zero",
    estimate > 0 ~ "Positive",
    TRUE ~ "Negative"
  )
}

hc3_vcov <- function(model) {
  model_beta <- coef(model)
  estimable <- !is.na(model_beta)
  design_matrix <- model.matrix(model)[, estimable, drop = FALSE]
  bread <- solve(crossprod(design_matrix))
  hc3_score <- design_matrix *
    as.numeric(residuals(model) / (1 - hatvalues(model)))
  robust_vcov <- bread %*% crossprod(hc3_score) %*% bread
  dimnames(robust_vcov) <- list(
    names(model_beta[estimable]),
    names(model_beta[estimable])
  )
  robust_vcov
}

linear_contrast_summary <- function(model, contrast_vector) {
  model_beta <- coef(model)
  estimable <- !is.na(model_beta)
  model_beta <- model_beta[estimable]
  robust_vcov <- hc3_vcov(model)
  contrast_vector <- contrast_vector[names(model_beta)]
  contrast_vector[is.na(contrast_vector)] <- 0

  estimate <- drop(contrast_vector %*% model_beta)
  standard_error <- sqrt(drop(
    contrast_vector %*% robust_vcov %*% contrast_vector
  ))
  residual_df <- df.residual(model)
  t_statistic <- estimate / standard_error
  f_statistic <- t_statistic^2

  tibble(
    Estimate = estimate,
    `HC3 SE` = standard_error,
    `HC3 t statistic` = t_statistic,
    `HC3 F` = f_statistic,
    `Numerator df` = 1L,
    `Denominator df` = residual_df,
    `HC3 p value, positive` =
      pt(t_statistic, df = residual_df, lower.tail = FALSE),
    `HC3 p value, two-sided` =
      2 * pt(abs(t_statistic), df = residual_df, lower.tail = FALSE)
  )
}

model_contrast <- function(model, terms) {
  contrast_vector <- setNames(rep(0, length(coef(model))), names(coef(model)))
  matched_terms <- intersect(names(terms), names(contrast_vector))
  contrast_vector[matched_terms] <- terms[matched_terms]
  contrast_vector
}

robust_solve <- function(matrix_value, vector_value) {
  tryCatch(
    solve(matrix_value, vector_value),
    error = function(e) qr.solve(matrix_value, vector_value)
  )
}

three_way_terms <- function(model) {
  model_beta <- coef(model)
  term_names <- names(model_beta)[!is.na(model_beta)]

  term_names[
    str_detect(term_names, fixed("TreatmentSocial")) &
      str_detect(term_names, fixed("info_treatmentPartInfo")) &
      str_count(term_names, fixed(":")) >= 2
  ]
}

}

pairwise_level_comparisons <- function(covariate_levels) {
  if (length(covariate_levels) < 2) {
    return(tibble(
      `Reference value` = character(),
      `Contrast value` = character()
    ))
  }

  comparison_matrix <- combn(as.character(covariate_levels), 2)

  tibble(
    `Reference value` = comparison_matrix[1, ],
    `Contrast value` = comparison_matrix[2, ]
  )
}

wald_test_terms <- function(model, terms) {
  if (length(terms) == 0) {
    return(tibble(
      `HC3 F` = NA_real_,
      `Numerator df` = 0L,
      `Denominator df` = df.residual(model),
      `HC3 p value` = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  model_beta <- coef(model)
  estimable <- !is.na(model_beta)
  model_beta <- model_beta[estimable]
  robust_vcov <- hc3_vcov(model)
  terms <- intersect(terms, names(model_beta))
  term_beta <- model_beta[terms]
  term_vcov <- robust_vcov[terms, terms, drop = FALSE]
  term_df <- length(term_beta)
  wald_statistic <- drop(t(term_beta) %*% robust_solve(term_vcov, term_beta))
  f_statistic <- wald_statistic / term_df
  residual_df <- df.residual(model)

  tibble(
    `HC3 F` = f_statistic,
    `Numerator df` = term_df,
    `Denominator df` = residual_df,
    `HC3 p value` = pf(
      f_statistic,
      df1 = term_df,
      df2 = residual_df,
      lower.tail = FALSE
    )
  )
}

model_f_statistic <- function(model) {
  f_statistic <- summary(model)$fstatistic

  if (is.null(f_statistic)) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  unname(f_statistic[["value"]])
}

model_row <- function(model,
                      treatment_value,
                      information_value,
                      covariate_variable,
                      covariate_value,
                      covariate_levels) {
  newdata <- tibble(
    Treatment = factor(treatment_value, levels = treatment_levels),
    info_treatment = factor(information_value, levels = condition_levels)
  )
  newdata[[covariate_variable]] <- factor(
    covariate_value,
    levels = covariate_levels
  )

  model_beta <- coef(model)
  estimable <- !is.na(model_beta)
  model_matrix <- model.matrix(delete.response(terms(model)), data = newdata)
  model_row <- model_matrix[1, names(model_beta[estimable]), drop = TRUE]
  names(model_row) <- names(model_beta[estimable])
  model_row
}

estimate_information_effects <- function(model,
                                         covariate_variable,
                                         covariate_label,
                                         covariate_levels) {
  model_data <- as_tibble(model$model)

  map_dfr(covariate_levels, function(covariate_value) {
    model_cells <- model_data %>%
      filter(.data[[covariate_variable]] == covariate_value)

    env_no <- model_row(
      model,
      "Environmental",
      "NoInfo",
      covariate_variable,
      covariate_value,
      covariate_levels
    )
    env_part <- model_row(
      model,
      "Environmental",
      "PartInfo",
      covariate_variable,
      covariate_value,
      covariate_levels
    )
    social_no <- model_row(
      model,
      "Social",
      "NoInfo",
      covariate_variable,
      covariate_value,
      covariate_levels
    )
    social_part <- model_row(
      model,
      "Social",
      "PartInfo",
      covariate_variable,
      covariate_value,
      covariate_levels
    )

    environmental_effect <- env_part - env_no
    social_effect <- social_part - social_no
    difference_effect <- social_effect - environmental_effect

    environmental_summary <- linear_contrast_summary(
      model,
      environmental_effect
    )
    social_summary <- linear_contrast_summary(model, social_effect)
    difference_summary <- linear_contrast_summary(model, difference_effect)

    tibble(
      Covariate = covariate_label,
      Value = as.character(covariate_value),
      Participants = nobs(model),
      `Env NoInfo n` =
        sum(
          model_cells$Treatment == "Environmental" &
            model_cells$info_treatment == "NoInfo"
        ),
      `Env PartInfo n` =
        sum(
          model_cells$Treatment == "Environmental" &
            model_cells$info_treatment == "PartInfo"
        ),
      `Soc NoInfo n` =
        sum(
          model_cells$Treatment == "Social" &
            model_cells$info_treatment == "NoInfo"
        ),
      `Soc PartInfo n` =
        sum(
          model_cells$Treatment == "Social" &
            model_cells$info_treatment == "PartInfo"
        ),
      `ME Environmental` = environmental_summary$Estimate,
      `HC3 SE, Environmental ME` = environmental_summary$`HC3 SE`,
      `ME Social` = social_summary$Estimate,
      `HC3 SE, Social ME` = social_summary$`HC3 SE`,
      `Difference in MEs (Social - Environmental)` =
        difference_summary$Estimate,
      `HC3 SE, difference` = difference_summary$`HC3 SE`,
      `HC3 t statistic, difference` =
        difference_summary$`HC3 t statistic`,
      `HC3 F, difference` = difference_summary$`HC3 F`,
      `HC3 p value, difference positive` =
        difference_summary$`HC3 p value, positive`,
      `HC3 p value, difference two-sided` =
        difference_summary$`HC3 p value, two-sided`,
      `Sign of difference` =
        signed_direction(difference_summary$Estimate),
      `Larger signed ME` =
        larger_moderation_label(difference_summary$Estimate),
      Stars = average_regression_star_label(
        difference_summary$`HC3 p value, two-sided`
      )
    )
  })
}

estimate_wooldridge_three_way_contrasts <- function(model,
                                                    covariate_variable,
                                                    covariate_label,
                                                    covariate_levels) {
  comparisons <- pairwise_level_comparisons(covariate_levels)

  map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(comparisons)), function(comparison_index) {
    reference_value <- comparisons$`Reference value`[[comparison_index]]
    contrast_value <- comparisons$`Contrast value`[[comparison_index]]

    information_effect_row <- function(treatment_value, covariate_value) {
      part_row <- model_row(
        model,
        treatment_value,
        "PartInfo",
        covariate_variable,
        covariate_value,
        covariate_levels
      )
      no_row <- model_row(
        model,
        treatment_value,
        "NoInfo",
        covariate_variable,
        covariate_value,
        covariate_levels
      )

      part_row - no_row
    }

    environmental_reference <- information_effect_row(
      "Environmental",
      reference_value
    )
    environmental_contrast <- information_effect_row(
      "Environmental",
      contrast_value
    )
    social_reference <- information_effect_row("Social", reference_value)
    social_contrast <- information_effect_row("Social", contrast_value)
    three_way_contrast <- (social_contrast - social_reference) -
      (environmental_contrast - environmental_reference)
    contrast_summary <- linear_contrast_summary(model, three_way_contrast)
    contrast_estimate <- contrast_summary$Estimate

    tibble(
      Covariate = covariate_label,
      `Reference value` = as.character(reference_value),
      `Contrast value` = as.character(contrast_value),
      Contrast = paste(contrast_value, "vs", reference_value),
      Participants = nobs(model),
      `Difference estimate (Social - Environmental)` = contrast_estimate,
      `HC3 SE` = contrast_summary$`HC3 SE`,
      `HC3 t statistic` = contrast_summary$`HC3 t statistic`,
      `HC3 p value, positive` =
        contrast_summary$`HC3 p value, positive`,
      `HC3 p value, two-sided` =
        contrast_summary$`HC3 p value, two-sided`,
      `Sign of difference` = signed_direction(contrast_estimate),
      `Larger signed moderation` = larger_moderation_label(contrast_estimate),
      Stars = average_regression_star_label(
        contrast_summary$`HC3 p value, two-sided`
      )
    )
  })
}

estimate_cardinal_marginal_positive_tests <- function(model,
                                                      covariate_variable,
                                                      covariate_label,
                                                      covariate_levels) {
  model_data <- as_tibble(model$model)

  map_dfr(treatment_levels, function(treatment_value) {
    map_dfr(covariate_levels, function(covariate_value) {
      no_row <- model_row(
        model,
        treatment_value,
        "NoInfo",
        covariate_variable,
        covariate_value,
        covariate_levels
      )
      part_row <- model_row(
        model,
        treatment_value,
        "PartInfo",
        covariate_variable,
        covariate_value,
        covariate_levels
      )
      information_effect <- part_row - no_row
      effect_summary <- linear_contrast_summary(model, information_effect)
      model_cells <- model_data %>%
        filter(
          Treatment == treatment_value,
          .data[[covariate_variable]] == covariate_value
        )

      tibble(
        Treatment = treatment_value,
        Covariate = covariate_label,
        Value = as.character(covariate_value),
        `NoInfo n` = sum(model_cells$info_treatment == "NoInfo"),
        `PartInfo n` = sum(model_cells$info_treatment == "PartInfo"),
        `ME (PartInfo - NoInfo)` = effect_summary$Estimate,
        `HC3 SE` = effect_summary$`HC3 SE`,
        `HC3 t statistic` = effect_summary$`HC3 t statistic`,
        `Denominator df` = effect_summary$`Denominator df`,
        `HC3 p value, ME > 0` =
          effect_summary$`HC3 p value, positive`,
        `HC3 p value, two-sided` =
          effect_summary$`HC3 p value, two-sided`,
        `Sign of ME` = signed_direction(effect_summary$Estimate),
        Stars = average_regression_star_label(
          effect_summary$`HC3 p value, positive`
        )
      )
    })
  })
}

estimate_cardinal_within_treatment_me_tests <- function(model,
                                                        covariate_variable,
                                                        covariate_label,
                                                        covariate_levels) {
  comparisons <- pairwise_level_comparisons(covariate_levels)

  map_dfr(treatment_levels, function(treatment_value) {
    map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(comparisons)), function(comparison_index) {
      reference_value <- comparisons$`Reference value`[[comparison_index]]
      contrast_value <- comparisons$`Contrast value`[[comparison_index]]
      reference_no <- model_row(
        model,
        treatment_value,
        "NoInfo",
        covariate_variable,
        reference_value,
        covariate_levels
      )
      reference_part <- model_row(
        model,
        treatment_value,
        "PartInfo",
        covariate_variable,
        reference_value,
        covariate_levels
      )
      contrast_no <- model_row(
        model,
        treatment_value,
        "NoInfo",
        covariate_variable,
        contrast_value,
        covariate_levels
      )
      contrast_part <- model_row(
        model,
        treatment_value,
        "PartInfo",
        covariate_variable,
        contrast_value,
        covariate_levels
      )
      reference_effect <- reference_part - reference_no
      contrast_effect <- contrast_part - contrast_no
      reference_summary <- linear_contrast_summary(model, reference_effect)
      contrast_summary <- linear_contrast_summary(model, contrast_effect)
      difference_summary <- linear_contrast_summary(
        model,
        contrast_effect - reference_effect
      )
      difference_estimate <- difference_summary$Estimate

      tibble(
        Treatment = treatment_value,
        Covariate = covariate_label,
        `Reference value` = as.character(reference_value),
        `Contrast value` = as.character(contrast_value),
        `ME reference` = reference_summary$Estimate,
        `ME contrast` = contrast_summary$Estimate,
        `Difference in MEs (contrast - reference)` = difference_estimate,
        `HC3 SE, difference` = difference_summary$`HC3 SE`,
        `HC3 t statistic, difference` =
          difference_summary$`HC3 t statistic`,
        `HC3 F, difference` = difference_summary$`HC3 F`,
        `HC3 p value, contrast higher` =
          difference_summary$`HC3 p value, positive`,
        `HC3 p value, two-sided` =
          difference_summary$`HC3 p value, two-sided`,
        `Sign of difference` = signed_direction(difference_estimate),
        `Higher information effect` = case_when(
          is.na(difference_estimate) ~ NA_character_,
          abs(difference_estimate) < sqrt(.Machine$double.eps) ~
            "No signed difference",
          difference_estimate > 0 ~ as.character(contrast_value),
          TRUE ~ as.character(reference_value)
        ),
        Stars = average_regression_star_label(
          difference_summary$`HC3 p value, two-sided`
        )
      )
    })
  })
}

condition_gap_direction_label <- function(estimate) {
  case_when(
    is.na(estimate) ~ NA_character_,
    abs(estimate) < sqrt(.Machine$double.eps) ~ "No signed difference",
    estimate > 0 ~ "PartInfo gap > NoInfo gap",
    TRUE ~ "NoInfo gap > PartInfo gap"
  )
}

estimate_cardinal_condition_covariate_gap_tests <- function(model,
                                                            covariate_variable,
                                                            covariate_label,
                                                            covariate_levels) {
  comparisons <- pairwise_level_comparisons(covariate_levels)

  gap_vectors <- function(treatment_value, reference_value, contrast_value) {
    reference_no <- model_row(
      model,
      treatment_value,
      "NoInfo",
      covariate_variable,
      reference_value,
      covariate_levels
    )
    contrast_no <- model_row(
      model,
      treatment_value,
      "NoInfo",
      covariate_variable,
      contrast_value,
      covariate_levels
    )
    reference_part <- model_row(
      model,
      treatment_value,
      "PartInfo",
      covariate_variable,
      reference_value,
      covariate_levels
    )
    contrast_part <- model_row(
      model,
      treatment_value,
      "PartInfo",
      covariate_variable,
      contrast_value,
      covariate_levels
    )

    list(
      part_gap = contrast_part - reference_part,
      no_gap = contrast_no - reference_no,
      difference = (contrast_part - reference_part) -
        (contrast_no - reference_no)
    )
  }

  make_row <- function(treatment_value,
                       reference_value,
                       contrast_value,
                       part_gap,
                       no_gap,
                       difference) {
    part_summary <- linear_contrast_summary(model, part_gap)
    no_summary <- linear_contrast_summary(model, no_gap)
    difference_summary <- linear_contrast_summary(model, difference)
    difference_estimate <- difference_summary$Estimate

    tibble(
      Treatment = treatment_value,
      Covariate = covariate_label,
      `Reference value` = as.character(reference_value),
      `Contrast value` = as.character(contrast_value),
      `M(partinfo)` = part_summary$Estimate,
      `HC3 SE, M(partinfo)` = part_summary$`HC3 SE`,
      `M(noinfo)` = no_summary$Estimate,
      `HC3 SE, M(noinfo)` = no_summary$`HC3 SE`,
      `M(partinfo) - M(noinfo)` = difference_estimate,
      `HC3 SE, difference` = difference_summary$`HC3 SE`,
      `HC3 t statistic, difference` =
        difference_summary$`HC3 t statistic`,
      `HC3 F, difference` = difference_summary$`HC3 F`,
      `HC3 p value, difference positive` =
        difference_summary$`HC3 p value, positive`,
      `HC3 p value, difference two-sided` =
        difference_summary$`HC3 p value, two-sided`,
      `Sign of difference` = signed_direction(difference_estimate),
      `Larger signed change` = condition_gap_direction_label(difference_estimate),
      Stars = average_regression_star_label(
        difference_summary$`HC3 p value, two-sided`
      )
    )
  }

  map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(comparisons)), function(comparison_index) {
    reference_value <- comparisons$`Reference value`[[comparison_index]]
    contrast_value <- comparisons$`Contrast value`[[comparison_index]]
    environmental_vectors <- gap_vectors(
      "Environmental",
      reference_value,
      contrast_value
    )
    social_vectors <- gap_vectors(
      "Social",
      reference_value,
      contrast_value
    )
    treatment_vectors <- list(
      Environmental = environmental_vectors,
      Social = social_vectors
    )

    imap_dfr(
      treatment_vectors,
      function(vectors, treatment_value) {
        make_row(
          treatment_value,
          reference_value,
          contrast_value,
          vectors$part_gap,
          vectors$no_gap,
          vectors$difference
        )
      }
    )
  })
}

summary_se <- function(data, group_vars = character()) {
  data %>%
    mutate(
      Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = treatment_levels),
      Condition = factor(Condition, levels = condition_levels),
      obs_level = factor(obs_level, levels = obs_level_levels)
    ) %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(c(group_vars, "Treatment", "obs_level", "Condition")))) %>%
    summarise(
      n = sum(!is.na(inferred_attribute)),
      Mean = mean(inferred_attribute, na.rm = TRUE),
      SD = sd(inferred_attribute, na.rm = TRUE),
      SE = if_else(n > 1, SD / sqrt(n), NA_real_),
      ymin = Mean - SE,
      ymax = Mean + SE,
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

make_treatment_plot <- function(desc_data,
                                treatment_value,
                                plot_title = NULL,
                                facet_var = NULL,
                                facet_cols = NULL) {
  settings <- outcome_settings[[treatment_value]]

  p <- desc_data %>%
    filter(Treatment == treatment_value) %>%
    ggplot(
      aes(
        x = obs_level,
        y = Mean,
        fill = Condition,
        group = Condition
      )
    ) +
    geom_col(
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
      width = 0.8
    ) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
      width = 0.2,
      linewidth = 0.6
    ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = settings$hline, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = settings$limits, breaks = settings$breaks) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = condition_palettes[[treatment_value]],
      breaks = condition_levels,
      limits = condition_levels,
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = obs_level_labels) +
    labs(
      title = if (is.null(plot_title)) settings$title else plot_title,
      x = "Level of the observed attribute",
      y = settings$y_label
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      legend.key.width = grid::unit(0.3, "cm"),
      legend.key.height = grid::unit(0.3, "cm"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 9),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    ) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(title = NULL))

  if (!is.null(facet_var)) {
    p <- p +
      facet_wrap(
        as.formula(paste("~", facet_var)),
        ncol = facet_cols,
        labeller = label_wrap_gen(width = 24)
      ) +
      theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 8.5))
  }

  p
}

average_b2_data <- dataset %>%
  mutate(
    b2_h_numeric = as.numeric(a_B2_H),
    b2_m_numeric = as.numeric(a_B2_M),
    b2_l_numeric = as.numeric(a_B2_L),
    average_B2 = rowMeans(
      cbind(b2_h_numeric, b2_m_numeric, b2_l_numeric),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    average_B2 = if_else(is.nan(average_B2), NA_real_, average_B2),
    b2_min = case_when(
      Treatment == "Environmental" ~ 1.5,
      Treatment == "Social" ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    b2_max = case_when(
      Treatment == "Environmental" ~ 11.5,
      Treatment == "Social" ~ 1500,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    renormalised_average_b2 = (average_B2 - b2_min) / (b2_max - b2_min),
    Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = treatment_levels),
    Condition = factor(Condition, levels = condition_levels),
    info_treatment = factor(Condition, levels = condition_levels)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(id),
    !is.na(Treatment),
    !is.na(Condition),
    !is.na(info_treatment),
    !is.na(average_B2),
    !is.na(renormalised_average_b2)
  )

clean_ticker <- function(x) {
  str_replace_all(str_to_upper(as.character(x)), "[^A-Z0-9]", "")
}

read_blackrock_holdings <- function(path) {
  lines <- readLines(path, warn = FALSE)
  header_line <- which(str_detect(lines, "^Ticker,"))[1]

  if (is.na(header_line)) {
    stop("Could not find the holdings header row in the BlackRock CSV.", call. = FALSE)
  }

  readr::read_csv(
    I(paste(lines[header_line:length(lines)], collapse = "\n")),
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )
}

    )
  )

make_b2_level_descriptive_stats <- function(treatment_value, include_uk_ceo_worker = FALSE) {
  level_condition_levels <- as.vector(t(outer(
    unname(obs_level_labels[obs_level_levels]),
    c("Silent", "Interval"),
    paste
  )))

  level_descriptive_stats <- data_rq2 %>%
    filter(
      Treatment == treatment_value,
      !is.na(Condition),
      !is.na(obs_level),
      !is.na(inferred_attribute)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Condition = factor(Condition, levels = condition_levels),
      `Level-condition` = paste(
        unname(obs_level_labels[as.character(obs_level)]),
        recode(as.character(Condition), NoInfo = "Silent", PartInfo = "Interval")
      ),
      `Level-condition` = factor(
        `Level-condition`,
        levels = level_condition_levels
      )
    ) %>%
    group_by(`Level-condition`) %>%
    summarise(
      Mean = mean(inferred_attribute, na.rm = TRUE),
      Median = median(inferred_attribute, na.rm = TRUE),
      `5%` = quantile(inferred_attribute, probs = 0.05, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE),
      `10%` = quantile(inferred_attribute, probs = 0.10, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE),
      `25%` = quantile(inferred_attribute, probs = 0.25, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE),
      `75%` = quantile(inferred_attribute, probs = 0.75, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE),
      `90%` = quantile(inferred_attribute, probs = 0.90, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE),
      `95%` = quantile(inferred_attribute, probs = 0.95, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE),
      Max = max(inferred_attribute, na.rm = TRUE),
      Min = min(inferred_attribute, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    complete(
      `Level-condition` = factor(level_condition_levels, levels = level_condition_levels)
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = all_of(descriptive_stat_levels),
      names_to = "Statistic",
      values_to = "precision equivalent"
    ) %>%
    mutate(Statistic = factor(Statistic, levels = descriptive_stat_levels)) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = `Level-condition`,
      values_from = `precision equivalent`
    ) %>%
    arrange(Statistic) %>%
    mutate(Statistic = as.character(Statistic))

  if (include_uk_ceo_worker) {
    level_descriptive_stats <- level_descriptive_stats %>%
      left_join(uk_ceo_worker_descriptive_stats, by = "Statistic")
  }

  numeric_columns <- setdiff(names(level_descriptive_stats), "Statistic")

  level_descriptive_stats %>%
    mutate(
      across(
        all_of(numeric_columns),
        ~ fmt_num(.x, if_else(treatment_value == "Environmental", 2, 0))
      )
    )
}

make_sample_census_comparison_table <- function(data,
                                                variable_name,
                                                category_levels,
                                                census_percent,
                                                category_column) {
  comparison_table <- data %>%
    mutate(Category = factor(.data[[variable_name]], levels = category_levels)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Category)) %>%
    count(Category, name = "Freq.") %>%
    complete(
      Category = factor(category_levels, levels = category_levels),
      fill = list(`Freq.` = 0L)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      `%` = 100 * `Freq.` / sum(`Freq.`),
      `(C)` = unname(census_percent[as.character(Category)]),
      Category = as.character(Category),
      `%` = fmt_pct(`%`),
      `(C)` = fmt_pct(`(C)`)
    ) %>%
    select(Category, `Freq.`, `%`, `(C)`)

  names(comparison_table)[names(comparison_table) == "Category"] <- category_column
  comparison_table
}

summarise_average_b2_political_means <- function() {
  total_sample <- average_b2_data %>%
    mutate(political_group = "Total")

  political_sample <- average_b2_data %>%
    filter(!is_missing_value(political_spectrum)) %>%
    mutate(
      political_group = factor(
        as.character(political_spectrum),
        levels = c("Left", "Center", "Right")
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(political_group)) %>%
    mutate(political_group = as.character(political_group))

  bind_rows(total_sample, political_sample) %>%
    mutate(
      political_group = factor(
        political_group,
        levels = average_b2_plot_group_levels
      )
    ) %>%
    group_by(Treatment, Condition, political_group) %>%
    summarise(
      n = sum(!is.na(average_B2)),
      Mean = mean(average_B2, na.rm = TRUE),
      Median = median(average_B2, na.rm = TRUE),
      SD = sd(average_B2, na.rm = TRUE),
      SE = if_else(n > 1, SD / sqrt(n), NA_real_),
      ymin = Mean - SE,
      ymax = Mean + SE,
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

make_average_b2_side_summary <- function(values, source_label) {
  values <- values[is.finite(values) & values >= 0]

  if (length(values) < 2) {
    return(tibble())
  }

  quantiles <- quantile(
    values,
    c(0.05, 0.25, 0.75, 0.95),
    na.rm = TRUE,
    names = FALSE
  )

  tibble(
    source = source_label,
    n = length(values),
    mean = mean(values, na.rm = TRUE),
    median = median(values, na.rm = TRUE),
    q05 = quantiles[[1]],
    q25 = quantiles[[2]],
    q75 = quantiles[[3]],
    q95 = quantiles[[4]]
  )
}

run_average_b2_plot_mann_whitney_test <- function(data,
                                                  treatment_value,
                                                  political_group_value) {
  test_data <- data %>%
    filter(Treatment == treatment_value)

  if (!identical(political_group_value, "Total")) {
    test_data <- test_data %>%
      filter(
        !is_missing_value(political_spectrum),
        as.character(political_spectrum) == political_group_value
      )
  }

  no_info_values <- test_data %>%
    filter(Condition == "NoInfo") %>%
    pull(average_B2)
  partial_info_values <- test_data %>%
    filter(Condition == "PartInfo") %>%
    pull(average_B2)

  no_info_values <- no_info_values[is.finite(no_info_values)]
  partial_info_values <- partial_info_values[is.finite(partial_info_values)]

  mann_whitney_test <- tryCatch(
    wilcox.test(
      partial_info_values,
      no_info_values,
      alternative = "two.sided",
      exact = FALSE,
      correct = TRUE
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  p_value <- if (is.null(mann_whitney_test)) {
    NA_real_
  } else {
    mann_whitney_test$p.value
  }
  stars <- average_regression_star_label(p_value)

  tibble(
    Treatment = as.character(treatment_value),
    political_group = political_group_value,
    `Mann-Whitney p value` = p_value,
    Stars = stars,
    `Plot label` = if_else(is.na(p_value), "", if_else(stars == "", "n.s.", stars))
  )
}

      ..1,
      ..2
    )
  )

make_average_b2_political_mean_plot <- function(plot_data,
                                                treatment_value,
                                                plot_title,
                                                side_summary_sources = NULL,
                                                side_summary_boxes = NULL,
                                                side_summary_points = NULL) {
  settings <- average_b2_interval_settings[[treatment_value]]
  reference_lines <- switch(
    treatment_value,
    Environmental = c(4, 9),
    Social = c(250, 500, 1000, 1250),
    numeric(0)
  )
  y_break_data <- bind_rows(
    tibble(value = settings$breaks, label = settings$break_labels),
    tibble(
      value = reference_lines,
      label = format(reference_lines, big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE)
    )
  ) %>%
    arrange(value)
  group_positions <- tibble(
    political_group = factor(
      average_b2_plot_group_levels,
      levels = average_b2_plot_group_levels
    ),
    x_group = seq_along(average_b2_plot_group_levels)
  )
  condition_offsets <- c("NoInfo" = -0.13, "PartInfo" = 0.13)

  plot_subset <- plot_data %>%
    filter(Treatment == treatment_value) %>%
    mutate(
      political_group = factor(
        political_group,
        levels = average_b2_plot_group_levels
      ),
      Condition = factor(Condition, levels = condition_levels),
      count_label = paste0("n=", n),
      median_label = "Median"
    ) %>%
    left_join(group_positions, by = "political_group") %>%
    mutate(
      x_plot = x_group + condition_offsets[as.character(Condition)],
      ymin_plot = pmax(ymin, settings$limits[1], na.rm = TRUE),
      ymax_plot = pmin(ymax, settings$limits[2], na.rm = TRUE),
      label_y = pmin(
        ymax_plot + diff(settings$limits) * 0.035,
        settings$limits[2] - diff(settings$limits) * 0.025
      )
    )

  bracket_data <- average_b2_plot_mann_whitney_tests %>%
    filter(Treatment == treatment_value) %>%
    mutate(
      political_group = factor(
        political_group,
        levels = average_b2_plot_group_levels
      )
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      plot_subset %>%
        group_by(political_group) %>%
        summarise(
          x_start = min(x_plot, na.rm = TRUE),
          x_end = max(x_plot, na.rm = TRUE),
          max_mark = max(c(ymax_plot, Median, label_y), na.rm = TRUE),
          .groups = "drop"
        ),
      by = "political_group"
    ) %>%
    filter(
      is.finite(x_start),
      is.finite(x_end),
      is.finite(max_mark),
      !is.na(`Plot label`),
      `Plot label` != ""
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      x_mid = (x_start + x_end) / 2,
      y = pmin(
        max_mark + diff(settings$limits) * 0.055,
        settings$limits[2] + diff(settings$limits) * 0.035
      ),
      y_tip = y - diff(settings$limits) * 0.025,
      label_y = y + diff(settings$limits) * 0.03
    )

  interval_markers <- tibble(
    value = settings$breaks,
    label = settings$break_labels,
    marker = factor(
      case_when(
        value == settings$limits[1] ~ "Zero",
        value == max(settings$breaks) ~ "Upper limit",
        str_detect(label, "Midpoint") ~ "Midpoint",
        TRUE ~ "Lower limit"
      ),
      levels = c("Zero", "Lower limit", "Midpoint", "Upper limit")
    )
  )

  x_side_base <- max(group_positions$x_group) + 0.68
  x_side_spacing <- 0.18
  side_summary_box_width <- 0.09
  include_side_summary_sources <-
    !is.null(side_summary_sources) && length(side_summary_sources) > 0
  include_side_summary_boxes <-
    !is.null(side_summary_boxes) && nrow(side_summary_boxes) > 0
  include_side_summary_points <-
    !is.null(side_summary_points) && nrow(side_summary_points) > 0
  include_side_summary <- include_side_summary_sources ||
    include_side_summary_boxes ||
    include_side_summary_points

  side_summary <- tibble()
  side_point_data <- tibble()

  if (include_side_summary) {
    side_source_order <- unique(c(
      if (include_side_summary_sources) names(side_summary_sources) else character(),
      if (include_side_summary_boxes) as.character(side_summary_boxes$source) else character(),
      if (include_side_summary_points) as.character(side_summary_points$source) else character()
    ))

    side_positions <- tibble(
      source = factor(side_source_order, levels = side_source_order),
      x_plot = x_side_base +
        (seq_along(side_source_order) - (length(side_source_order) + 1) / 2) *
          x_side_spacing
    )

    side_summary <- bind_rows(
      if (include_side_summary_sources) {
        imap_dfr(
          side_summary_sources,
          ~ make_average_b2_side_summary(.x, .y)
        )
      } else {
        tibble()
      },
      if (include_side_summary_boxes) {
        side_summary_boxes
      } else {
        tibble()
      }
    ) %>%
      mutate(
        source = factor(source, levels = side_source_order),
        q05_plot = pmax(q05, settings$limits[1]),
        q25_plot = pmin(pmax(q25, settings$limits[1]), settings$limits[2]),
        median_plot = pmin(pmax(median, settings$limits[1]), settings$limits[2]),
        q75_plot = pmin(pmax(q75, settings$limits[1]), settings$limits[2]),
        q95_plot = pmin(q95, settings$limits[2]),
        q05_plot = pmin(q05_plot, q25_plot),
        q95_plot = pmax(q95_plot, q75_plot)
      ) %>%
      left_join(side_positions, by = "source") %>%
      mutate(
        axis_label = coalesce(
          unname(average_b2_side_summary_axis_labels[as.character(source)]),
          as.character(source)
        )
      )

    if (include_side_summary_points) {
      side_point_data <- side_summary_points %>%
        mutate(source = factor(source, levels = side_source_order)) %>%
        left_join(side_positions, by = "source") %>%
        group_by(source) %>%
        mutate(
          point_index = row_number(),
          point_count = n(),
          x_point = x_plot +
            (point_index - (point_count + 1) / 2) * (side_summary_box_width / 3),
          value_plot = pmin(pmax(value, settings$limits[1]), settings$limits[2])
        ) %>%
        ungroup()
    }
  }

  x_breaks <- group_positions %>%
    transmute(x = x_group, label = as.character(political_group))
  x_limits <- c(0.55, max(group_positions$x_group) + 0.45)

  fill_values <- condition_palettes[[treatment_value]]
  fill_labels <- average_b2_condition_labels

  if (nrow(side_summary) > 0) {
    side_summary_colors <- average_b2_side_summary_palette[
      side_source_order[
        side_source_order %in% names(average_b2_side_summary_palette)
      ]
    ]
    fill_values <- c(fill_values, side_summary_colors)
    fill_labels <- c(
      fill_labels,
      average_b2_side_summary_labels[names(side_summary_colors)]
    )
  }

  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_hline(
      data = interval_markers,
      aes(yintercept = value, linetype = marker),
      color = "grey55",
      linewidth = 0.35
    )

  if (length(reference_lines) > 0) {
    p <- p +
      geom_hline(
        yintercept = reference_lines,
        color = "grey70",
        linetype = "dotted",
        linewidth = 0.3
      )
  }

  p <- p +
    geom_col(
      data = plot_subset,
      aes(x = x_plot, y = Mean, fill = Condition),
      width = 0.22,
      color = "grey30",
      linewidth = 0.2
    ) +
    geom_errorbar(
      data = plot_subset,
      aes(
        x = x_plot,
        ymin = ymin_plot,
        ymax = ymax_plot
      ),
      color = "grey25",
      width = 0.06,
      linewidth = 0.45
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = plot_subset,
      aes(x = x_plot, y = Median, shape = median_label),
      color = "blue",
      size = 3.8,
      stroke = 0.8
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = plot_subset,
      aes(x = x_plot, y = label_y, label = count_label),
      size = 2.55,
      color = "grey20",
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_segment(
      data = bracket_data,
      aes(x = x_start, xend = x_end, y = y, yend = y),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      linewidth = 0.35
    ) +
    geom_segment(
      data = bracket_data,
      aes(x = x_start, xend = x_start, y = y, yend = y_tip),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      linewidth = 0.35
    ) +
    geom_segment(
      data = bracket_data,
      aes(x = x_end, xend = x_end, y = y, yend = y_tip),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      linewidth = 0.35
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = bracket_data,
      aes(x = x_mid, y = label_y, label = `Plot label`),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 3,
      color = "grey15"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = x_breaks$x,
      labels = x_breaks$label,
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = y_break_data$value,
      labels = y_break_data$label,
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = fill_values,
      labels = fill_labels,
      breaks = names(fill_values),
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = average_b2_side_summary_outline_palette,
      breaks = names(average_b2_side_summary_outline_palette),
      guide = "none"
    ) +
    scale_shape_manual(
      values = c(Median = 95),
      breaks = "Median",
      labels = "Median"
    ) +
    scale_linetype_manual(
      values = c(
        "Zero" = "solid",
        "Lower limit" = "solid",
        "Midpoint" = "dashed",
        "Upper limit" = "solid"
      ),
      guide = "none"
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = x_limits, ylim = settings$limits, clip = "off") +
    labs(
      title = plot_title,
      x = "Sample",
      y = settings$y_label,
      fill = "Series",
      shape = NULL
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(
        18,
        if (include_side_summary) 72 else 8,
        34,
        5.5
      )
    ) +
    guides(
      fill = guide_legend(nrow = if_else(include_side_summary, 2L, 1L), byrow = TRUE),
      shape = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 5))
    )

  if (include_side_summary) {
    p <- p +
      geom_segment(
        data = tibble(
          x = x_limits[[2]],
          y = settings$limits[[1]],
          yend = settings$limits[[2]]
        ),
        aes(x = x, xend = x, y = y, yend = yend),
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        color = "grey45",
        linewidth = 0.3
      )
  }

  if (nrow(side_summary) > 0) {
    p <- p +
      geom_boxplot(
        data = side_summary,
        aes(
          x = x_plot,
          ymin = q05_plot,
          lower = q25_plot,
          middle = median_plot,
	          upper = q75_plot,
	          ymax = q95_plot,
	          group = source,
	          fill = source,
	          color = source
	        ),
	        stat = "identity",
	        width = side_summary_box_width,
	        linewidth = 0.35
	      )
  }

  if (nrow(side_point_data) > 0) {
    p <- p +
      geom_point(
        data = side_point_data,
        aes(x = x_point, y = value_plot, color = source),
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        size = 2.1,
        alpha = 0.8,
        position = position_jitter(width = 0.006, height = 0)
      )
  }

  if (nrow(side_summary) > 0) {
    p <- p +
      geom_text(
        data = side_summary,
        aes(
          x = x_plot,
          y = settings$limits[[1]] - diff(settings$limits) * 0.045,
          label = axis_label
        ),
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        size = 2.55,
        lineheight = 0.9,
        color = "grey35"
      )
  }

  p
}
```

The precision equivalent in this section is the respondent-level mean of
the precision equivalents in high, medium, and low tasks. In the
article, this is what we call the "(average) precision equivalent".

```{r average-b2-condition-tests}
run_average_b2_condition_tests <- function(data, treatment_value) {
  test_data <- data %>%
    filter(Treatment == treatment_value)

  no_info_values <- test_data %>%
    filter(Condition == "NoInfo") %>%
    pull(average_B2)

  partial_info_values <- test_data %>%
    filter(Condition == "PartInfo") %>%
    pull(average_B2)

  no_info_n <- length(no_info_values)
  partial_info_n <- length(partial_info_values)
  no_info_mean <- mean(no_info_values, na.rm = TRUE)
  partial_info_mean <- mean(partial_info_values, na.rm = TRUE)
  mean_difference <- partial_info_mean - no_info_mean

  welch_test <- tryCatch(
    t.test(partial_info_values, no_info_values, var.equal = FALSE),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  mann_whitney_test <- tryCatch(
    wilcox.test(
      partial_info_values,
      no_info_values,
      alternative = "two.sided",
      exact = FALSE,
      correct = TRUE
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  tibble(
    Treatment = as.character(treatment_value),
    Test = c("Welch t-test", "Mann-Whitney"),
    `N No/Part` = paste(no_info_n, partial_info_n, sep = " / "),
    `Mean No/Part` = paste(
      fmt_num(no_info_mean, 1),
      fmt_num(partial_info_mean, 1),
      sep = " / "
    ),
    `Diff` = fmt_num(mean_difference, 3),
    Statistic = c(
      if (is.null(welch_test)) {
        ""
      } else {
        paste0("t=", fmt_num(unname(welch_test$statistic), 2))
      },
      if (is.null(mann_whitney_test)) {
        ""
      } else {
        paste0(
          "W=",
          formatC(unname(mann_whitney_test$statistic), format = "f", digits = 0)
        )
      }
    ),
    df = c(
      if (is.null(welch_test)) fmt_num(NA_real_) else fmt_num(unname(welch_test$parameter), 1),
      ""
    ),
    `p value` = c(
      if (is.null(welch_test)) fmt_p(NA_real_) else fmt_p(welch_test$p.value),
      if (is.null(mann_whitney_test)) fmt_p(NA_real_) else fmt_p(mann_whitney_test$p.value)
    )
  )
}

average_b2_condition_tests <- map_dfr(
  treatment_levels,
  ~ run_average_b2_condition_tests(average_b2_data, .x)
)

run_average_b2_shapiro_test <- function(values) {
  values <- values[is.finite(values)]

  if (length(values) < 3 || length(values) > 5000 || n_distinct(values) < 2) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  tryCatch(
    shapiro.test(values),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
}

run_average_b2_levene_test <- function(test_data) {
  levene_data <- test_data %>%
    filter(!is.na(Condition), is.finite(average_B2)) %>%
    group_by(Condition) %>%
    mutate(
      condition_median = median(average_B2, na.rm = TRUE),
      absolute_deviation = abs(average_B2 - condition_median)
    ) %>%
    ungroup()

  if (n_distinct(levene_data$Condition) < 2) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  tryCatch(
    {
      levene_model <- lm(absolute_deviation ~ Condition, data = levene_data)
      levene_table <- anova(levene_model) %>%
        as.data.frame() %>%
        rownames_to_column("Term")

      list(
        effect = levene_table %>% filter(Term == "Condition"),
        residual = levene_table %>% filter(Term == "Residuals")
      )
    },
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
}

run_average_b2_condition_diagnostics <- function(data, treatment_value) {
  test_data <- data %>%
    filter(Treatment == treatment_value)

  normality_rows <- map_dfr(condition_levels, function(condition_value) {
    condition_values <- test_data %>%
      filter(Condition == condition_value) %>%
      pull(average_B2)
    condition_values <- condition_values[is.finite(condition_values)]
    shapiro_test <- run_average_b2_shapiro_test(condition_values)

    tibble(
      Treatment = as.character(treatment_value),
      Diagnostic = "Normality",
      `Distribution compared` = average_b2_condition_labels[[condition_value]],
      Test = "Shapiro-Wilk",
      N = as.character(length(condition_values)),
      Statistic = if (is.null(shapiro_test)) {
        ""
      } else {
        paste0("W=", fmt_num(unname(shapiro_test$statistic), 3))
      },
      df = "",
      `p value` = if (is.null(shapiro_test)) {
        ""
      } else {
        fmt_p(shapiro_test$p.value)
      }
    )
  })

  levene_stats <- run_average_b2_levene_test(test_data)
  no_info_n <- sum(test_data$Condition == "NoInfo", na.rm = TRUE)
  part_info_n <- sum(test_data$Condition == "PartInfo", na.rm = TRUE)

  levene_row <- tibble(
    Treatment = as.character(treatment_value),
    Diagnostic = "Equal variance",
    `Distribution compared` = "Silent vs Interval",
    Test = "Levene median test",
    N = paste(no_info_n, part_info_n, sep = " / "),
    Statistic = if (is.null(levene_stats)) {
      ""
    } else {
      paste0(
        "F=",
        fmt_num(levene_stats$effect$`F value`[[1]], 3)
      )
    },
    df = if (is.null(levene_stats)) {
      ""
    } else {
      paste(
        fmt_num(levene_stats$effect$Df[[1]], 0),
        fmt_num(levene_stats$residual$Df[[1]], 0),
        sep = ", "
      )
    },
    `p value` = if (is.null(levene_stats)) {
      ""
    } else {
      fmt_p(levene_stats$effect$`Pr(>F)`[[1]])
    }
  )

  bind_rows(normality_rows, levene_row)
}
```

For the regression below, precision equivalent is put on the following
treatment-specific renormalised scales:

$$Y_i =
\begin{cases}
(\overline{B2}_i - 1.5)/(11.5 - 1.5), & \text{Environmental}\\
(\overline{B2}_i - 1)/(1500 - 1), & \text{Social.}
\end{cases}$$

The no-covariate regression is

$$Y_i = \alpha + \beta Social_i + \gamma Interval_i
  + \delta (Social_i \times Interval_i) + u_i.$$

Thus $ME_E = \gamma$, $ME_S = \gamma + \delta$, and
$ME_S - ME_E = \delta$. The coefficient tests below are two-sided HC3
robust $t$ tests of $H_0: \theta = 0$ against $H_1: \theta \neq 0$. In
particular, the interaction row tests $H_0: ME_S - ME_E = 0$ against
$H_1: ME_S - ME_E \neq 0$.

```{r renormalised-average-b2-condition-regression}
renormalised_average_b2_condition_model <- lm(
  renormalised_average_b2 ~ Treatment * info_treatment,
  data = average_b2_data
)

format_renormalised_condition_term <- function(term) {
  case_when(
    term == "(Intercept)" ~ "Intercept",
    term == "TreatmentSocial" ~ "Social information gap",
    term == "info_treatmentPartInfo" ~ "Interval",
    str_detect(term, fixed("TreatmentSocial")) &
      str_detect(term, fixed("info_treatmentPartInfo")) ~
      "Social x Interval",
    TRUE ~ term
  )
}

renormalised_condition_model_beta <- coef(
  renormalised_average_b2_condition_model
)
renormalised_condition_model_beta <- renormalised_condition_model_beta[
  !is.na(renormalised_condition_model_beta)
]
renormalised_condition_model_vcov <- hc3_vcov(
  renormalised_average_b2_condition_model
)
renormalised_condition_model_se <- sqrt(
  diag(renormalised_condition_model_vcov)
)
renormalised_condition_model_t <- renormalised_condition_model_beta /
  renormalised_condition_model_se[names(renormalised_condition_model_beta)]
renormalised_condition_model_df <- df.residual(
  renormalised_average_b2_condition_model
)
renormalised_condition_model_p <- 2 * pt(
  abs(renormalised_condition_model_t),
  df = renormalised_condition_model_df,
  lower.tail = FALSE
)

renormalised_condition_model_coefficients <- tibble(
  Term = format_renormalised_condition_term(
    names(renormalised_condition_model_beta)
  ),
  Estimate = unname(renormalised_condition_model_beta),
  `HC3 SE` = unname(
    renormalised_condition_model_se[
      names(renormalised_condition_model_beta)
    ]
  ),
  `HC3 t` = unname(renormalised_condition_model_t),
  df = renormalised_condition_model_df,
  `p value (two-sided)` = fmt_p(unname(renormalised_condition_model_p)),
  Stars = average_regression_star_label(renormalised_condition_model_p)
)

export_table(
  renormalised_condition_model_coefficients,
  table_id = "renormalised_average_b2_condition_model_coefficients",
  digits = 4,
  caption = paste(
    "No-covariate OLS regression of renormalised average B2 on treatment,",
    "information condition, and their interaction.",
    "Environmental and Silent are the reference categories.",
    "Standard errors are HC3; p values and stars are from two-sided robust t tests."
  ),
  column_widths = c(
    "0.24\\linewidth",
    "0.11\\linewidth",
    "0.11\\linewidth",
    "0.10\\linewidth",
    "0.08\\linewidth",
    "0.10\\linewidth",
    "0.06\\linewidth"
  ),
  latex_font_size = "\\footnotesize",
```

```{r renormalised-average-b2-marginal-effects}
)

format_marginal_effect_row <- function(effect_label,
                                       hypothesis_label,
                                       effect_summary) {
  effect_summary %>%
    transmute(
      Effect = hypothesis_label,
      Estimate,
      `HC3 SE`,
      `HC3 t` = `HC3 t statistic`,
      df = `Denominator df`,
      `p value` = fmt_p(`HC3 p value, two-sided`)
    )
}

  ),

    "$\\mathrm{ME}_E$ and $\\mathrm{ME}_S$ are defined as in the text, within information gaps on the environmental and social dimensions. The tests are two-sided $t$-tests with HC3 robust standard errors.  Model fit: $R^2 = ",
      fmt_num(summary(renormalised_average_b2_condition_model)$r.squared, 3),
      "$; adjusted $R^2 = ",

  ),
```

The ordinal table fits information-gap-specific probabilistic indices
with a logit-link probabilistic-index model. The comparison set is
restricted to pairs within the same information gap, with the left
observation drawn from `Silent` and the right observation drawn from
`Interval`. The fitted line uses separate Environmental and Social
information-gap coefficients, with no intercept.

For each admissible Silent--Interval pair $(i,j)$ in information gap
$T_{ij} \in \{E,S\}$, define the PIM pseudo-response as

$$D_{ij} =
\mathbf{1}\{Y_j > Y_i\}
+ \frac{1}{2}\mathbf{1}\{Y_j = Y_i\},$$

where $Y_i$ is the Silent observation and $Y_j$ is the Interval
observation. The fitted PIM-logit model is

$$\logit\{\Pr(D_{ij}=1)\}
= \lambda_E \mathbf{1}\{T_{ij}=E\}
+ \lambda_S \mathbf{1}\{T_{ij}=S\},$$

with no intercept. Equivalently,

$$\theta_E = \logit^{-1}(\lambda_E)
= \Pr(Y_{\mathrm{Interval},E} > Y_{\mathrm{Silent},E})
+ \frac{1}{2}\Pr(Y_{\mathrm{Interval},E}=Y_{\mathrm{Silent},E}),$$

and

$$\theta_S = \logit^{-1}(\lambda_S)
= \Pr(Y_{\mathrm{Interval},S} > Y_{\mathrm{Silent},S})
+ \frac{1}{2}\Pr(Y_{\mathrm{Interval},S}=Y_{\mathrm{Silent},S}).$$

With this comparison set, the Environmental coefficient estimates
$\logit(\theta_E)$, and the Social coefficient estimates
$\logit(\theta_S)$. Since the logit link is monotone, testing
$\theta_S > \theta_E$ is equivalent to testing
$\logit(\theta_S)-\logit(\theta_E) > 0$.

```{r pim-logit-average-b2-condition-effects}
build_pim_condition_pairs <- function(data) {
  environmental_no_info <- which(
    data$Treatment == "Environmental" &
      data$info_treatment == "NoInfo"
  )
  environmental_part_info <- which(
    data$Treatment == "Environmental" &
      data$info_treatment == "PartInfo"
  )
  social_no_info <- which(
    data$Treatment == "Social" &
      data$info_treatment == "NoInfo"
  )
  social_part_info <- which(
    data$Treatment == "Social" &
      data$info_treatment == "PartInfo"
  )

  as.matrix(bind_rows(
    expand_grid(L = environmental_no_info, R = environmental_part_info),
    expand_grid(L = social_no_info, R = social_part_info)
  ))
}

pim_condition_pairs <- build_pim_condition_pairs(average_b2_data)

pim_condition_counts <- average_b2_data %>%
  count(Treatment, info_treatment, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(
    Treatment = as.character(Treatment),
    info_treatment = as.character(info_treatment)
  )

pim_n_label <- function(treatment_value) {
  treatment_counts <- pim_condition_counts %>%
    filter(Treatment == treatment_value)

  paste(
    treatment_counts$n[
      match("NoInfo", treatment_counts$info_treatment)
    ],
    treatment_counts$n[
      match("PartInfo", treatment_counts$info_treatment)
    ],
    sep = " / "
  )
}

pim_logit_average_b2_condition_model <- pim(
  average_B2 ~ R(Treatment) - 1,
  data = average_b2_data,
  compare = pim_condition_pairs,
  link = "logit"
)

pim_logit_coef <- coef(pim_logit_average_b2_condition_model)
pim_logit_vcov <- vcov(pim_logit_average_b2_condition_model)
pim_logit_se <- sqrt(diag(pim_logit_vcov))

pim_environmental_term <- names(pim_logit_coef)[
  str_detect(names(pim_logit_coef), fixed("Environmental"))
]
pim_social_term <- names(pim_logit_coef)[
  str_detect(names(pim_logit_coef), fixed("Social"))
]

if (length(pim_environmental_term) != 1 || length(pim_social_term) != 1) {
  stop(
    "Could not identify the Environmental and Social PIM coefficient terms.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

format_pim_logit_row <- function(effect_label,
                                 n_label,
                                 pi_estimate,
                                 logit_estimate,
                                 logit_se) {
  wald_z <- logit_estimate / logit_se
  p_two_sided <- 2 * pnorm(abs(wald_z), lower.tail = FALSE)

  tibble(
    Effect = effect_label,
    `N Silent / Interval` = n_label,
    `PI estimate` = pi_estimate,
    `Logit estimate` = logit_estimate,
    `Logit SE` = logit_se,
    `Wald z` = wald_z,
    `p value` = fmt_p(p_two_sided)
  )
}

pim_difference_contrast <- setNames(rep(0, length(pim_logit_coef)), names(pim_logit_coef))
pim_difference_contrast[pim_social_term] <- 1
pim_difference_contrast[pim_environmental_term] <- -1
pim_difference_logit_estimate <- drop(pim_difference_contrast %*% pim_logit_coef)
pim_difference_logit_se <- sqrt(drop(
  pim_difference_contrast %*% pim_logit_vcov %*% pim_difference_contrast
))

pim_logit_average_b2_condition_effects <- bind_rows(
  format_pim_logit_row(
    "theta_E > 0.5",
    pim_n_label("Environmental"),
    plogis(pim_logit_coef[[pim_environmental_term]]),
    pim_logit_coef[[pim_environmental_term]],
    pim_logit_se[[pim_environmental_term]]
  ),
  format_pim_logit_row(
    "theta_S > 0.5",
    pim_n_label("Social"),
    plogis(pim_logit_coef[[pim_social_term]]),
    pim_logit_coef[[pim_social_term]],
    pim_logit_se[[pim_social_term]]
  ),
  format_pim_logit_row(
    "theta_S > theta_E",
    "",
    plogis(pim_logit_coef[[pim_social_term]]) -
      plogis(pim_logit_coef[[pim_environmental_term]]),
    pim_difference_logit_estimate,
    pim_difference_logit_se
  )
)
```

### info gap format tests: by attitudes and socio-dem

For the covariate tables below, each listed covariate $Z$ is analysed in
a separate saturated model. Let $G_i=1$ for the Social information gap
and $G_i=0$ for the Environmental information gap. Let $D_i=1$ for the
Interval condition and $D_i=0$ for the Silent condition. If $Z$ has
levels $z_1,\ldots,z_K$, with $z_1$ the reference level, the OLS specification is

$$Y_i =
\alpha + \beta G_i + \gamma D_i + \delta G_iD_i
+ \sum_{k=2}^{K}\eta_k \mathbf{1}\{Z_i=z_k\}
+ \sum_{k=2}^{K}\rho_k G_i\mathbf{1}\{Z_i=z_k\}
+ \sum_{k=2}^{K}\tau_k D_i\mathbf{1}\{Z_i=z_k\}
+ \sum_{k=2}^{K}\phi_k G_iD_i\mathbf{1}\{Z_i=z_k\}
+ u_i.$$

For the first set of cardinal tables, $Y_i$ is renormalised precision
equivalent. For the log-social version, the same equation is fitted with
$Y_i^{*}$, where environmental observations remain on the renormalised
precision-equivalent scale and social observations use the renormalised
log precision-equivalent scale.

The marginal effects reported for covariate value $z$ are fitted
contrasts from this saturated regression:

$$ME_T(z) =
E[Y_i \mid G_i=T, D_i=\text{Interval}, Z_i=z]
- E[Y_i \mid G_i=T, D_i=\text{Silent}, Z_i=z].$$

The ordinal covariate tables use the analogous PIM-logit specification.
For each admissible Silent--Interval pair $(i,j)$ within the same
information gap and the same covariate value, define

$$D_{ij} =
\mathbf{1}\{Y_j > Y_i\}
+ \frac{1}{2}\mathbf{1}\{Y_j = Y_i\},$$

where $i$ is the Silent observation and $j$ is the Interval observation.
The fitted PIM-logit model is

$$\logit\{\Pr(D_{ij}=1)\}
= \sum_{T \in \{E,S\}}\sum_{k=1}^{K}
\lambda_{Tk}\mathbf{1}\{T_{ij}=T, Z_{ij}=z_k\},$$

again with no intercept. Thus

$$\theta_T(z_k)=\logit^{-1}(\lambda_{Tk})$$

is the probability index for Interval over Silent within information gap
$T$ and covariate value $z_k$.

```{r info-gap-covariate-support, include=FALSE}
recode_agree_dummy <- function(x) {
  x_chr <- trimws(as.character(x))
  x_num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x_chr))
  missing <- is_missing_value(x)

  case_when(
    missing ~ NA_real_,
    tolower(x_chr) %in% c("strongly agree", "somewhat agree") ~ 1,
    !is.na(x_num) & x_num %in% c(1, 2) ~ 1,
    TRUE ~ 0
  )
}

recode_future_use_yes_dummy <- function(x) {
  x_chr <- trimws(as.character(x))
  x_num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x_chr))
  missing <- is_missing_value(x)

  case_when(
    missing ~ NA_real_,
    tolower(x_chr) %in% c("definitely yes", "probably yes") ~ 1,
    !is.na(x_num) & x_num %in% c(1, 2) ~ 1,
    TRUE ~ 0
  )
}

recode_threshold_dummy <- function(x, threshold) {
  x_num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(x)))
  missing <- is_missing_value(x)

  case_when(
    missing ~ NA_real_,
    !is.na(x_num) & x_num >= threshold ~ 1,
    !is.na(x_num) ~ 0,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  )
}
```
