```{r info-gap-covariate-support, include=FALSE}
fit_covariate_model <- function(data,
                                outcome_variable,
                                covariate_variable,
                                covariate_label) {
  model_data <- data %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(.data[[outcome_variable]]),
      !is.na(.data[[covariate_variable]])
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      "{covariate_variable}" := fct_drop(.data[[covariate_variable]])
    )

  if (nrow(model_data) == 0 || length(levels(model_data[[covariate_variable]])) == 0) {
    return(list(
      model = NULL,
      covariate_variable = covariate_variable,
      covariate_label = covariate_label,
      covariate_levels = character(),
      coefficients = tibble(),
      covariate_test = tibble(),
      model_fit = tibble(),
      marginal_effects = tibble(),
      marginal_positive_tests = tibble(),
      within_treatment_me_tests = tibble(),
      condition_covariate_gap_tests = tibble()
    ))
  }

  model_formula <- as.formula(
    paste0(
      outcome_variable,
      " ~ Treatment * info_treatment * ",
      covariate_variable
    )
  )
  model <- lm(model_formula, data = model_data)
  covariate_levels <- levels(model_data[[covariate_variable]])
  triple_terms <- three_way_terms(model)
  coefficient_table <- estimate_wooldridge_three_way_contrasts(
    model,
    covariate_variable,
    covariate_label,
    covariate_levels
  )

  covariate_test <- wald_test_terms(model, triple_terms) %>%
    mutate(
      Covariate = covariate_label,
      Participants = nobs(model),
      `Triple-term signs` = paste(
        coefficient_table$Contrast,
        coefficient_table$`Sign of difference`,
        sep = ": ",
        collapse = "; "
      ),
      .before = 1
    )

  model_fit <- tibble(
    Covariate = covariate_label,
    Participants = nobs(model),
    `Triple terms` = length(triple_terms),
    `R-squared` = summary(model)$r.squared,
    `Model F` = model_f_statistic(model),
    `Adjusted R-squared` = summary(model)$adj.r.squared
  )

  list(
    model = model,
    covariate_variable = covariate_variable,
    covariate_label = covariate_label,
    covariate_levels = covariate_levels,
    coefficients = coefficient_table,
    covariate_test = covariate_test,
    model_fit = model_fit,
    marginal_effects = estimate_information_effects(
      model,
      covariate_variable,
      covariate_label,
      covariate_levels
    ),
    marginal_positive_tests = estimate_cardinal_marginal_positive_tests(
      model,
      covariate_variable,
      covariate_label,
      covariate_levels
    ),
    within_treatment_me_tests = estimate_cardinal_within_treatment_me_tests(
      model,
      covariate_variable,
      covariate_label,
      covariate_levels
    ),
    condition_covariate_gap_tests = estimate_cardinal_condition_covariate_gap_tests(
      model,
      covariate_variable,
      covariate_label,
      covariate_levels
    )
  )
}

fit_pim_logit_marginal_positive_tests <- function(data,
                                                  covariate_variable,
                                                  covariate_label) {
  pim_data <- data %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(average_b2_raw),
      !is.na(.data[[covariate_variable]])
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      "{covariate_variable}" := fct_drop(.data[[covariate_variable]]),
      pim_cell = interaction(
        Treatment,
        .data[[covariate_variable]],
        sep = ": ",
        drop = TRUE
      )
    )
  covariate_levels <- levels(pim_data[[covariate_variable]])

  if (nrow(pim_data) == 0 || length(covariate_levels) == 0) {
    return(tibble())
  }

  pim_pairs <- map_dfr(treatment_levels, function(treatment_value) {
    map_dfr(covariate_levels, function(covariate_value) {
      no_info_indices <- which(
        pim_data$Treatment == treatment_value &
          pim_data$info_treatment == "NoInfo" &
          pim_data[[covariate_variable]] == covariate_value
      )
      part_info_indices <- which(
        pim_data$Treatment == treatment_value &
          pim_data$info_treatment == "PartInfo" &
          pim_data[[covariate_variable]] == covariate_value
      )

      if (length(no_info_indices) == 0 || length(part_info_indices) == 0) {
        return(tibble(L = integer(), R = integer()))
      }

      expand_grid(L = no_info_indices, R = part_info_indices)
    })
  })

  if (nrow(pim_pairs) == 0) {
    return(tibble())
  }

  pim_model <- pim(
    average_b2_raw ~ R(pim_cell) - 1,
    data = pim_data,
    compare = as.matrix(pim_pairs),
    link = "logit"
  )
  pim_coef <- coef(pim_model)
  pim_se <- sqrt(diag(vcov(pim_model)))
  pim_levels <- levels(pim_data$pim_cell)

  if (length(pim_coef) != length(pim_levels)) {
    stop(
      "Could not match PIM coefficients to treatment-covariate cells.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  coefficient_lookup <- tibble(
    pim_cell = pim_levels,
    logit_estimate = unname(pim_coef),
    logit_se = unname(pim_se)
  )

  map_dfr(treatment_levels, function(treatment_value) {
    map_dfr(covariate_levels, function(covariate_value) {
      cell_label <- paste(treatment_value, covariate_value, sep = ": ")
      coefficient_row <- coefficient_lookup %>%
        filter(pim_cell == cell_label) %>%
        slice(1)
      cell_data <- pim_data %>%
        filter(
          Treatment == treatment_value,
          .data[[covariate_variable]] == covariate_value
        )

      if (nrow(coefficient_row) == 0) {
        return(tibble(
          Treatment = treatment_value,
          Covariate = covariate_label,
          Value = as.character(covariate_value),
          `NoInfo n` = sum(cell_data$info_treatment == "NoInfo"),
          `PartInfo n` = sum(cell_data$info_treatment == "PartInfo"),
          `PI estimate` = NA_real_,
          `Index minus 0.5` = NA_real_,
          `Logit estimate` = NA_real_,
          `Logit SE` = NA_real_,
          `Wald z` = NA_real_,
          `p value, index > 0.5` = NA_real_,
          `p value, two-sided` = NA_real_,
          `Sign of ordinal ME` = NA_character_,
          Stars = ""
        ))
      }

      wald_z <- coefficient_row$logit_estimate / coefficient_row$logit_se
      p_positive <- pnorm(wald_z, lower.tail = FALSE)
      p_two_sided <- 2 * pnorm(abs(wald_z), lower.tail = FALSE)
      pi_estimate <- plogis(coefficient_row$logit_estimate)

      tibble(
        Treatment = treatment_value,
        Covariate = covariate_label,
        Value = as.character(covariate_value),
        `NoInfo n` = sum(cell_data$info_treatment == "NoInfo"),
        `PartInfo n` = sum(cell_data$info_treatment == "PartInfo"),
        `PI estimate` = pi_estimate,
        `Index minus 0.5` = pi_estimate - 0.5,
        `Logit estimate` = coefficient_row$logit_estimate,
        `Logit SE` = coefficient_row$logit_se,
        `Wald z` = wald_z,
        `p value, index > 0.5` = p_positive,
        `p value, two-sided` = p_two_sided,
        `Sign of ordinal ME` = signed_direction(pi_estimate - 0.5),
        Stars = average_regression_star_label(p_positive)
      )
    })
  })
}

fit_pim_logit_marginal_effects <- function(data,
                                           covariate_variable,
                                           covariate_label) {
  pim_data <- data %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(average_b2_raw),
      !is.na(.data[[covariate_variable]])
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      "{covariate_variable}" := fct_drop(.data[[covariate_variable]]),
      pim_cell = interaction(
        Treatment,
        .data[[covariate_variable]],
        sep = ": ",
        drop = TRUE
      )
    )
  covariate_levels <- levels(pim_data[[covariate_variable]])

  if (nrow(pim_data) == 0 || length(covariate_levels) == 0) {
    return(tibble())
  }

  pim_pairs <- map_dfr(treatment_levels, function(treatment_value) {
    map_dfr(covariate_levels, function(covariate_value) {
      no_info_indices <- which(
        pim_data$Treatment == treatment_value &
          pim_data$info_treatment == "NoInfo" &
          pim_data[[covariate_variable]] == covariate_value
      )
      part_info_indices <- which(
        pim_data$Treatment == treatment_value &
          pim_data$info_treatment == "PartInfo" &
          pim_data[[covariate_variable]] == covariate_value
      )

      if (length(no_info_indices) == 0 || length(part_info_indices) == 0) {
        return(tibble(L = integer(), R = integer()))
      }

      expand_grid(L = no_info_indices, R = part_info_indices)
    })
  })

  if (nrow(pim_pairs) == 0) {
    return(tibble())
  }

  pim_model <- pim(
    average_b2_raw ~ R(pim_cell) - 1,
    data = pim_data,
    compare = as.matrix(pim_pairs),
    link = "logit"
  )
  pim_coef <- coef(pim_model)
  pim_vcov <- vcov(pim_model)
  pim_levels <- levels(pim_data$pim_cell)

  if (length(pim_coef) != length(pim_levels)) {
    stop(
      "Could not match PIM coefficients to treatment-covariate cells.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  count_cell <- function(treatment_value, information_value, covariate_value) {
    sum(
      pim_data$Treatment == treatment_value &
        pim_data$info_treatment == information_value &
        pim_data[[covariate_variable]] == covariate_value
    )
  }

  map_dfr(covariate_levels, function(covariate_value) {
    environmental_label <- paste(
      "Environmental",
      covariate_value,
      sep = ": "
    )
    social_label <- paste("Social", covariate_value, sep = ": ")
    environmental_index <- match(environmental_label, pim_levels)
    social_index <- match(social_label, pim_levels)

    counts <- tibble(
      `Env NoInfo n` = count_cell(
        "Environmental",
        "NoInfo",
        covariate_value
      ),
      `Env PartInfo n` = count_cell(
        "Environmental",
        "PartInfo",
        covariate_value
      ),
      `Soc NoInfo n` = count_cell("Social", "NoInfo", covariate_value),
      `Soc PartInfo n` = count_cell("Social", "PartInfo", covariate_value)
    )

    if (any(is.na(c(environmental_index, social_index)))) {
      return(bind_cols(
        tibble(
          Covariate = covariate_label,
          Value = as.character(covariate_value),
          Participants = nrow(pim_data)
        ),
        counts,
        tibble(
          `PI Environmental` = NA_real_,
          `Logit Environmental` = NA_real_,
          `Logit SE, Environmental` = NA_real_,
          `PI Social` = NA_real_,
          `Logit Social` = NA_real_,
          `Logit SE, Social` = NA_real_,
          `Difference in PIs (Social - Environmental)` = NA_real_,
          `SE, PI difference` = NA_real_,
          `Difference in logits (Social - Environmental)` = NA_real_,
          `SE, logit difference` = NA_real_,
          `Wald z statistic, logit difference` = NA_real_,
          `p value, logit difference two-sided` = NA_real_,
          `Sign of difference` = NA_character_,
          Stars = ""
        )
      ))
    }

    environmental_logit <- unname(pim_coef[[environmental_index]])
    social_logit <- unname(pim_coef[[social_index]])
    environmental_pi <- plogis(environmental_logit)
    social_pi <- plogis(social_logit)
    pi_difference <- social_pi - environmental_pi
    logit_difference <- social_logit - environmental_logit
    logit_difference_variance <- (
      pim_vcov[social_index, social_index] +
        pim_vcov[environmental_index, environmental_index] -
        2 * pim_vcov[social_index, environmental_index]
    )
    logit_difference_se <- sqrt(max(logit_difference_variance, 0))
    pi_gradient <- c(
      -environmental_pi * (1 - environmental_pi),
      social_pi * (1 - social_pi)
    )
    pi_difference_variance <- drop(
      t(pi_gradient) %*%
        pim_vcov[
          c(environmental_index, social_index),
          c(environmental_index, social_index),
          drop = FALSE
        ] %*%
        pi_gradient
    )
    pi_difference_se <- sqrt(max(pi_difference_variance, 0))
    wald_z <- logit_difference / logit_difference_se
    p_two_sided <- 2 * pnorm(abs(wald_z), lower.tail = FALSE)

    bind_cols(
      tibble(
        Covariate = covariate_label,
        Value = as.character(covariate_value),
        Participants = nrow(pim_data)
      ),
      counts,
      tibble(
        `PI Environmental` = environmental_pi,
        `Logit Environmental` = environmental_logit,
        `Logit SE, Environmental` =
          sqrt(pim_vcov[environmental_index, environmental_index]),
        `PI Social` = social_pi,
        `Logit Social` = social_logit,
        `Logit SE, Social` = sqrt(pim_vcov[social_index, social_index]),
        `Difference in PIs (Social - Environmental)` = pi_difference,
        `SE, PI difference` = pi_difference_se,
        `Difference in logits (Social - Environmental)` = logit_difference,
        `SE, logit difference` = logit_difference_se,
        `Wald z statistic, logit difference` = wald_z,
        `p value, logit difference two-sided` = p_two_sided,
        `Sign of difference` = signed_direction(pi_difference),
        Stars = average_regression_star_label(p_two_sided)
      )
    )
  })
}

    "Income groups" = "Income",
    "Political spectrum" = "Politics",
    "Alone at dinner" = "Alone dinner",
    "Climate change is a serious problem" = "Climate serious",
    "We should fight climate change" = "Fight climate",
    "Lifestyle changes are needed" = "Lifestyle",
    "People like us are responsible" = "Personal resp.",
    "High-income people are responsible" = "High-inc resp.",
    "UK government is responsible" = "Gov. resp.",
    "Companies are responsible" = "Company resp.",
    "Income differences" = "Inc differences",
    "Responsibility for inequality" = "Inequality resp.",
    .default = covariate_label
  )
}

  value_label %>%
    str_remove("\\s*\\([01]\\)$") %>%
    str_replace(fixed("Yes/probably yes"), "Yes/probably")

higher_information_format <- function(effect_sign) {
  case_when(
    effect_sign == "Positive" ~ "Interval",
    effect_sign == "Negative" ~ "Silent",
    effect_sign == "Zero" ~ "tie",
    TRUE ~ ""
  )
}

estimate_se_bracket <- function(estimate, standard_error, digits = 4) {
  case_when(
    is.na(estimate) & is.na(standard_error) ~ "",
    is.na(standard_error) ~ fmt_num(estimate, digits),
    TRUE ~ paste0(
      fmt_num(estimate, digits),
      " [",
      fmt_num(standard_error, digits),
      "]"
    )
  )
}

latex_escape_cell <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(ifelse(is.na(x), "", x))

  replacements <- list(
    "\\" = "\\textbackslash{}",
    "&" = "\\&",
    "%" = "\\%",
    "$" = "\\$",
    "#" = "\\#",
    "_" = "\\_",
    "{" = "\\{",
    "}" = "\\}",
    "~" = "\\textasciitilde{}",
    "^" = "\\textasciicircum{}",
    "£" = "\\pounds{}"
  )

  for (pattern in names(replacements)) {
    x <- str_replace_all(x, fixed(pattern), replacements[[pattern]])
  }

  x %>%
    str_replace_all(fixed("<="), "$\\leq$") %>%
    str_replace_all(fixed(">="), "$\\geq$")
}

latex_table_label <- function(table_id) {
  str_replace_all(table_id, "_", "-")
}

positive_test_star_note <- paste(
  "N reports Silent/Interval counts.",
  "SEs are in square brackets.",
  "Stars mark two-sided tests of the null hypothesis of zero marginal effect:",
  "* $p < 0.05$, ** $p < 0.01$, *** $p < 0.001$."
)

higher_treatment_format <- function(effect_sign) {
  case_when(
    effect_sign == "Positive" ~ "social",
    effect_sign == "Negative" ~ "environmental",
    effect_sign == "Zero" ~ "tie",
    TRUE ~ ""
  )
}

marginal_effect_star_note <- paste(
  "N reports environmental and social Silent/Interval counts.",
  "SEs are in square brackets.",
  "Stars mark two-sided Social-minus-Environmental tests:",
  "* $p < 0.05$, ** $p < 0.01$, *** $p < 0.001$."
)

render_grouped_latex_table <- function(table_data,
                                       table_id,
                                       caption,
                                       column_widths,
	                                       latex_font_size = "\\scriptsize",
	                                       latex_tabcolsep = "2pt",
	                                       latex_arraystretch = "0.86") {
  rename_treatment <- uses_information_gap_label(table_id)
  table_data <- display_rename_table(
    table_data,
    rename_treatment = rename_treatment
  )
  caption <- display_rename_caption(caption, rename_treatment = rename_treatment)

  if (!"Covariate" %in% names(table_data)) {
    stop("Grouped LaTeX tables need a Covariate column.", call. = FALSE)
  }

  if (ncol(table_data) != length(column_widths)) {
    stop("Column widths must match the number of table columns.", call. = FALSE)
  }

  column_spec <- paste0("p{", column_widths, "}", collapse = "")
  covariate_width <- column_widths[[1]]
  escaped_header <- latex_escape_cell(names(blank_stars_column_title(table_data)))

  table_rows <- split(
    table_data,
    factor(table_data$Covariate, levels = unique(table_data$Covariate)),
    drop = TRUE
  )

  body_rows <- map_chr(seq_along(table_rows), function(group_index) {
    group_data <- table_rows[[group_index]]
    covariate_rows <- map_chr(seq_len(nrow(group_data)), function(row_index) {
      row_data <- group_data[row_index, , drop = FALSE]
      covariate_cell <- if (row_index == 1 && nrow(group_data) == 1) {
        paste0(
          "\\multicolumn{1}{p{",
          covariate_width,
          "}}{",
          latex_escape_cell(row_data$Covariate),
          "}"
        )
      } else if (row_index == 1) {
        paste0(
          "\\multicolumn{1}{p{",
          covariate_width,
          "}}{\\multirow{",
          nrow(group_data),
          "}{",
          covariate_width,
          "}{",
          latex_escape_cell(row_data$Covariate),
          "}}"
        )
      } else {
        paste0("\\multicolumn{1}{p{", covariate_width, "}}{}")
      }

      row_cells <- c(
        covariate_cell,
        map_chr(
          seq(2, ncol(row_data)),
          ~ latex_escape_cell(row_data[[.x]])
        )
      )

      paste(row_cells, collapse = " & ")
    })

    if (group_index < length(table_rows)) {
      paste(c(covariate_rows, "\\addlinespace[1pt]"), collapse = "\\\\\n")
    } else {
      paste(covariate_rows, collapse = "\\\\\n")
    }
  })
  body_rows <- paste0(paste(body_rows, collapse = "\n"), "\\\\")

  paste(
    c(
      "\\providecommand{\\multirow}[3]{#3}",
      "\\begin{table}",
      "",
      paste0(
        "\\caption{\\label{tab:",
        latex_table_label(table_id),
        "}",
        caption,
        "}"
      ),
      "\\centering",
      latex_font_size,
      paste0("\\setlength{\\tabcolsep}{", latex_tabcolsep, "}"),
      paste0("\\renewcommand{\\arraystretch}{", latex_arraystretch, "}"),
      paste0("\\begin{tabular}[t]{", column_spec, "}"),
      "\\toprule",
      paste(escaped_header, collapse = " & "),
      "\\\\",
      "\\midrule",
      body_rows,
      "\\bottomrule",
      "\\end{tabular}",
      "\\end{table}"
    ),
    collapse = "\n"
  )
}

write_grouped_latex_table <- function(table_data,
                                      table_id,
                                      caption,
                                      column_widths,
                                      latex_font_size = "\\scriptsize",
                                      latex_tabcolsep = "2pt",
                                      latex_arraystretch = "0.86") {
  writeLines(
    render_grouped_latex_table(
      table_data,
      table_id = table_id,
      caption = caption,
      column_widths = column_widths,
      latex_font_size = latex_font_size,
      latex_tabcolsep = latex_tabcolsep,
      latex_arraystretch = latex_arraystretch
    ),
    file.path(overleaf_table_dir, paste0(table_id, ".tex")),
    useBytes = TRUE
  )

  display_rename_table(
    blank_stars_column_title(table_data),
    rename_treatment = uses_information_gap_label(table_id)
  )
}

write_split_grouped_latex_table <- function(table_data,
                                            table_id,
                                            caption_template,
                                            column_widths,
                                            split_after_covariate = "Education",
                                            latex_font_size = "\\scriptsize",
                                            latex_tabcolsep = "2pt",
                                            latex_arraystretch = "0.86") {
  covariate_order <- unique(table_data$Covariate)
  split_position <- match(split_after_covariate, covariate_order)

  if (is.na(split_position)) {
    stop("Could not find split covariate in table data.", call. = FALSE)
  }

  first_covariates <- covariate_order[seq_len(split_position)]
  second_covariates <- covariate_order[
    seq(split_position + 1, length(covariate_order))
  ]
  table_parts <- list(
    through_carbon_use = table_data %>%
      filter(Covariate %in% first_covariates),
    remaining = table_data %>%
      filter(Covariate %in% second_covariates)
  )
  part_labels <- c(
    through_carbon_use = "covariates through Education",
    remaining = "remaining covariates"
  )

  latex_tables <- imap(table_parts, function(part_data, part_id) {
    render_grouped_latex_table(
      part_data,
      table_id = paste0(table_id, "_", part_id),
      caption = caption_template(part_labels[[part_id]]),
      column_widths = column_widths,
      latex_font_size = latex_font_size,
      latex_tabcolsep = latex_tabcolsep,
      latex_arraystretch = latex_arraystretch
    )
  })

  walk2(
    latex_tables,
    names(latex_tables),
    ~ writeLines(
      .x,
      file.path(overleaf_table_dir, paste0(table_id, "_", .y, ".tex")),
      useBytes = TRUE
    )
  )

  writeLines(
    paste(unname(latex_tables), collapse = "\n\n"),
    file.path(overleaf_table_dir, paste0(table_id, ".tex")),
    useBytes = TRUE
  )

  display_rename_table(
    blank_stars_column_title(table_data),
    rename_treatment = uses_information_gap_label(table_id)
  )
}

render_grouped_positive_test_table <- function(table_data,
                                               table_id,
                                               caption,
	                                               column_widths,
	                                               latex_font_size = "\\scriptsize",
	                                               latex_tabcolsep = "2pt") {
  rename_treatment <- uses_information_gap_label(table_id)
  table_data <- display_rename_table(
    table_data,
    rename_treatment = rename_treatment
  )
  caption <- display_rename_caption(caption, rename_treatment = rename_treatment)

  column_spec <- paste0("p{", column_widths, "}", collapse = "")
  covariate_width <- column_widths[[1]]
  escaped_header <- latex_escape_cell(names(blank_stars_column_title(table_data)))

  table_rows <- split(
    table_data,
    factor(table_data$Covariate, levels = unique(table_data$Covariate)),
    drop = TRUE
  )

  body_rows <- map_chr(seq_along(table_rows), function(group_index) {
    group_data <- table_rows[[group_index]]
    covariate_rows <- map_chr(seq_len(nrow(group_data)), function(row_index) {
      row_data <- group_data[row_index, , drop = FALSE]
      covariate_cell <- if (row_index == 1) {
        paste0(
          "\\multicolumn{1}{p{",
          covariate_width,
          "}}{\\multirow{",
          nrow(group_data),
          "}{",
          covariate_width,
          "}{",
          latex_escape_cell(row_data$Covariate),
          "}}"
        )
      } else {
        paste0("\\multicolumn{1}{p{", covariate_width, "}}{}")
      }

      row_cells <- c(
        covariate_cell,
        latex_escape_cell(row_data$Value),
        latex_escape_cell(row_data[[3]]),
        latex_escape_cell(row_data[[4]]),
        latex_escape_cell(row_data[[5]]),
        latex_escape_cell(row_data[[6]]),
        latex_escape_cell(row_data$Stars),
        latex_escape_cell(row_data$Higher)
      )

      paste(row_cells, collapse = " & ")
    })

    if (group_index < length(table_rows)) {
      paste(c(covariate_rows, "\\addlinespace[1pt]"), collapse = "\\\\\n")
    } else {
      paste(covariate_rows, collapse = "\\\\\n")
    }
  })
  body_rows <- paste0(paste(body_rows, collapse = "\n"), "\\\\")

  paste(
    c(
      "\\providecommand{\\multirow}[3]{#3}",
      "\\begin{table}",
      "",
      paste0(
        "\\caption{\\label{tab:",
        latex_table_label(table_id),
        "}",
        caption,
        "}"
      ),
      "\\centering",
      latex_font_size,
      paste0("\\setlength{\\tabcolsep}{", latex_tabcolsep, "}"),
      "\\renewcommand{\\arraystretch}{0.86}",
      paste0("\\begin{tabular}[t]{", column_spec, "}"),
      "\\toprule",
      paste(escaped_header, collapse = " & "),
      "\\\\",
      "\\midrule",
      body_rows,
      "\\bottomrule",
      "\\end{tabular}",
      "\\end{table}"
    ),
    collapse = "\n"
  )
}

write_split_positive_test_tables <- function(table_data,
                                             table_id,
                                             caption_template,
                                             column_widths,
                                             latex_font_size = "\\scriptsize",
                                             latex_tabcolsep = "2pt") {
  treatment_table_ids <- c(
    Environmental = paste0(table_id, "_environmental"),
    Social = paste0(table_id, "_social")
  )

  latex_tables <- imap(treatment_table_ids, function(treatment_table_id,
                                                     treatment_name) {
    treatment_table <- table_data %>%
      filter(Treatment == treatment_name) %>%
      select(-Treatment)

    render_grouped_positive_test_table(
      treatment_table,
      table_id = treatment_table_id,
      caption = caption_template(treatment_name),
      column_widths = column_widths,
      latex_font_size = latex_font_size,
      latex_tabcolsep = latex_tabcolsep
    )
  })

  walk2(
    latex_tables,
    treatment_table_ids,
    ~ writeLines(
      .x,
      file.path(overleaf_table_dir, paste0(.y, ".tex")),
      useBytes = TRUE
    )
  )

  writeLines(
    paste(unname(latex_tables), collapse = "\n\n"),
    file.path(overleaf_table_dir, paste0(table_id, ".tex")),
    useBytes = TRUE
  )

  display_rename_table(
    blank_stars_column_title(table_data),
    rename_treatment = uses_information_gap_label(table_id)
  )
}

format_cardinal_positive_tests_for_export <- function(table_data) {
  table_data %>%
    mutate(
      Covariate = short_covariate_label(Covariate),
      Value = clean_covariate_value(Value),
      `N silence/range` = paste(`NoInfo n`, `PartInfo n`, sep = " / "),
      `ME [SE]` = estimate_se_bracket(
        `ME (PartInfo - NoInfo)`,
        `HC3 SE`
      ),
      Stars = average_regression_star_label(`HC3 p value, ME > 0`),
      Higher = higher_information_format(`Sign of ME`),
      .row_order = row_number(),
      .covariate_order = match(Covariate, unique(Covariate)),
      .treatment_order = match(Treatment, c("Environmental", "Social"))
    ) %>%
    filter(Covariate != "Alone at lunch") %>%
    arrange(.treatment_order, .covariate_order, .row_order) %>%
    transmute(
      Treatment,
      Covariate,
      Value,
      `N Sil. / Int.` = `N silence/range`,
      `ME [SE]`,
      `HC3 t` = fmt_num(`HC3 t statistic`, 4),
      df = fmt_num(`Denominator df`, 0),
      Stars,
      Higher
    )
}

format_pim_positive_tests_for_export <- function(table_data) {
  table_data %>%
    mutate(
      Covariate = short_covariate_label(Covariate),
      Value = clean_covariate_value(Value),
      `N silence/range` = paste(`NoInfo n`, `PartInfo n`, sep = " / "),
      `Logit [SE]` = estimate_se_bracket(
        `Logit estimate`,
        `Logit SE`
      ),
      Stars = average_regression_star_label(`p value, index > 0.5`),
      Higher = higher_information_format(`Sign of ordinal ME`),
      .row_order = row_number(),
      .covariate_order = match(Covariate, unique(Covariate)),
      .treatment_order = match(Treatment, c("Environmental", "Social"))
    ) %>%
    filter(Covariate != "Alone at lunch") %>%
    arrange(.treatment_order, .covariate_order, .row_order) %>%
    transmute(
      Treatment,
      Covariate,
      Value,
      `N Sil. / Int.` = `N silence/range`,
      PI = fmt_num(`PI estimate`, 4),
      `Logit [SE]`,
      `Wald z` = fmt_num(`Wald z`, 4),
      Stars,
      Higher
    )
}

condition_count_pair <- function(no_info_n, part_info_n) {
  paste(no_info_n, part_info_n, sep = "/")
}

environment_social_count_pair <- function(env_no_info_n,
                                          env_part_info_n,
                                          soc_no_info_n,
                                          soc_part_info_n) {
  paste(
    condition_count_pair(env_no_info_n, env_part_info_n),
    condition_count_pair(soc_no_info_n, soc_part_info_n),
    sep = "; "
  )
}

format_cardinal_marginal_effects_for_export <- function(table_data) {
```

```{r marginal-effect-difference-figures-support, include=FALSE}
prepare_marginal_effect_difference_plot_data <- function(table_data,
                                                         estimate_column,
                                                         se_column,
                                                         p_column) {
  table_data %>%
    mutate(
      Covariate = short_covariate_label(Covariate),
      Value = clean_covariate_value(Value),
      Estimate = .data[[estimate_column]],
      SE = .data[[se_column]],
      Stars = average_regression_star_label(.data[[p_column]]),
      .row_order = row_number(),
      .covariate_order = match(Covariate, unique(Covariate))
    ) %>%
    filter(
      Covariate != "Alone at lunch",
      is.finite(Estimate),
      is.finite(SE)
    ) %>%
    arrange(.covariate_order, .row_order) %>%
    mutate(
      ymin = Estimate - SE,
      ymax = Estimate + SE,
      count_label = environment_social_count_pair(
        `Env NoInfo n`,
        `Env PartInfo n`,
        `Soc NoInfo n`,
        `Soc PartInfo n`
      ),
      x_label = paste(Value, count_label, sep = "\n"),
      plot_covariate = figure_covariate_label(Covariate),
      Covariate = factor(plot_covariate, levels = unique(plot_covariate)),
      x_label = factor(x_label, levels = unique(x_label))
    ) %>%
    select(-plot_covariate)
}

make_marginal_effect_difference_plot <- function(plot_data,
                                                 plot_title,
                                                 y_label,
                                                 point_fill) {
  if (nrow(plot_data) == 0) {
    return(
      ggplot() +
        theme_void() +
        labs(title = paste(plot_title, ": no plot data"))
    )
  }

  y_range <- range(c(plot_data$ymin, plot_data$ymax, 0), na.rm = TRUE)
  y_span <- diff(y_range)
  if (!is.finite(y_span) || y_span == 0) {
    y_span <- max(abs(y_range), 0.1)
  }

  plot_data <- plot_data %>%
    mutate(
      star_label = if_else(Stars == "", "", Stars),
      star_y = ymax + y_span * 0.045
    )

  y_limits <- c(
    min(c(plot_data$ymin, 0), na.rm = TRUE) - y_span * 0.08,
    max(c(plot_data$star_y, plot_data$ymax, 0), na.rm = TRUE) + y_span * 0.08
  )
  topic_shading <- make_topic_shading_data(plot_data)

  ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = x_label, y = Estimate)) +
    geom_rect(
      data = topic_shading,
      aes(xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = topic_fill),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      color = NA
    ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey45", linewidth = 0.35) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
      width = 0.16,
      color = "grey30",
      linewidth = 0.45
    ) +
    geom_point(
      shape = 21,
      size = 2.6,
      stroke = 0.35,
      color = "grey15",
      fill = point_fill
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = plot_data %>% filter(star_label != ""),
      aes(y = star_y, label = star_label),
      vjust = 0,
      size = 3.1,
      color = "grey10"
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(drop = TRUE) +
    scale_fill_identity() +
    facet_grid(. ~ Covariate, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = y_limits, clip = "off") +
    labs(
      title = plot_title,
      x = NULL,
      y = y_label
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 8),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey94", color = "grey75", linewidth = 0.25),
      strip.text.x = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold", lineheight = 0.92),
      panel.spacing.x = grid::unit(0.08, "lines"),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 8, 96, 8)
    )
}
```

marginal-effect tests by covariate value. Points are the estimated
difference, whiskers are one standard error, the horizontal line marks
the null hypothesis of no Social--Environmental difference, and stars
mark the corresponding two-sided tests.

These tables report the cardinal marginal information-condition effects
in the OLS regressions, split into covariates through
Education and the remaining covariates. For each covariate value $z$,
they estimate $ME_E(z)$ and $ME_S(z)$, where each marginal effect is the
Interval-minus-Silent change in renormalised precision equivalent within
the environmental or social information gap. The null hypothesis is
$H_0: ME_S(z)-ME_E(z)=0$, against a two-sided alternative. The reported
test is the HC3 robust single-restriction $t$ test from the
covariate-specific OLS model; stars mark the corresponding two-sided
p-value, and Higher reports which information gap has the larger
marginal effect.

```{r wooldridge-marginal-effects}
  ),

)
```

These tables repeat the same cardinal marginal-effect comparison, but
change the scale for the social outcome and split the covariates after
Education. Environmental rows keep renormalised precision equivalent,
while social rows use $(\log(B2)-\log(1))/(\log(1500)-\log(1))$. For
each covariate value $z$, the null hypothesis remains
$H_0: ME_S(z)-ME_E(z)=0$, with a two-sided alternative. The test is the
HC3 robust single-restriction $t$ test from the corresponding OLS
regression; stars mark the two-sided p-value, and Higher reports which
information gap has the larger marginal effect.

These tables give the ordinal version of the marginal
information-condition comparison using a PIM regression with a logit
link, again split after Education. For each information gap and
covariate value, the probability index $\theta_T(z)$ is the probability
that an Interval observation exceeds a Silent observation within the
same information gap and covariate value. The formal null is equality on
the logit scale:
$H_0: \mathrm{logit}(\theta_S(z))-\mathrm{logit}(\theta_E(z))=0$. The
reported test is a Wald $z$ test from the joint PIM regression; stars
mark the two-sided p-value, and Higher reports which information gap has
the larger probability index.

This fit table describes the OLS regressions behind the cardinal marginal-effect and positivity tables. Each row is a
separate covariate-specific regression with information gap, information
condition, the listed covariate, and all interactions among them. The
table reports sample size, the number of three-way interaction terms,
$R^2$, adjusted $R^2$, and the usual overall model $F$ statistic, which
tests all non-intercept model terms jointly against an intercept-only
model.

precision equivalent, while social rows use the renormalised log
precision equivalent scale. As above, each row is one covariate-specific
model, and the reported $F$ statistic is the usual overall test of all
non-intercept model terms against an intercept-only model.

These tables split the cardinal positivity tests by information gap,
with environmental entries first and social entries second. For each
information gap $T$ and covariate value $z$, the null hypothesis is
$H_0: ME_T(z)=0$ against the one-sided alternative $H_1: ME_T(z)>0$,
where $ME_T(z)$ is the Interval-minus-Silent effect in renormalised
precision equivalent. The test is an HC3 robust finite-sample $t$ test
from the covariate-specific OLS regression; stars mark the one-sided
p-value. The count column gives Silent/Interval cell counts.

For each covariate $Z$, the table fits the saturated OLS model

$$Y_i = \alpha + G_i + D_i + Z_i + G_iD_i + G_iZ_i + D_iZ_i
  + G_iD_iZ_i + u_i,$$

where $Y_i$ is renormalised precision equivalent, $G_i$ is information
gap, $D_i$ is the information condition, and $Z_i$ is the listed
covariate. The reported effect is

$$ME_T(z) =
  E[Y_i \mid G_i=T, D_i=\text{Interval}, Z_i=z]
  - E[Y_i \mid G_i=T, D_i=\text{Silent}, Z_i=z].$$

```{r wooldridge-marginal-positive-figures-support, include=FALSE}
prepare_wooldridge_marginal_positive_plot_data <- function(table_data,
                                                           treatment_value) {
  table_data %>%
    mutate(
      Covariate = short_covariate_label(Covariate),
      Value = clean_covariate_value(Value),
      ME = `ME (PartInfo - NoInfo)`,
      SE = `HC3 SE`,
      Stars = average_regression_star_label(`HC3 p value, ME > 0`),
      .row_order = row_number(),
      .covariate_order = match(Covariate, unique(Covariate))
    ) %>%
    filter(
      Treatment == treatment_value,
      Covariate != "Alone at lunch",
      is.finite(ME),
      is.finite(SE)
    ) %>%
    arrange(.covariate_order, .row_order) %>%
    mutate(
      x_index = row_number(),
      ymin = ME - SE,
      ymax = ME + SE,
      count_label = paste(`NoInfo n`, `PartInfo n`, sep = "/"),
      x_label = paste(Value, count_label, sep = "\n"),
      plot_covariate = figure_covariate_label(Covariate),
      Covariate = factor(plot_covariate, levels = unique(plot_covariate)),
      x_label = factor(x_label, levels = unique(x_label))
    ) %>%
    select(-plot_covariate)
}

make_wooldridge_marginal_positive_plot <- function(table_data,
                                                   treatment_value) {
  plot_data <- prepare_wooldridge_marginal_positive_plot_data(
    table_data,
    treatment_value
  )

  if (nrow(plot_data) == 0) {
    return(
      ggplot() +
        theme_void() +
        labs(title = paste(treatment_value, "information gap: no plot data"))
    )
  }

  y_range <- range(c(plot_data$ymin, plot_data$ymax, 0), na.rm = TRUE)
  y_span <- diff(y_range)
  if (!is.finite(y_span) || y_span == 0) {
    y_span <- max(abs(y_range), 0.1)
  }

  plot_data <- plot_data %>%
    mutate(
      star_label = if_else(Stars == "", "", Stars),
      star_y = ymax + y_span * 0.045
    )

  y_limits <- c(
    min(c(plot_data$ymin, 0), na.rm = TRUE) - y_span * 0.08,
    max(c(plot_data$star_y, plot_data$ymax, 0), na.rm = TRUE) + y_span * 0.08
  )
  point_fill <- c(Environmental = "#009b44", Social = "#c7a000")[[treatment_value]]
  topic_shading <- make_topic_shading_data(plot_data)

  ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = x_label, y = ME)) +
    geom_rect(
      data = topic_shading,
      aes(xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = topic_fill),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      color = NA
    ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey45", linewidth = 0.35) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
      width = 0.16,
      color = "grey30",
      linewidth = 0.45
    ) +
    geom_point(
      shape = 21,
      size = 2.6,
      stroke = 0.35,
      color = "grey15",
      fill = point_fill
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = plot_data %>% filter(star_label != ""),
      aes(y = star_y, label = star_label),
      vjust = 0,
      size = 3.1,
      color = "grey10"
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(drop = TRUE) +
    scale_fill_identity() +
    facet_grid(. ~ Covariate, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = y_limits, clip = "off") +
    labs(
      title = paste(treatment_value, "information gap: marginal positivity tests"),
      x = NULL,
      y = "ME (Interval - Silent)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 8),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey94", color = "grey75", linewidth = 0.25),
      strip.text.x = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold", lineheight = 0.92),
      panel.spacing.x = grid::unit(0.08, "lines"),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 8, 96, 8)
    )
}
```

These tables repeat the cardinal positivity tests on the log-transform
scale: environmental effects are still on renormalised precision
equivalent, while social effects use renormalised log precision
equivalent. For each information gap $T$ and covariate value $z$, the
null hypothesis is $H_0: ME_T(z)=0$ against $H_1: ME_T(z)>0$. The
reported statistic is the HC3 robust finite-sample $t$ test from the
covariate-specific OLS regression, and stars mark the one-sided p-value.

For each covariate $Z$, the same saturated OLS specification is fitted:

$$Y_i^{*} = \alpha + G_i + D_i + Z_i + G_iD_i + G_iZ_i + D_iZ_i
  + G_iD_iZ_i + u_i.$$

Here $Y_i^{*}$ is renormalised precision equivalent for environmental
rows and renormalised log precision equivalent for social rows. The
reported effect is the Interval-minus-Silent contrast $ME_T(z)$ within
information gap $T$ and covariate value $z$.

```{r wooldridge-log-social-marginal-positive-tests}
write_split_positive_test_tables(
  format_cardinal_positive_tests_for_export(
    wooldridge_log_social_marginal_positive_tests
  ),
  table_id = "average_b2_renormalised_log_social_wooldridge_marginal_positive_tests",
  caption_template = function(treatment_name) {
    scale_note <- if (treatment_name == "Environmental") {
      "The dependent variable is renormalised average B2."
    } else {
      paste(
        "The dependent variable is renormalised log average B2,",
        "$(\\log(B2) - \\log(1))/(\\log(1500) - \\log(1))$."
      )
    }

    paste(
      treatment_name,
      "cardinal positivity tests for information effects.",
      scale_note,
      "Each row tests $\\mathrm{ME}_T(z) > 0$ for one covariate value;",
      "HC3 SEs and finite-sample $t$ tests come from the covariate-specific regression.",
      positive_test_star_note
    )
  },
  column_widths = c(
    "0.14\\textwidth",
    "0.17\\textwidth",
    "0.10\\textwidth",
    "0.18\\textwidth",
    "0.075\\textwidth",
    "0.05\\textwidth",
    "0.055\\textwidth",
    "0.07\\textwidth"
  )
)
```

These tables give the ordinal positivity tests using PIM regressions
with logit links, again split by information gap. For each information
gap $T$ and covariate value $z$, the probability index $\theta_T(z)$ is
the probability that an Interval observation exceeds a Silent
observation within that information gap and covariate value. The null
hypothesis is $H_0: \theta_T(z)=0.5$, equivalently a zero logit
coefficient, against the one-sided alternative $H_1: \theta_T(z)>0.5$.
The reported statistic is a Wald $z$ test from the PIM regression, and
stars mark the one-sided p-value.

For each covariate $Z$, the PIM compares Silent/Interval pairs within
the same information gap and covariate value and fits

$$\operatorname{logit}\{\theta_T(z)\} =
  \alpha_{Tz}, \qquad
\theta_T(z) =
  P(Y_{\text{Interval}} > Y_{\text{Silent}}
    \mid G=T, Z=z).$$

Thus each table row reports the estimated probability that an Interval
observation exceeds a Silent observation in the same information gap and
covariate cell.

```{r pim-logit-marginal-positive-tests}
write_split_positive_test_tables(
  format_pim_positive_tests_for_export(pim_logit_marginal_positive_tests),
  table_id = "average_b2_ordinal_marginal_positive_tests",
  caption_template = function(treatment_name) {
    paste(
      treatment_name,
      ": PIM-logit ordinal tests for effects of information-gap format.",
      "Each row tests whether $\\theta_T(z) > 0.5$ using Silent-Interval",
      "pairs within the same covariate value.",
      positive_test_star_note
    )
  },
  column_widths = c(
    "0.14\\textwidth",
    "0.16\\textwidth",
    "0.10\\textwidth",
    "0.08\\textwidth",
    "0.20\\textwidth",
    "0.075\\textwidth",
    "0.055\\textwidth",
    "0.07\\textwidth"
  )
)
```

```{r pim-logit-marginal-positive-figures-support, include=FALSE}
prepare_pim_logit_marginal_positive_plot_data <- function(table_data,
                                                          treatment_value) {
  table_data %>%
    mutate(
      Covariate = short_covariate_label(Covariate),
      Value = clean_covariate_value(Value),
      ME = `Index minus 0.5`,
      SE = `PI estimate` * (1 - `PI estimate`) * `Logit SE`,
      Stars = average_regression_star_label(`p value, index > 0.5`),
      .row_order = row_number(),
      .covariate_order = match(Covariate, unique(Covariate))
    ) %>%
    filter(
      Treatment == treatment_value,
      Covariate != "Alone at lunch",
      is.finite(ME),
      is.finite(SE)
    ) %>%
    arrange(.covariate_order, .row_order) %>%
    mutate(
      x_index = row_number(),
      ymin = ME - SE,
      ymax = ME + SE,
      count_label = paste(`NoInfo n`, `PartInfo n`, sep = "/"),
      x_label = paste(Value, count_label, sep = "\n"),
      plot_covariate = figure_covariate_label(Covariate),
      Covariate = factor(plot_covariate, levels = unique(plot_covariate)),
      x_label = factor(x_label, levels = unique(x_label))
    ) %>%
    select(-plot_covariate)
}

make_pim_logit_marginal_positive_plot <- function(table_data,
                                                  treatment_value) {
  plot_data <- prepare_pim_logit_marginal_positive_plot_data(
    table_data,
    treatment_value
  )

  if (nrow(plot_data) == 0) {
    return(
      ggplot() +
        theme_void() +
        labs(title = paste(treatment_value, "information gap: no PIM plot data"))
    )
  }

  y_range <- range(c(plot_data$ymin, plot_data$ymax, 0), na.rm = TRUE)
  y_span <- diff(y_range)
  if (!is.finite(y_span) || y_span == 0) {
    y_span <- max(abs(y_range), 0.1)
  }

  plot_data <- plot_data %>%
    mutate(
      star_label = if_else(Stars == "", "", Stars),
      star_y = ymax + y_span * 0.045
    )

  y_limits <- c(
    min(c(plot_data$ymin, 0), na.rm = TRUE) - y_span * 0.08,
    max(c(plot_data$star_y, plot_data$ymax, 0), na.rm = TRUE) + y_span * 0.08
  )
  point_fill <- c(Environmental = "#009b44", Social = "#c7a000")[[treatment_value]]
  topic_shading <- make_topic_shading_data(plot_data)

  ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = x_label, y = ME)) +
    geom_rect(
      data = topic_shading,
      aes(xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = topic_fill),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      color = NA
    ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey45", linewidth = 0.35) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
      width = 0.16,
      color = "grey30",
      linewidth = 0.45
    ) +
    geom_point(
      shape = 21,
      size = 2.6,
      stroke = 0.35,
      color = "grey15",
      fill = point_fill
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = plot_data %>% filter(star_label != ""),
      aes(y = star_y, label = star_label),
      vjust = 0,
      size = 3.1,
      color = "grey10"
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(drop = TRUE) +
    scale_fill_identity() +
    facet_grid(. ~ Covariate, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = y_limits, clip = "off") +
    labs(
      title = paste(treatment_value, "information gap: PIM positivity tests"),
      x = NULL,
      y = "PI - 0.5 (Interval over Silent)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 8),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey94", color = "grey75", linewidth = 0.25),
      strip.text.x = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold", lineheight = 0.92),
      panel.spacing.x = grid::unit(0.08, "lines"),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 8, 96, 8)
    )
}
```

## Halo effects

These figures and tests ask whether precision equivalents differ across
the observed high, medium, and low dimensions. The repeated-measures
tests use all three precision equivalent values for each participant.
The first-task tests keep only the B2 task that each participant
completed first, so observed dimension is compared between subjects
rather than within subjects.

```{r halo-effects-support, include=FALSE}
halo_dimension_levels <- c("High", "Medium", "Low")
b2_order_levels <- c("First task done", "Second task done", "Third task done")

overall_desc <- summary_se(data_rq2)

get_b2_order_position <- function(order_value, obs_level_value) {
  order_levels <- str_extract_all(as.character(order_value), "H|M|L")[[1]]
  position <- match(as.character(obs_level_value), order_levels)

  if (length(position) == 0 || is.na(position)) {
    return(NA_integer_)
  }

  as.integer(position)
}

b2_order_data <- data_rq2 %>%
  mutate(
    order_position = map2_int(
      order_B2,
      as.character(obs_level),
      get_b2_order_position
    ),
    b2_order_step = case_when(
      order_position == 1 ~ "First task done",
      order_position == 2 ~ "Second task done",
      order_position == 3 ~ "Third task done",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    b2_order_step = factor(b2_order_step, levels = b2_order_levels)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(b2_order_step))

halo_test_star_label <- average_regression_star_label

format_halo_condition_label <- function(condition_value) {
  recode(
    as.character(condition_value),
    NoInfo = "Silent",
    PartInfo = "Interval"
  )
}

count_dimension_level <- function(counts, level_value) {
  value <- counts %>%
    filter(as.character(observed_dimension) == level_value) %>%
    pull(n)

  if (length(value) == 0) {
    return(0L)
  }

  value[[1]]
}

build_dimension_count_cols <- function(model_data) {
  counts <- model_data %>%
    count(observed_dimension, name = "n")

  tibble(
    `High n` = count_dimension_level(counts, "High"),
    `Medium n` = count_dimension_level(counts, "Medium"),
    `Low n` = count_dimension_level(counts, "Low")
  )
}

empty_halo_omnibus_stats <- function(statistic_type) {
  tibble(
    `Numerator df` = NA_real_,
    `Denominator df` = NA_real_,
    `Statistic type` = statistic_type,
    Statistic = NA_real_,
    `p value` = NA_real_
  )
}

aggregate_halo_test_data <- data_rq2 %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(id),
    !is.na(Treatment),
    !is.na(Condition),
    !is.na(obs_level),
    !is.na(inferred_attribute)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = treatment_levels),
    Condition = factor(Condition, levels = condition_levels),
    observed_dimension = factor(
      as.character(obs_level),
      levels = c("H", "M", "L"),
      labels = halo_dimension_levels
    ),
    id = factor(id)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Treatment), !is.na(Condition), !is.na(observed_dimension)) %>%
  distinct(id, Treatment, Condition, observed_dimension, .keep_all = TRUE)

aggregate_halo_complete_data <- aggregate_halo_test_data %>%
  group_by(Treatment, Condition, id) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(observed_dimension) == length(halo_dimension_levels)) %>%
  ungroup()

aggregate_halo_nonboundary_complete_data <- aggregate_halo_complete_data %>%
  group_by(Treatment, Condition, id) %>%
  mutate(
    treatment_minimum = case_when(
      Treatment == "Environmental" ~ 1.5,
      Treatment == "Social" ~ 5,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    treatment_maximum = case_when(
      Treatment == "Environmental" ~ 11.5,
      Treatment == "Social" ~ 1500,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    all_values_at_minimum = all(near(inferred_attribute, treatment_minimum)),
    all_values_at_maximum = all(near(inferred_attribute, treatment_maximum)),
    boundary_subject = all_values_at_minimum | all_values_at_maximum
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!boundary_subject) %>%
  select(
    -treatment_minimum,
    -treatment_maximum,
    -all_values_at_minimum,
    -all_values_at_maximum,
    -boundary_subject
  )

run_repeated_halo_anova <- function(data, treatment_value, condition_value) {
  model_data <- data %>%
    filter(Treatment == treatment_value, Condition == condition_value) %>%
    mutate(
      observed_dimension = fct_drop(observed_dimension),
      id = fct_drop(id)
    )

  counts <- build_dimension_count_cols(model_data)

  stats <- tryCatch(
    {
      model <- aov(
        inferred_attribute ~ observed_dimension + Error(id / observed_dimension),
        data = model_data
      )

      summary_list <- summary(model)
      within_name <- names(summary_list)[
        str_detect(names(summary_list), "observed_dimension")
      ][1]
      anova_tbl <- summary_list[[within_name]][[1]] %>%
        as.data.frame() %>%
        rownames_to_column("Term") %>%
        mutate(Term = str_trim(Term))

      effect_row <- anova_tbl %>% filter(Term == "observed_dimension")
      residual_row <- anova_tbl %>% filter(Term == "Residuals")

      tibble(
        `Numerator df` = effect_row$Df[[1]],
        `Denominator df` = residual_row$Df[[1]],
        `Statistic type` = "F",
        Statistic = effect_row[["F value"]][[1]],
        `p value` = effect_row[["Pr(>F)"]][[1]]
      )
    },
    error = function(e) empty_halo_omnibus_stats("F")
  )

  bind_cols(
    tibble(
      Treatment = as.character(treatment_value),
      Condition = format_halo_condition_label(condition_value),
      Test = "Repeated-measures ANOVA",
      Effect = "Observed dimension",
      Participants = n_distinct(model_data$id),
      Observations = nrow(model_data)
    ),
    counts,
    stats
  )
}

run_repeated_halo_friedman <- function(data, treatment_value, condition_value) {
  model_data <- data %>%
    filter(Treatment == treatment_value, Condition == condition_value) %>%
    mutate(
      observed_dimension = fct_drop(observed_dimension),
      id = fct_drop(id)
    )

  counts <- build_dimension_count_cols(model_data)

  test_result <- tryCatch(
    friedman.test(inferred_attribute ~ observed_dimension | id, data = model_data),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  stats <- if (is.null(test_result)) {
    empty_halo_omnibus_stats("chi-squared")
  } else {
    tibble(
      `Numerator df` = unname(test_result$parameter),
      `Denominator df` = NA_real_,
      `Statistic type` = "chi-squared",
      Statistic = unname(test_result$statistic),
      `p value` = unname(test_result$p.value)
    )
  }

  bind_cols(
    tibble(
      Treatment = as.character(treatment_value),
      Condition = format_halo_condition_label(condition_value),
      Test = "Friedman test",
      Effect = "Observed dimension",
      Participants = n_distinct(model_data$id),
      Observations = nrow(model_data)
    ),
    counts,
    stats
  )
}

b2_aggregate_halo_within_subject_tests <- expand_grid(
  Treatment = treatment_levels,
  Condition = condition_levels
) %>%
  pmap_dfr(
    function(Treatment, Condition) {
      bind_rows(
        run_repeated_halo_anova(
          aggregate_halo_complete_data,
          Treatment,
          Condition
        ),
        run_repeated_halo_friedman(
          aggregate_halo_complete_data,
          Treatment,
          Condition
        )
      )
    }
  )

b2_aggregate_halo_nonboundary_within_subject_tests <- expand_grid(
  Treatment = treatment_levels,
  Condition = condition_levels
) %>%
  pmap_dfr(
    function(Treatment, Condition) {
      bind_rows(
        run_repeated_halo_anova(
          aggregate_halo_nonboundary_complete_data,
          Treatment,
          Condition
        ),
        run_repeated_halo_friedman(
          aggregate_halo_nonboundary_complete_data,
          Treatment,
          Condition
        )
      )
    }
  )

first_b2_halo_test_data <- b2_order_data %>%
  filter(
    order_position == 1,
    !is.na(id),
    !is.na(Treatment),
    !is.na(Condition),
    !is.na(obs_level),
    !is.na(inferred_attribute)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = treatment_levels),
    Condition = factor(Condition, levels = condition_levels),
    observed_dimension = factor(
      as.character(obs_level),
      levels = c("H", "M", "L"),
      labels = halo_dimension_levels
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Treatment), !is.na(Condition), !is.na(observed_dimension)) %>%
  distinct(id, Treatment, Condition, .keep_all = TRUE)

run_levene_test <- function(model_data) {
  model_data <- model_data %>%
    filter(!is.na(inferred_attribute), !is.na(observed_dimension)) %>%
    mutate(observed_dimension = fct_drop(observed_dimension))

  if (n_distinct(model_data$observed_dimension) < 2) {
    return(empty_halo_omnibus_stats("F"))
  }

  tryCatch(
    {
      levene_data <- model_data %>%
        group_by(observed_dimension) %>%
        mutate(
          group_center = median(inferred_attribute, na.rm = TRUE),
          absolute_deviation = abs(inferred_attribute - group_center)
        ) %>%
        ungroup()

      levene_model <- lm(absolute_deviation ~ observed_dimension, data = levene_data)
      levene_table <- anova(levene_model) %>%
        as.data.frame() %>%
        rownames_to_column("Term") %>%
        mutate(Term = str_trim(Term))

      effect_row <- levene_table %>% filter(Term == "observed_dimension")
      residual_row <- levene_table %>% filter(Term == "Residuals")

      tibble(
        `Numerator df` = effect_row$Df[[1]],
        `Denominator df` = residual_row$Df[[1]],
        `Statistic type` = "F",
        Statistic = effect_row[["F value"]][[1]],
        `p value` = effect_row[["Pr(>F)"]][[1]]
      )
    },
    error = function(e) empty_halo_omnibus_stats("F")
  )
}

extract_one_way_anova_stats <- function(model_data) {
  tryCatch(
    {
      model <- lm(inferred_attribute ~ observed_dimension, data = model_data)
      anova_tbl <- anova(model) %>%
        as.data.frame() %>%
        rownames_to_column("Term") %>%
        mutate(Term = str_trim(Term))

      effect_row <- anova_tbl %>% filter(Term == "observed_dimension")
      residual_row <- anova_tbl %>% filter(Term == "Residuals")

      tibble(
        `Numerator df` = effect_row$Df[[1]],
        `Denominator df` = residual_row$Df[[1]],
        `Statistic type` = "F",
        Statistic = effect_row[["F value"]][[1]],
        `p value` = effect_row[["Pr(>F)"]][[1]]
      )
    },
    error = function(e) empty_halo_omnibus_stats("F")
  )
}

extract_welch_anova_stats <- function(model_data) {
  test_result <- tryCatch(
    oneway.test(
      inferred_attribute ~ observed_dimension,
      data = model_data,
      var.equal = FALSE
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(test_result)) {
    return(empty_halo_omnibus_stats("F"))
  }

  tibble(
    `Numerator df` = unname(test_result$parameter[[1]]),
    `Denominator df` = unname(test_result$parameter[[2]]),
    `Statistic type` = "F",
    Statistic = unname(test_result$statistic),
    `p value` = unname(test_result$p.value)
  )
}

run_first_b2_dimension_test <- function(data, treatment_value, condition_value) {
  model_data <- data %>%
    filter(Treatment == treatment_value, Condition == condition_value) %>%
    mutate(observed_dimension = fct_drop(observed_dimension))

  counts <- build_dimension_count_cols(model_data)
  levene_stats <- run_levene_test(model_data)
  variance_homogeneous <- isTRUE(levene_stats$`p value`[[1]] >= 0.05)
  selected_stats <- if (variance_homogeneous) {
    extract_one_way_anova_stats(model_data)
  } else {
    extract_welch_anova_stats(model_data)
  }

  bind_cols(
    tibble(
      Treatment = as.character(treatment_value),
      Condition = format_halo_condition_label(condition_value),
      Test = if_else(variance_homogeneous, "One-way ANOVA", "Welch ANOVA"),
      Effect = "First B2 observed dimension",
      Participants = n_distinct(model_data$id),
      Observations = nrow(model_data),
      `Variance decision` = if_else(
        variance_homogeneous,
        "homogeneous",
        "unequal"
      ),
      `Levene F` = levene_stats$Statistic[[1]],
      `Levene numerator df` = levene_stats$`Numerator df`[[1]],
      `Levene denominator df` = levene_stats$`Denominator df`[[1]],
      `Levene p value` = levene_stats$`p value`[[1]]
    ),
    counts,
    selected_stats
  )
}

b2_first_task_dimension_tests <- expand_grid(
  Treatment = treatment_levels,
  Condition = condition_levels
) %>%
  pmap_dfr(
    function(Treatment, Condition) {
      run_first_b2_dimension_test(first_b2_halo_test_data, Treatment, Condition)
    }
  )

fmt_halo_df <- function(numerator_df, denominator_df) {
  case_when(
    is.na(numerator_df) ~ "",
    is.na(denominator_df) ~ fmt_num(numerator_df, 0),
    abs(denominator_df - round(denominator_df)) < sqrt(.Machine$double.eps) ~
      paste(fmt_num(numerator_df, 0), fmt_num(denominator_df, 0), sep = ", "),
    TRUE ~ paste(fmt_num(numerator_df, 0), fmt_num(denominator_df, 1), sep = ", ")
  )
}

fmt_halo_stat <- function(statistic_type, statistic) {
  case_when(
    is.na(statistic) ~ "",
    statistic_type == "chi-squared" ~ paste0("$\\chi^2$=", fmt_num(statistic, 3)),
    TRUE ~ paste0(statistic_type, "=", fmt_num(statistic, 3))
  )
}

format_halo_aggregate_tests_for_export <- function(table_data,
                                                   include_dimension_counts = TRUE,
                                                   include_p_values = FALSE) {
  formatted_table <- table_data %>%
    mutate(
      .treatment_order = match(Treatment, treatment_levels),
      .condition_order = match(Condition, c("Silent", "Interval")),
      .test_order = match(Test, c("Repeated-measures ANOVA", "Friedman test")),
      `N H/M/L` = paste(`High n`, `Medium n`, `Low n`, sep = "/"),
      Test = recode(
        Test,
        "Repeated-measures ANOVA" = "RM ANOVA",
        "Friedman test" = "Friedman"
      )
    ) %>%
    arrange(.treatment_order, .condition_order, .test_order) %>%
    transmute(
      `Information Gap` = Treatment,
      `Format` = Condition,
      Test,
      n = Participants,
      `N H/M/L`,
      df = fmt_halo_df(`Numerator df`, `Denominator df`),
      Statistic = fmt_halo_stat(`Statistic type`, Statistic),
      `p-value` = fmt_p(`p value`)
    )

  if (!include_dimension_counts) {
    formatted_table <- formatted_table %>%
      select(-`N H/M/L`)
  }

  if (!include_p_values) {
    formatted_table <- formatted_table %>%
      select(-`p-value`)
  }

  formatted_table
}

format_first_task_dimension_tests_for_export <- function(table_data) {
  table_data %>%
    mutate(
      .treatment_order = match(Treatment, treatment_levels),
      .condition_order = match(Condition, c("Silent", "Interval")),
      `N H/M/L` = paste(`High n`, `Medium n`, `Low n`, sep = "/"),
      `Levene df` = fmt_halo_df(`Levene numerator df`, `Levene denominator df`)
    ) %>%
    arrange(.treatment_order, .condition_order) %>%
    transmute(
      `Imprecise` = recode(Treatment, Environmental = "Env.", Social = "Social"),
      `Format` = Condition,
      n = Participants,
      `N H/M/L`,
      `Levene F` = fmt_num(`Levene F`, 3),
      `Levene df`,
      `Levene p` = fmt_p(`Levene p value`),
      Test = recode(Test, "One-way ANOVA" = "one-way", "Welch ANOVA" = "Welch"),
      df = fmt_halo_df(`Numerator df`, `Denominator df`),
      F = fmt_num(Statistic, 3),
      `p-value` = fmt_p(`p value`)
    )
}

make_halo_dual_axis_plot <- function(desc_data) {
  environmental_settings <- outcome_settings$Environmental
  social_settings <- outcome_settings$Social

  social_to_environmental <- function(value) {
    environmental_settings$limits[[1]] +
      (value - social_settings$limits[[1]]) *
      diff(environmental_settings$limits) / diff(social_settings$limits)
  }
  environmental_to_social <- function(value) {
    social_settings$limits[[1]] +
      (value - environmental_settings$limits[[1]]) *
      diff(social_settings$limits) / diff(environmental_settings$limits)
  }

  plot_data <- desc_data %>%
    mutate(
      Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = treatment_levels),
      Condition = factor(Condition, levels = condition_levels),
      Series = paste(
        as.character(Treatment),
        format_halo_condition_label(Condition)
      ),
      Series = factor(
        Series,
        levels = c(
          "Environmental Silent",
          "Environmental Interval",
          "Social Silent",
          "Social Interval"
        )
      ),
      Mean_plot = if_else(
        Treatment == "Social",
        social_to_environmental(Mean),
        Mean
      ),
      ymin_plot = if_else(
        Treatment == "Social",
        social_to_environmental(ymin),
        ymin
      ),
      ymax_plot = if_else(
        Treatment == "Social",
        social_to_environmental(ymax),
        ymax
      )
    )

  series_palette <- c(
    "Environmental Silent" = condition_palettes$Environmental[["NoInfo"]],
    "Environmental Interval" = condition_palettes$Environmental[["PartInfo"]],
    "Social Silent" = condition_palettes$Social[["NoInfo"]],
    "Social Interval" = condition_palettes$Social[["PartInfo"]]
  )

  ggplot(
    plot_data,
    aes(x = obs_level, y = Mean_plot, color = Series, group = Series)
  ) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(ymin = ymin_plot, ymax = ymax_plot),
      width = 0.1,
      linewidth = 0.7
    ) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = c(
        environmental_settings$limits[[1]],
        environmental_settings$hline,
        environmental_settings$limits[[2]]
      ),
      color = "grey35",
      linewidth = 0.35
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = environmental_settings$limits,
      breaks = environmental_settings$breaks,
      sec.axis = sec_axis(
        trans = ~ environmental_to_social(.),
        name = "Precision equivalent, CEO-median worker ratio",
        breaks = seq(0, 1500, by = 250)
      )
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = series_palette, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = obs_level_labels) +
    labs(
      title = "Halo effect by information-gap format",
      x = "Level of the precisely disclosed dimension",
      y = expression("Precision equivalent, kg of " * CO[2] * "e")
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      legend.key.width = grid::unit(0.3, "cm"),
      legend.key.height = grid::unit(0.3, "cm"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 9),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    ) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(title = NULL, nrow = 2))
}
```

```{r halo-effects-combined-figure, fig.width=6.8, fig.height=4.2}

```

The table below tests the omnibus null hypothesis that mean precision
equivalent is the same across the high, medium, and low observed
dimensions within each information gap and information condition. The
repeated-measures ANOVA is the parametric within-subject test; the
Friedman test is the rank-based within-subject analogue.

```{r halo-aggregate-anova-friedman-tests}
export_table(
  format_halo_aggregate_tests_for_export(
    b2_aggregate_halo_within_subject_tests,
    include_dimension_counts = FALSE,
    include_p_values = TRUE
  ),
  table_id = "b2_aggregate_halo_within_subject_tests",
  caption = paste(
    "Halo-effect repeated-measures ANOVA and Friedman tests.",
    "The dependent variable is the precision equivalent of the information gap in the specified dimension; the factor is precise value of the other",
    "dimension, coded as High, Medium, and Low (Table \\ref{tab:info-levels})."
  ),
  digits = 3,
  escape = FALSE,
  column_widths = c(
    "0.20\\linewidth",
    "0.10\\linewidth",
    "0.14\\linewidth",

    "0.12\\linewidth",
    "0.08\\linewidth"
  ),
  latex_float_environment = "subtable",
```
```{r halo-aggregate-anova-friedman-nonboundary-tests}
  latex_font_size = "\\scriptsize",
  latex_tabcolsep = "2pt"
)
```

For the first-task table, each respondent contributes only the B2 task
they saw first. Before choosing the omnibus test, the table applies a
median-centred Levene test for equal variances across the high, medium,
and low first-task groups. If the Levene test is not significant at 5%,
the table reports the ordinary one-way ANOVA; otherwise it reports
Welch's ANOVA.

The order-effect regressions below use all three B2 precision-equivalent
tasks for each subject. Each information-gap-condition cell is fitted
separately with the OLS model `precision equivalent ~ task * order`,
treating both task and order as categorical variables. Medium task and
first order are the reference categories. Standard errors are clustered
at the subject level, and coefficient p-values use the clustered
Satterthwaite test.

```{r halo-order-effect-regression-support, include=FALSE}
b2_order_effect_data <- b2_order_data %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(id),
    !is.na(Treatment),
    !is.na(Condition),
    !is.na(order_position),
    !is.na(obs_level),
    !is.na(inferred_attribute)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = treatment_levels),
    Condition = factor(Condition, levels = condition_levels),
    Task = factor(
      as.character(obs_level),
      levels = c("M", "L", "H"),
      labels = c("Medium", "Low", "High")
    ),
    Order = factor(
      order_position,
      levels = c(1, 2, 3),
      labels = c("First", "Second", "Third")
    ),
    id = factor(id)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Treatment), !is.na(Condition), !is.na(Task), !is.na(Order)) %>%
  distinct(id, Treatment, Condition, Task, Order, .keep_all = TRUE)

format_b2_order_effect_term <- function(term) {
  case_when(
    term == "(Intercept)" ~ "Intercept: Medium, first",
    term == "TaskLow" ~ "Task: Low vs Medium",
    term == "TaskHigh" ~ "Task: High vs Medium",
    term == "OrderSecond" ~ "Order: Second vs First",
    term == "OrderThird" ~ "Order: Third vs First",
    term == "TaskLow:OrderSecond" ~ "Low task x second order",
    term == "TaskHigh:OrderSecond" ~ "High task x second order",
    term == "TaskLow:OrderThird" ~ "Low task x third order",
    term == "TaskHigh:OrderThird" ~ "High task x third order",
    TRUE ~ term
  )
}

fit_b2_order_effect_model <- function(data, treatment_value, condition_value) {
  model_data <- data %>%
    filter(Treatment == treatment_value, Condition == condition_value) %>%
    mutate(
      Task = fct_drop(Task),
      Order = fct_drop(Order),
      id = fct_drop(id)
    )

  model <- lm(inferred_attribute ~ Task * Order, data = model_data)
  clustered_vcov <- clubSandwich::vcovCR(
    model,
    cluster = model_data$id,
    type = "CR1"
  )

  coefficient_table <- clubSandwich::coef_test(
    model,
    vcov = clustered_vcov,
    test = "Satterthwaite"
  ) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("term") %>%
    transmute(
      Term = format_b2_order_effect_term(term),
      `Estimate [SE]` = estimate_se_bracket(beta, SE, digits = 4),
      `Cluster t` = fmt_num(tstat, 3),
      df = fmt_num(df_Satt, 1),
      `p-value` = fmt_p(p_Satt)
    )

  list(
    model = model,
    model_data = model_data,
    clustered_vcov = clustered_vcov,
    coefficients = coefficient_table
  )
}

b2_order_effect_fits <- expand_grid(
  Treatment = treatment_levels,
  Condition = condition_levels
) %>%
  mutate(
    fit = map2(
      Treatment,
      Condition,
      ~ fit_b2_order_effect_model(b2_order_effect_data, .x, .y)
    )
  )

get_b2_order_effect_fit <- function(treatment_value, condition_value) {
  b2_order_effect_fits %>%
    filter(Treatment == treatment_value, Condition == condition_value) %>%
    pull(fit) %>%
    pluck(1)
}

b2_order_effect_coefficients_for_export <- function(treatment_value,
                                                    condition_value) {
  get_b2_order_effect_fit(treatment_value, condition_value)$coefficients
}

extract_b2_order_effect_fit_stats <- function(fit_object) {
  model <- fit_object$model
  model_summary <- summary(model)
  f_statistic <- model_summary$fstatistic

  tibble(
    Observations = nobs(model),
    Participants = n_distinct(fit_object$model_data$id),
    F = if (!is.null(f_statistic)) unname(f_statistic[["value"]]) else NA_real_,
    `Numerator df` =
      if (!is.null(f_statistic)) unname(f_statistic[["numdf"]]) else NA_real_,
    `Denominator df` =
      if (!is.null(f_statistic)) unname(f_statistic[["dendf"]]) else NA_real_,
    `F p value` = if (!is.null(f_statistic)) {
      pf(
        unname(f_statistic[["value"]]),
        df1 = unname(f_statistic[["numdf"]]),
        df2 = unname(f_statistic[["dendf"]]),
        lower.tail = FALSE
      )
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },
    `R-squared` = model_summary$r.squared,
    `Adjusted R-squared` = model_summary$adj.r.squared
  )
}

b2_order_effect_fit_stats <- b2_order_effect_fits %>%
  mutate(fit_stats = map(fit, extract_b2_order_effect_fit_stats)) %>%
  unnest(fit_stats) %>%
  mutate(
    Treatment = as.character(Treatment),
    Condition = format_halo_condition_label(Condition)
  )

format_b2_order_effect_fit_stats_for_export <- function(table_data) {
  table_data %>%
    mutate(
      .treatment_order = match(Treatment, treatment_levels),
      .condition_order = match(Condition, c("Silent", "Interval"))
    ) %>%
    arrange(.treatment_order, .condition_order) %>%
    transmute(
      `Imprecise` = recode(Treatment, Environmental = "Env.", Social = "Social"),
      Info = Condition,
      Obs. = Observations,
      Subjects = Participants,
      F = fmt_num(F, 3),
      df = fmt_halo_df(`Numerator df`, `Denominator df`),
      `F p-value` = fmt_p(`F p value`),
      `R-squared` = fmt_num(`R-squared`, 3),
      `Adj. R-squared` = fmt_num(`Adjusted R-squared`, 3)
    )
}
```
