The final halo-effect check classifies each subject into one of three
groups. `boundary` means the subject has zero absolute B2 halo effect
and the common precision equivalent lies at the scale minimum or
maximum. `no halo effect` means zero absolute B2 halo effect away from
those boundaries. `halo effect` means a non-zero absolute B2 halo
effect. The table gives counts by information gap and information
condition, plus the percentage with a halo effect. The chi-square test
is the omnibus test of whether the three-category distribution differs
between information conditions within the displayed information gap.

```{r halo-category-support, include=FALSE}
calculate_b2_absolute_halo_effect <- function(low_value, medium_value, high_value) {
  pmax(
    abs(high_value - medium_value),
    abs(medium_value - low_value),
    abs(high_value - low_value)
  )
}

halo_category_levels <- c("boundary", "no weak halo effect", "weak halo effect")

is_boundary_perception_value <- function(low_value,
                                         medium_value,
                                         high_value,
                                         treatment_minimum,
                                         treatment_maximum) {
  if (any(is.na(c(treatment_minimum, treatment_maximum)))) {
    return(FALSE)
  }

  values <- c(low_value, medium_value, high_value)
  any(
    near(values, treatment_minimum) | near(values, treatment_maximum),
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
}

individual_b2_halo_category_data <- dataset %>%
  mutate(
    Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = treatment_levels),
    Condition = factor(Condition, levels = condition_levels),
    wtp_B2_L = as.numeric(a_B2_L),
    wtp_B2_M = as.numeric(a_B2_M),
    wtp_B2_H = as.numeric(a_B2_H),
    absolute_halo_effect = calculate_b2_absolute_halo_effect(
      wtp_B2_L,
      wtp_B2_M,
      wtp_B2_H
    ),
    treatment_minimum = case_when(
      Treatment == "Environmental" ~ 1.5,
      Treatment == "Social" ~ 5,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    treatment_maximum = case_when(
      Treatment == "Environmental" ~ 11.5,
      Treatment == "Social" ~ 1500,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    zero_absolute_halo = near(absolute_halo_effect, 0),
    perception_at_boundary = pmap_lgl(
      list(
        wtp_B2_L,
        wtp_B2_M,
        wtp_B2_H,
        treatment_minimum,
        treatment_maximum
      ),
      is_boundary_perception_value
    ),
    halo_category = case_when(
      zero_absolute_halo & perception_at_boundary ~ "boundary",
      zero_absolute_halo & !perception_at_boundary ~ "no weak halo effect",
      !zero_absolute_halo ~ "weak halo effect",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    halo_category = factor(halo_category, levels = halo_category_levels)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(id),
    !is.na(Treatment),
    !is.na(Condition),
    !is.na(halo_category)
  )

halo_category_counts <- individual_b2_halo_category_data %>%
  count(Treatment, Condition, halo_category, name = "n") %>%
  complete(
    Treatment = factor(treatment_levels, levels = treatment_levels),
    Condition = factor(condition_levels, levels = condition_levels),
    halo_category = factor(halo_category_levels, levels = halo_category_levels),
    fill = list(n = 0)
  ) %>%
  group_by(Treatment, Condition) %>%
  mutate(Participants = sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

run_halo_category_chisq_test <- function(data, treatment_value) {
  count_data <- data %>%
    filter(Treatment == treatment_value) %>%
    count(Condition, halo_category, name = "n") %>%
    complete(
      Condition = factor(condition_levels, levels = condition_levels),
      halo_category = factor(halo_category_levels, levels = halo_category_levels),
      fill = list(n = 0)
    ) %>%
    arrange(Condition, halo_category)

  contingency_table <- xtabs(n ~ Condition + halo_category, data = count_data)
  chisq_result <- tryCatch(
    chisq.test(contingency_table, correct = FALSE),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  tibble(
    Treatment = as.character(treatment_value),
    `Chi-square` = if (!is.null(chisq_result)) {
      unname(chisq_result$statistic)
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },
    df = if (!is.null(chisq_result)) {
      unname(chisq_result$parameter)
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },
    `p value` = if (!is.null(chisq_result)) {
      unname(chisq_result$p.value)
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }
  )
}

halo_category_chisq_tests <- map_dfr(
  treatment_levels,
  ~ run_halo_category_chisq_test(individual_b2_halo_category_data, .x)
)

run_halo_category_condition_pairwise_tests <- function(data, treatment_value) {
  count_data <- data %>%
    filter(Treatment == treatment_value) %>%
    count(Condition, halo_category, name = "n") %>%
    complete(
      Condition = factor(condition_levels, levels = condition_levels),
      halo_category = factor(halo_category_levels, levels = halo_category_levels),
      fill = list(n = 0)
    )

  map_dfr(halo_category_levels, function(category_value) {
    condition_counts <- count_data %>%
      group_by(Condition) %>%
      summarise(
        category_n = sum(n[halo_category == category_value]),
        total_n = sum(n),
        other_n = total_n - category_n,
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      complete(
        Condition = factor(condition_levels, levels = condition_levels),
        fill = list(category_n = 0, total_n = 0, other_n = 0)
      ) %>%
      arrange(Condition)

    contingency_table <- matrix(
      c(condition_counts$category_n, condition_counts$other_n),
      nrow = length(condition_levels),
      byrow = FALSE,
      dimnames = list(
        Condition = condition_levels,
        Outcome = c(category_value, "other")
      )
    )

    chisq_result <- tryCatch(
      chisq.test(contingency_table, correct = FALSE),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )

    tibble(
      Treatment = as.character(treatment_value),
      Category = category_value,
      `Chi-square` = if (!is.null(chisq_result)) {
        unname(chisq_result$statistic)
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },
      df = if (!is.null(chisq_result)) {
        unname(chisq_result$parameter)
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },
      `p value` = if (!is.null(chisq_result)) {
        unname(chisq_result$p.value)
      } else {
        NA_real_
      }
    )
  })
}

halo_category_condition_pairwise_tests <- map_dfr(
  treatment_levels,
  ~ run_halo_category_condition_pairwise_tests(
    individual_b2_halo_category_data,
    .x
  )
) %>%
  group_by(Treatment) %>%
  mutate(
    `Bonferroni p value` = p.adjust(`p value`, method = "bonferroni"),
    Stars = halo_test_star_label(`Bonferroni p value`),
    `Plot label` = if_else(Stars == "", "n.s.", Stars)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

halo_category_plot_counts <- halo_category_counts %>%
  mutate(
    Treatment = as.character(Treatment),

halo_category_bracket_data <- halo_category_condition_pairwise_tests %>%
  left_join(
    halo_category_plot_counts %>%
      mutate(Category = as.character(Category)) %>%
      group_by(Treatment, Category) %>%
      summarise(max_count = max(n), .groups = "drop"),
    by = c("Treatment", "Category")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    halo_category_plot_counts %>%
      group_by(Treatment) %>%
      summarise(treatment_max = max(n), .groups = "drop"),
    by = "Treatment"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    category_index = match(Category, halo_category_levels),
    bracket_offset = pmax(treatment_max * 0.10, 4),
    bracket_tip = pmax(treatment_max * 0.03, 1),
    x_start = category_index - 0.22,
    x_end = category_index + 0.22,
    y = max_count + bracket_offset,
    y_tip = y - bracket_tip,
    label_y = y + pmax(bracket_tip * 0.8, 2)
  )

make_halo_category_count_plot <- function(treatment_value) {
  plot_counts <- halo_category_plot_counts %>%
    filter(Treatment == treatment_value)
  bracket_data <- halo_category_bracket_data %>%
    filter(Treatment == treatment_value)

  ggplot(
    plot_counts,
    aes(
      x = category_index,
      y = n,
      fill = Condition,
      group = Condition
    )
  ) +
    geom_col(
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.72),
      width = 0.62,
      color = "grey25",
      linewidth = 0.2
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = n),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.72),
      vjust = -0.25,
      size = 3,
      color = "grey20"
    ) +
    geom_segment(
      data = bracket_data,
      aes(x = x_start, xend = x_end, y = y, yend = y),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      linewidth = 0.35
    ) +
    geom_segment(
      data = bracket_data,
      aes(x = x_start, xend = x_start, y = y, yend = y_tip),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      linewidth = 0.35
    ) +
    geom_segment(
      data = bracket_data,
      aes(x = x_end, xend = x_end, y = y, yend = y_tip),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      linewidth = 0.35
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = bracket_data,
      aes(x = category_index, y = label_y, label = `Plot label`),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 3,
      color = "grey15"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq_along(halo_category_levels),
      labels = c("boundary", "no halo\neffect", "halo\neffect")
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = condition_palettes[[treatment_value]],

      labels = average_b2_condition_labels,
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.18))
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    labs(
      title = paste(treatment_value, "halo effect category counts"),
      x = NULL,
      y = "Subjects",

    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(5.5, 5.5, 24, 5.5)
    )
}
```

The two plots below show the same three halo-effect categories as counts
within each information condition. Brackets compare silent with interval
within each category using chi-square tests for that category versus the
other two categories combined. Stars use Bonferroni-adjusted p-values
across the three category comparisons within each information gap:
$^{*}p < 0.05$, $^{**}p < 0.01$, $^{***}p < 0.001$.

```{r halo-category-bars-environmental, fig.width=6.2, fig.height=4.2}
make_halo_category_count_plot("Environmental")
```

```{r halo-category-bars-social, fig.width=6.2, fig.height=4.2}
make_halo_category_count_plot("Social")
```

The following tests restrict the sample to non-boundary subjects: those
in the `no halo effect` category away from the scale bounds, and those
in the `halo effect` category. The first table tests whether individual
B2 halo monotonicity is balanced around zero within each information gap
and information condition. Kendall tau-b is computed from the ordered
low, medium, and high precision equivalents; subjects with no halo
effect have tau-b set to zero. The binomial count test uses the positive
and negative tau-b counts and tests the null hypothesis that the two
signs are equally likely. Zero tau-b cases are reported but not included
in the binomial denominator.

```{r halo-nonboundary-individual-tests-support, include=FALSE}
calculate_b2_halo_tau_b <- function(low_value, medium_value, high_value) {
  values <- c(low_value, medium_value, high_value)

  if (any(is.na(values))) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  value_diffs <- c(
    medium_value - low_value,
    high_value - low_value,
    high_value - medium_value
  )

  concordant <- sum(value_diffs > 0)
  discordant <- sum(value_diffs < 0)
  ties_y <- sum(value_diffs == 0)

  if (ties_y == 3) {
    return(0)
  }

  denominator <- sqrt(3 * (3 - ties_y))

  if (denominator == 0) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  (concordant - discordant) / denominator
}

tau_zero_tolerance <- sqrt(.Machine$double.eps)

individual_b2_nonboundary_halo_test_data <-
  individual_b2_halo_category_data %>%
  filter(halo_category != "boundary") %>%
  mutate(
    halo_monotonicity = pmap_dbl(
      list(wtp_B2_L, wtp_B2_M, wtp_B2_H),
      calculate_b2_halo_tau_b
    ),
    halo_monotonicity = if_else(
      zero_absolute_halo,
      0,
      halo_monotonicity
    ),
    tau_sign = case_when(
      halo_monotonicity > tau_zero_tolerance ~ "positive",
      halo_monotonicity < -tau_zero_tolerance ~ "negative",
      TRUE ~ "zero"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(halo_monotonicity))

run_halo_tau_count_test <- function(data, treatment_value, condition_value) {
  model_data <- data %>%
    filter(Treatment == treatment_value, Condition == condition_value)

  positive_n <- sum(model_data$tau_sign == "positive")
  negative_n <- sum(model_data$tau_sign == "negative")
  zero_n <- sum(model_data$tau_sign == "zero")
  signed_n <- positive_n + negative_n

  test_result <- tryCatch(
    {
      if (signed_n == 0) {
        NULL
      } else {
        binom.test(
          positive_n,
          signed_n,
          p = 0.5,
          alternative = "two.sided"
        )
      }
    },
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  tibble(
    Treatment = as.character(treatment_value),
    Condition = format_halo_condition_label(condition_value),
    Participants = n_distinct(model_data$id),
    `Tau > 0` = positive_n,
    `Tau = 0` = zero_n,
    `Tau < 0` = negative_n,
    `Signed n` = signed_n,
    `Mean tau-b` = mean(model_data$halo_monotonicity, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Median tau-b` = median(model_data$halo_monotonicity, na.rm = TRUE),
    `p value` = if (!is.null(test_result)) {
      unname(test_result$p.value)
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }
  )
}

) %>%

run_halo_tau_gof_test <- function(negative_n, zero_n, positive_n) {
  observed_counts <- c(negative_n, zero_n, positive_n)

  test_result <- tryCatch(
    {
      if (sum(observed_counts) == 0) {
        NULL
      } else {
        suppressWarnings(chisq.test(observed_counts, p = rep(1 / 3, 3)))
      }
    },
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  tibble(
    `Chi-square` = if (!is.null(test_result)) {
      unname(test_result$statistic)
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },
    df = if (!is.null(test_result)) {
      unname(test_result$parameter)
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },
    `p value` = if (!is.null(test_result)) {
      unname(test_result$p.value)
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }
  )
}

run_two_group_levene_test <- function(model_data,
                                      outcome_var,
                                      group_var = "Condition") {
  model_data <- model_data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[outcome_var]]), !is.na(.data[[group_var]])) %>%
    mutate("{group_var}" := fct_drop(.data[[group_var]]))

  if (n_distinct(model_data[[group_var]]) < 2) {
    return(empty_halo_omnibus_stats("F"))
  }

  tryCatch(
    {
      levene_data <- model_data %>%
        group_by(.data[[group_var]]) %>%
        mutate(
          group_center = median(.data[[outcome_var]], na.rm = TRUE),
          absolute_deviation = abs(.data[[outcome_var]] - group_center)
        ) %>%
        ungroup()

      levene_model <- lm(
        reformulate(group_var, response = "absolute_deviation"),
        data = levene_data
      )
      levene_table <- anova(levene_model) %>%
        as.data.frame() %>%
        rownames_to_column("Term") %>%
        mutate(Term = str_trim(Term))

      effect_row <- levene_table %>% filter(Term == group_var)
      residual_row <- levene_table %>% filter(Term == "Residuals")

      tibble(
        `Numerator df` = effect_row$Df[[1]],
        `Denominator df` = residual_row$Df[[1]],
        `Statistic type` = "F",
        Statistic = effect_row[["F value"]][[1]],
        `p value` = effect_row[["Pr(>F)"]][[1]]
      )
    },
    error = function(e) empty_halo_omnibus_stats("F")
  )
}

empty_absolute_condition_test_stats <- function(test_label, statistic_type) {
  tibble(
    Test = test_label,
    `Statistic type` = statistic_type,
    Statistic = NA_real_,
    df = NA_real_,
    `p value` = NA_real_
  )
}

run_nonboundary_absolute_condition_test <- function(data, treatment_value) {
  model_data <- data %>%
    filter(Treatment == treatment_value) %>%
    mutate(Condition = fct_drop(Condition))

  no_info_values <- model_data %>%
    filter(Condition == "NoInfo") %>%
    pull(absolute_halo_effect)
  part_info_values <- model_data %>%
    filter(Condition == "PartInfo") %>%
    pull(absolute_halo_effect)

  levene_stats <- run_two_group_levene_test(
    model_data,
    outcome_var = "absolute_halo_effect",
    group_var = "Condition"
  )
  levene_p <- levene_stats$`p value`[[1]]
  use_welch <- is.na(levene_p) || levene_p >= 0.05

  selected_stats <- if (use_welch) {
    tryCatch(
      {
        test_result <- t.test(
          absolute_halo_effect ~ Condition,
          data = model_data,
          var.equal = FALSE
        )

        tibble(
          Test = "Welch t-test",
          `Statistic type` = "t",
          Statistic = unname(test_result$statistic),
          df = unname(test_result$parameter),
          `p value` = unname(test_result$p.value)
        )
      },
      error = function(e) empty_absolute_condition_test_stats("Welch t-test", "t")
    )
  } else {
    tryCatch(
      {
        test_result <- wilcox.test(
          absolute_halo_effect ~ Condition,
          data = model_data,
          exact = FALSE,
          correct = TRUE
        )

        tibble(
          Test = "Mann-Whitney",
          `Statistic type` = "W",
          Statistic = unname(test_result$statistic),
          df = NA_real_,
          `p value` = unname(test_result$p.value)
        )
      },
      error = function(e) empty_absolute_condition_test_stats("Mann-Whitney", "W")
    )
  }

  bind_cols(
    tibble(
      Treatment = as.character(treatment_value),
      `No info n` = length(no_info_values),
      `Part info n` = length(part_info_values),
      `No info mean` = mean(no_info_values, na.rm = TRUE),
      `Part info mean` = mean(part_info_values, na.rm = TRUE),
      `Mean difference` =
        mean(part_info_values, na.rm = TRUE) -
        mean(no_info_values, na.rm = TRUE),
      `Levene F` = levene_stats$Statistic[[1]],
      `Levene df` = fmt_halo_df(
        levene_stats$`Numerator df`[[1]],
        levene_stats$`Denominator df`[[1]]
      ),
      `Levene p value` = levene_p,
      `Selection rule` = if_else(use_welch, "Levene p >= 0.05", "Levene p < 0.05")
    ),
    selected_stats
  )
}

  halo_monotonicity ~ Treatment * Condition,
  data = individual_b2_nonboundary_halo_test_data
)

format_halo_tau_regression_term <- function(term) {
  case_when(
    term == "(Intercept)" ~ "Intercept: Env., Silent",
    term == "TreatmentSocial" ~ "Social information gap",
    term == "ConditionPartInfo" ~ "Interval",
    term %in% c(
      "TreatmentSocial:ConditionPartInfo",
      "ConditionPartInfo:TreatmentSocial"
    ) ~ "Social x Interval",
    TRUE ~ term
  )
}

halo_tau_regression_table <- {
  model_beta <- coef(individual_b2_halo_tau_model)
  estimable <- !is.na(model_beta)
  model_beta <- model_beta[estimable]
  robust_vcov <- hc3_vcov(individual_b2_halo_tau_model)[
    names(model_beta),
    names(model_beta),
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  robust_se <- sqrt(diag(robust_vcov))
  residual_df <- df.residual(individual_b2_halo_tau_model)
  robust_t <- model_beta / robust_se
  robust_p <- 2 * pt(abs(robust_t), df = residual_df, lower.tail = FALSE)
  model_summary <- summary(individual_b2_halo_tau_model)

  tibble(
    Term = format_halo_tau_regression_term(names(model_beta)),
    `Estimate [SE]` = estimate_se_bracket(
      unname(model_beta),
      unname(robust_se),
      digits = 4
    ),
    `HC3 t` = fmt_num(unname(robust_t), 3),
    df = fmt_num(residual_df, 0),
    `p-value` = fmt_p(unname(robust_p)),
    n = nobs(individual_b2_halo_tau_model),
    `R-squared` = fmt_num(model_summary$r.squared, 3),
    `Adj. R-squared` = fmt_num(model_summary$adj.r.squared, 3)
  )
}

estimate_halo_tau_information_effect <- function(treatment_value) {
  model_data <- individual_b2_nonboundary_halo_test_data %>%
    filter(Treatment == treatment_value)

  no_info_mean <- model_data %>%
    filter(Condition == "NoInfo") %>%
    summarise(value = mean(halo_monotonicity, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    pull(value)
  part_info_mean <- model_data %>%
    filter(Condition == "PartInfo") %>%
    summarise(value = mean(halo_monotonicity, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    pull(value)

  contrast_summary <- linear_contrast_summary(
    individual_b2_halo_tau_model,
    model_contrast(
      individual_b2_halo_tau_model,
      halo_tau_information_effect_terms[[treatment_value]]
    )
  )

  tibble(
    Treatment = treatment_value,
    `No info n` = n_distinct(model_data$id[model_data$Condition == "NoInfo"]),
    `Part info n` = n_distinct(model_data$id[model_data$Condition == "PartInfo"]),
    `No info mean tau-b` = no_info_mean,
    `Part info mean tau-b` = part_info_mean,
    Estimate = contrast_summary$Estimate[[1]],
    `HC3 SE` = contrast_summary$`HC3 SE`[[1]],
    `HC3 t` = contrast_summary$`HC3 t statistic`[[1]],
    df = contrast_summary$`Denominator df`[[1]],
    `p value` = contrast_summary$`HC3 p value, two-sided`[[1]]
  )
}

  )

halo_tau_pim_logit_pairs <- build_halo_tau_pim_pairs(halo_tau_pim_logit_data)

halo_tau_pim_logit_counts <- halo_tau_pim_logit_data %>%
  count(Treatment, Condition, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(
    Treatment = as.character(Treatment),
    Condition = as.character(Condition)
  )

halo_tau_pim_n_label <- function(treatment_value) {
  treatment_counts <- halo_tau_pim_logit_counts %>%
    filter(Treatment == treatment_value)

  paste(
    treatment_counts$n[
      match("NoInfo", treatment_counts$Condition)
    ],
    treatment_counts$n[
      match("PartInfo", treatment_counts$Condition)
    ],
    sep = " / "
  )
}

halo_tau_pim_logit_model <- pim(
  halo_monotonicity ~ R(Treatment) - 1,
  data = halo_tau_pim_logit_data,
  compare = halo_tau_pim_logit_pairs,
  link = "logit"
)

halo_tau_pim_logit_coef <- coef(halo_tau_pim_logit_model)
halo_tau_pim_logit_vcov <- vcov(halo_tau_pim_logit_model)
halo_tau_pim_logit_se <- sqrt(diag(halo_tau_pim_logit_vcov))

halo_tau_pim_environmental_term <- names(halo_tau_pim_logit_coef)[
  str_detect(names(halo_tau_pim_logit_coef), fixed("Environmental"))
]
halo_tau_pim_social_term <- names(halo_tau_pim_logit_coef)[
  str_detect(names(halo_tau_pim_logit_coef), fixed("Social"))
]

if (
  length(halo_tau_pim_environmental_term) != 1 ||
    length(halo_tau_pim_social_term) != 1
) {
  stop(
    "Could not identify Environmental and Social Kendall-tau PIM coefficients.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

format_halo_tau_pim_logit_row <- function(effect_label,
                                          n_label,
                                          pi_estimate,
                                          logit_estimate,
                                          logit_se) {
  wald_z <- if_else(
    is.na(logit_se) || logit_se <= 0,
    NA_real_,
    logit_estimate / logit_se
  )
  p_two_sided <- 2 * pnorm(abs(wald_z), lower.tail = FALSE)

  tibble(
    Effect = effect_label,
    `N Sil./Int.` = n_label,
    `PI estimate` = pi_estimate,
    `Logit estimate` = logit_estimate,
    `Logit SE` = logit_se,
    `Wald z` = wald_z,
    `p value` = p_two_sided
  )
}

halo_tau_pim_logit_information_effect_tests <- bind_rows(
  format_halo_tau_pim_logit_row(
    "theta_E != 0.5",
    halo_tau_pim_n_label("Environmental"),
    plogis(halo_tau_pim_logit_coef[[halo_tau_pim_environmental_term]]),
    halo_tau_pim_logit_coef[[halo_tau_pim_environmental_term]],
    halo_tau_pim_logit_se[[halo_tau_pim_environmental_term]]
  ),
  format_halo_tau_pim_logit_row(
    "theta_S != 0.5",
    halo_tau_pim_n_label("Social"),
    plogis(halo_tau_pim_logit_coef[[halo_tau_pim_social_term]]),
    halo_tau_pim_logit_coef[[halo_tau_pim_social_term]],
    halo_tau_pim_logit_se[[halo_tau_pim_social_term]]
  )
)

format_halo_tau_pim_logit_information_effects_for_export <- function(table_data) {
  table_data %>%
    transmute(
      Effect,
      `N Sil./Int.`,
      `PI estimate` = fmt_num(`PI estimate`, 4),
      `Logit [SE]` = estimate_se_bracket(
        `Logit estimate`,
        `Logit SE`,
        digits = 4
      ),
      `Wald z` = fmt_num(`Wald z`, 4),
      `p-value` = fmt_p(`p value`)
    )
}
```

The ordinal table below tests the same information-condition hypothesis
without treating Kendall tau-b as a cardinal outcome. For each
information gap $T \in \{E,S\}$, every Silent subject is paired with
every Interval subject within the same information gap. With Silent on
the left of the comparison and Interval on the right, the PIM
pseudo-response is

$$P_{ijT} =
\begin{cases}
1, & \tau_{jT}^{I} > \tau_{iT}^{S},\\
0.5, & \tau_{jT}^{I} = \tau_{iT}^{S},\\
0, & \tau_{jT}^{I} < \tau_{iT}^{S}.
\end{cases}$$

Thus the conditional probabilistic index is

$$\theta_T =
\Pr(\tau_T^{I} > \tau_T^{S})
+ \frac{1}{2}\Pr(\tau_T^{I} = \tau_T^{S}),$$

where values above 0.5 mean that Interval observations tend to have
higher directionality Kendall tau-b than Silent observations in the same
information gap. The fitted logit-link PIM is

$$\operatorname{logit}(\theta_T)=\lambda_T,\quad T \in \{E,S\}.$$

The two rows test $H_0:\theta_T=0.5$ against $H_1:\theta_T \neq 0.5$,
equivalently $H_0:\lambda_T=0$. Reported p-values are two-sided Wald $z$
tests on the logit scale, using the asymptotic sandwich
variance-covariance matrix returned by `pim::pim`. These are ordinal
tests: they use only pairwise ordering of tau-b and ties, not normality
of tau-b itself. The inference assumes independent subject-level
observations and the large-sample normal approximation for the PIM logit
estimates.

```{r halo-kendall-tau-pim-logit-information-effects}
export_table(
  format_halo_tau_pim_logit_information_effects_for_export(
    halo_tau_pim_logit_information_effect_tests
  ),
  table_id = "individual_b2_nonboundary_halo_tau_pim_logit_information_effects",
  caption = paste(
    "Non-boundary subjects: PIM-logit tests for the",
    "effect of information-gap format on halo directionality, conditional on information gap dimension.",
    "Silent observations are paired on the left with Interval observations on the right",
    "within each information gap. The rows test $\\theta_T = 0.5$.",
    "Logit estimates and sandwich standard errors are in the remaining columns.",
    "The tests are two-sided Wald tests of the null effects."
  ),
  digits = 4,
  column_widths = c(
    "0.16\\textwidth",
    "0.10\\textwidth",
    "0.10\\textwidth",
    "0.16\\textwidth",
    "0.08\\textwidth",
    "0.08\\textwidth"
  ),
  latex_float_environment = "subtable",
  latex_font_size = "\\scriptsize",
  latex_tabcolsep = "2pt"
)
```

## WTP

This section reproduces the overall WTP figures from the
independence-attitudes analysis. The plotted WTP values are the
information-gap task, B1, and the three B3 tasks corresponding to low,
medium, and high levels of the other characteristic. Both information
conditions are shown within each WTP treatment.

```{r wtp-section-support, include=FALSE}
wtp_task_levels <- c("Environmental", "Social")
wtp_level_levels <- c("B1", "L", "M", "H")
wtp_level_labels <- c(
  B1 = "Info gap",
  L = "Low",
  M = "Medium",
  H = "High"
)
wtp_condition_labels <- c(
  NoInfo = "Silent",
  PartInfo = "Interval"
)

derive_wtp_task <- function(treatment) {
  case_when(
    treatment == "Social" ~ "Environmental",
    treatment == "Environmental" ~ "Social",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

wtp_plot_data <- dataset %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(wtp_B1, wtp_B3_L, wtp_B3_M, wtp_B3_H),
    names_to = "wtp_var",
    values_to = "wtp_value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    wtp_value = as.numeric(wtp_value),
    wtp_level = case_when(
      wtp_var == "wtp_B1" ~ "B1",
      TRUE ~ str_extract(wtp_var, "H|M|L")
    ),
    wtp_level = factor(wtp_level, levels = wtp_level_levels),
    wtp_task = derive_wtp_task(Treatment),
    wtp_task = factor(wtp_task, levels = wtp_task_levels),
    Condition = factor(Condition, levels = condition_levels)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(id), !is.na(wtp_task), !is.na(wtp_level), !is.na(Condition))

summary_wtp_se <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    group_by(wtp_task, wtp_level, Condition) %>%
    summarise(
      n = sum(!is.na(wtp_value)),
      Mean = mean(wtp_value, na.rm = TRUE),
      SD = sd(wtp_value, na.rm = TRUE),
      SE = if_else(n > 1, SD / sqrt(n), NA_real_),
      ymin = Mean - SE,
      ymax = Mean + SE,
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

wtp_overall_desc <- summary_wtp_se(wtp_plot_data)

make_wtp_mean_se_plot <- function(desc_data, task_value) {
  desc_data %>%
    filter(wtp_task == task_value) %>%
    ggplot(
      aes(
        x = wtp_level,
        y = Mean,
        color = Condition,
        group = Condition
      )
    ) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_point(size = 2.4) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax), width = 0.1, linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 0,
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.35,
      color = "grey50"
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = condition_palettes[[task_value]],
      breaks = condition_levels,
      labels = wtp_condition_labels,
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = wtp_level_labels) +
    labs(
      title = paste(task_value, "WTP"),
      x = "Other dimension",
      y = "Mean WTP",
      color = "Information-gap format"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
}

wtp_violin_iqr <- function(x) {
  tibble(
    y = median(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    ymin = quantile(x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    ymax = quantile(x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

make_wtp_violin_plot <- function(plot_data, task_value) {
  plot_subset <- plot_data %>%
    filter(wtp_task == task_value, !is.na(wtp_value))

  dodge_width <- 0.72

  ggplot(
    plot_subset,
    aes(
      x = wtp_level,
      y = wtp_value,
      fill = Condition,
      color = Condition,
      group = interaction(wtp_level, Condition)
    )
  ) +
    geom_violin(
      position = position_dodge(width = dodge_width),
      width = 0.68,
      alpha = 0.45,
      trim = FALSE,
      linewidth = 0.25
    ) +
    geom_point(
      position = position_jitterdodge(
        jitter.width = 0.08,
        jitter.height = 0,
        dodge.width = dodge_width,
        seed = 90213
      ),
      size = 0.7,
      alpha = 0.24,
      stroke = 0
    ) +
    stat_summary(
      fun.data = wtp_violin_iqr,
      geom = "pointrange",
      position = position_dodge(width = dodge_width),
      linewidth = 0.55,
      fatten = 2.2,
      color = "grey15"
    ) +
    stat_summary(
      fun = mean,
      geom = "point",
      position = position_dodge(width = dodge_width),
      shape = 21,
      size = 2.2,
      fill = "white",
      color = "grey15",
      stroke = 0.55
    ) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 0,
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.35,
      color = "grey50"
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = condition_palettes[[task_value]],
      breaks = condition_levels,
      labels = wtp_condition_labels,
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = condition_palettes[[task_value]],
      breaks = condition_levels,
      labels = wtp_condition_labels,
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = wtp_level_labels) +
    labs(
      title = paste(task_value, "WTP distribution"),
      x = "Other dimension",
      y = "WTP",
      fill = "Information-gap format",
      color = "Information-gap format"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    ) +
    guides(color = "none")
}

run_wtp_positive_binomial_test <- function(positive_n, total_n) {
  test_result <- tryCatch(
    {
      if (total_n == 0) {
        NULL
      } else {
        binom.test(
          positive_n,
          total_n,
          p = 0.5,
          alternative = "greater"
        )
      }
    },
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(test_result)) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  unname(test_result$p.value)
}

wtp_min_count_data <- dataset %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(wtp_min_B1, wtp_min_B3_L, wtp_min_B3_M, wtp_min_B3_H),
    names_to = "wtp_min_var",
    values_to = "wtp_min_value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    wtp_min_value = as.numeric(wtp_min_value),
    wtp_level = case_when(
      wtp_min_var == "wtp_min_B1" ~ "B1",
      TRUE ~ str_extract(wtp_min_var, "H|M|L")
    ),
    wtp_level = factor(wtp_level, levels = wtp_level_levels),
    wtp_task = derive_wtp_task(Treatment),
    wtp_task = factor(wtp_task, levels = wtp_task_levels),
    Condition = factor(Condition, levels = condition_levels)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(id), !is.na(wtp_task), !is.na(wtp_level), !is.na(Condition))

wtp_sign_count_tests <- wtp_min_count_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(wtp_min_value)) %>%
  group_by(wtp_task, Condition, wtp_level) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    `WTP min < 0` = sum(wtp_min_value < 0),
    `WTP min = 0` = sum(near(wtp_min_value, 0)),
    `WTP min > 0` = sum(wtp_min_value > 0),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    `Binomial p value` = map2_dbl(
      `WTP min > 0`,
      n,
      run_wtp_positive_binomial_test
    ),
    `Proportion WTP min > 0` = `WTP min > 0` / n
  )

wtp_min_subject_positive_summary <- wtp_min_count_data %>%
  filter(wtp_level %in% c("B1", "L", "M", "H")) %>%
  mutate(
    wtp_level_chr = as.character(wtp_level),
    wtp_min_positive = wtp_min_value > 0
  ) %>%
  select(id, wtp_task, Condition, wtp_level_chr, wtp_min_positive) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = wtp_level_chr,
    values_from = wtp_min_positive,
    values_fn = ~ any(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
    values_fill = FALSE
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    any_b3_positive = L | M | H,
    any_info_gap_or_b3_positive = B1 | any_b3_positive
  ) %>%
  group_by(wtp_task, Condition) %>%
  summarise(
    Subjects = n_distinct(id),
    `Any L/M/H positive n` = sum(any_b3_positive),
    `Any info gap/L/M/H positive n` = sum(any_info_gap_or_b3_positive),
    `Any L/M/H positive proportion` =
      `Any L/M/H positive n` / Subjects,
    `Any info gap/L/M/H positive proportion` =
      `Any info gap/L/M/H positive n` / Subjects,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

run_wtp_min_b1_info_condition_test <- function(data, task_value) {
  count_data <- data %>%
    filter(wtp_task == task_value, wtp_level == "B1") %>%
    mutate(wtp_min_positive = wtp_min_value > 0) %>%
    group_by(Condition) %>%
    summarise(
      Subjects = n_distinct(id),
      Positive = sum(wtp_min_positive, na.rm = TRUE),
      `Non-positive` = sum(!wtp_min_positive, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    complete(
      Condition = factor(condition_levels, levels = condition_levels),
      fill = list(Subjects = 0, Positive = 0, `Non-positive` = 0)
    ) %>%
    arrange(Condition)

  no_info <- count_data %>% filter(Condition == "NoInfo")
  part_info <- count_data %>% filter(Condition == "PartInfo")

  contingency_table <- matrix(
    c(
      no_info$Positive,
      no_info$`Non-positive`,
      part_info$Positive,
      part_info$`Non-positive`
    ),
    nrow = 2,
    byrow = TRUE,
    dimnames = list(
      Info = c("Info gap", "Interval"),
      Outcome = c("WTP-min > 0", "WTP-min <= 0")
    )
  )

  chi_square_test <- tryCatch(
    chisq.test(contingency_table, correct = FALSE),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  tibble(
    Treatment = as.character(task_value),
    `No info n` = no_info$Subjects,
    `No info positive` = no_info$Positive,
    `No info non-positive` = no_info$`Non-positive`,
    `No info positive proportion` = no_info$Positive / no_info$Subjects,
    `Part info n` = part_info$Subjects,
    `Part info positive` = part_info$Positive,
    `Part info non-positive` = part_info$`Non-positive`,
    `Part info positive proportion` = part_info$Positive / part_info$Subjects,
    `Chi-square` = if (!is.null(chi_square_test)) {
      unname(chi_square_test$statistic)
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },
    df = if (!is.null(chi_square_test)) {
      unname(chi_square_test$parameter)
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },
    `Chi-square p value` = if (!is.null(chi_square_test)) {
      unname(chi_square_test$p.value)
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }
  )
}

wtp_min_b1_info_condition_tests <- map_dfr(
  wtp_task_levels,
  ~ run_wtp_min_b1_info_condition_test(wtp_min_count_data, .x)
)

run_wtp_min_b1_wtp_task_test <- function(data) {
  count_data <- data %>%
    filter(wtp_level == "B1") %>%
    mutate(wtp_min_positive = wtp_min_value > 0) %>%
    distinct(id, wtp_task, wtp_min_positive) %>%
    group_by(wtp_task) %>%
    summarise(
      Subjects = n_distinct(id),
      Positive = sum(wtp_min_positive, na.rm = TRUE),
      `Non-positive` = sum(!wtp_min_positive, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    complete(
      wtp_task = factor(wtp_task_levels, levels = wtp_task_levels),
      fill = list(Subjects = 0, Positive = 0, `Non-positive` = 0)
    ) %>%
    arrange(wtp_task)

  environmental <- count_data %>% filter(wtp_task == "Environmental")
  social <- count_data %>% filter(wtp_task == "Social")

  contingency_table <- matrix(
    c(
      environmental$Positive,
      environmental$`Non-positive`,
      social$Positive,
      social$`Non-positive`
    ),
    nrow = 2,
    byrow = TRUE,
    dimnames = list(
      `WTP task` = c("Environmental", "Social"),
      Outcome = c("WTP-min > 0", "WTP-min <= 0")
    )
  )

  chi_square_test <- tryCatch(
    chisq.test(contingency_table, correct = FALSE),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  tibble(
    Test = "Environmental vs Social",
    `Environmental n` = environmental$Subjects,
    `Environmental positive` = environmental$Positive,
    `Environmental non-positive` = environmental$`Non-positive`,
    `Environmental positive proportion` =
      environmental$Positive / environmental$Subjects,
    `Social n` = social$Subjects,
    `Social positive` = social$Positive,
    `Social non-positive` = social$`Non-positive`,
    `Social positive proportion` = social$Positive / social$Subjects,
    `Chi-square` = if (!is.null(chi_square_test)) {
      unname(chi_square_test$statistic)
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },
    df = if (!is.null(chi_square_test)) {
      unname(chi_square_test$parameter)
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },
    `Chi-square p value` = if (!is.null(chi_square_test)) {
      unname(chi_square_test$p.value)
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }
  )
}

wtp_min_b1_wtp_task_test <- run_wtp_min_b1_wtp_task_test(wtp_min_count_data)

empty_wtp_condition_test_stats <- function(test_label, statistic_type) {
  tibble(
    Test = test_label,
    `Statistic type` = statistic_type,
    Statistic = NA_real_,
    df = NA_real_,
    `p value` = NA_real_
  )
}

run_wtp_info_condition_mean_tests <- function(data, task_value, level_value) {
  test_data <- data %>%
    filter(wtp_task == task_value, wtp_level == level_value, !is.na(wtp_value))

  no_info_values <- test_data %>%
    filter(Condition == "NoInfo") %>%
    pull(wtp_value)
  part_info_values <- test_data %>%
    filter(Condition == "PartInfo") %>%
    pull(wtp_value)

  no_info_mean <- mean(no_info_values, na.rm = TRUE)
  part_info_mean <- mean(part_info_values, na.rm = TRUE)

  common_info <- tibble(
    Treatment = as.character(task_value),
    Task = as.character(level_value),
    `No info n` = length(no_info_values),
    `Part info n` = length(part_info_values),
    `No info mean` = no_info_mean,
    `Part info mean` = part_info_mean,
    `Difference` = part_info_mean - no_info_mean
  )

  welch_stats <- tryCatch(
    {
      test_result <- t.test(
        part_info_values,
        no_info_values,
        var.equal = FALSE
      )

      tibble(
        Test = "Welch",
        `Statistic type` = "t",
        Statistic = unname(test_result$statistic),
        df = unname(test_result$parameter),
        `p value` = unname(test_result$p.value)
      )
    },
    error = function(e) empty_wtp_condition_test_stats("Welch", "t")
  )

  mann_whitney_stats <- tryCatch(
    {
      test_result <- wilcox.test(
        part_info_values,
        no_info_values,
        alternative = "two.sided",
        exact = FALSE,
        correct = TRUE
      )

      tibble(
        Test = "Mann-Whitney",
        `Statistic type` = "W",
        Statistic = unname(test_result$statistic),
        df = NA_real_,
        `p value` = unname(test_result$p.value)
      )
    },
    error = function(e) empty_wtp_condition_test_stats("Mann-Whitney", "W")
  )

  bind_rows(
    bind_cols(common_info, welch_stats),
    bind_cols(common_info, mann_whitney_stats)
  )
}

wtp_info_condition_mean_tests <- expand_grid(

  wtp_level = factor("B1", levels = wtp_level_levels)
) %>%
  pmap_dfr(
    ~ run_wtp_info_condition_mean_tests(wtp_plot_data, ..1, ..2)
  )

extract_wtp_repeated_anova_effects <- function(summary_list) {
  effect_labels <- c(
    Condition = "Info-gap format",
    Task = "Other dimension",
    `Condition:Task` = "Info-gap format x Other dimension"
  )

  imap_dfr(
    summary_list,
    function(stratum_summary, stratum_name) {
      anova_tbl <- stratum_summary[[1]] %>%
        as.data.frame() %>%
        rownames_to_column("Term") %>%
        mutate(Term = str_trim(Term))

      residual_df <- anova_tbl %>%
        filter(Term == "Residuals") %>%
        pull(Df) %>%
        first(default = NA_real_)

      anova_tbl %>%
        filter(Term %in% names(effect_labels)) %>%
        transmute(
          Effect = unname(effect_labels[Term]),
          `Numerator df` = Df,
          `Denominator df` = residual_df,
          `Statistic type` = "F",
          Statistic = .data[["F value"]],
          `p value` = .data[["Pr(>F)"]]
        )
    }
  )
}

empty_wtp_repeated_anova_effects <- function() {
  tibble(
    Effect = c("Info-gap format", "Other dimension", "Info-gap format x Other dimension"),
    `Numerator df` = NA_real_,
    `Denominator df` = NA_real_,
    `Statistic type` = "F",
    Statistic = NA_real_,
    `p value` = NA_real_
  )
}

run_wtp_repeated_anova <- function(data, task_value) {
  model_data <- data %>%
    filter(wtp_task == task_value, !is.na(wtp_value)) %>%
    mutate(
      Condition = fct_drop(Condition),
      Task = factor(
        as.character(wtp_level),
        levels = wtp_level_levels,
        labels = unname(wtp_level_labels[wtp_level_levels])
      ),
      id = factor(id)
    ) %>%
    distinct(id, Condition, Task, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    group_by(id) %>%
    filter(n_distinct(Task) == length(wtp_level_levels)) %>%
    ungroup()

  effects <- tryCatch(
    {
      model <- aov(
        wtp_value ~ Condition * Task + Error(id / Task),
        data = model_data
      )

      extract_wtp_repeated_anova_effects(summary(model))
    },
    error = function(e) empty_wtp_repeated_anova_effects()
  )

  effects %>%
    mutate(
      Treatment = as.character(task_value),
      Participants = n_distinct(model_data$id),
      Observations = nrow(model_data),
      .before = 1
    )
}

wtp_repeated_anova_tests <- map_dfr(
  wtp_task_levels,
  ~ run_wtp_repeated_anova(wtp_plot_data, .x)
)

format_wtp_social_task_regression_term <- function(term) {
  case_when(
    term == "(Intercept)" ~ "Intercept: Info gap",
    term == "TaskLow" ~ "Low vs Info gap",
    term == "TaskMedium" ~ "Medium vs Info gap",
    term == "TaskHigh" ~ "High vs Info gap",
    TRUE ~ term
  )
}

build_wtp_social_task_comparison_matrix <- function(model) {
  coefficient_names <- names(coef(model))
  comparison_matrix <- matrix(
    0,
    nrow = 6,
    ncol = length(coefficient_names),
    dimnames = list(
      c(
        "Low - Info gap",
        "Medium - Info gap",
        "High - Info gap",
        "Low - Medium",
        "Low - High",
        "Medium - High"
      ),
      coefficient_names
    )
  )

  comparison_matrix["Low - Info gap", "TaskLow"] <- 1
  comparison_matrix["Medium - Info gap", "TaskMedium"] <- 1
  comparison_matrix["High - Info gap", "TaskHigh"] <- 1
  comparison_matrix["Low - Medium", "TaskLow"] <- 1
  comparison_matrix["Low - Medium", "TaskMedium"] <- -1
  comparison_matrix["Low - High", "TaskLow"] <- 1
  comparison_matrix["Low - High", "TaskHigh"] <- -1
  comparison_matrix["Medium - High", "TaskMedium"] <- 1
  comparison_matrix["Medium - High", "TaskHigh"] <- -1

  comparison_matrix
}

fit_wtp_social_task_regression <- function(data) {
  model_data <- data %>%
    filter(wtp_task == "Social", !is.na(wtp_value)) %>%
    mutate(
      Task = factor(
        as.character(wtp_level),
        levels = wtp_level_levels,
        labels = unname(wtp_level_labels[wtp_level_levels])
      ),
      id = factor(id)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Task), !is.na(id)) %>%
    distinct(id, Task, .keep_all = TRUE)

  model <- lm(wtp_value ~ Task, data = model_data)
  clustered_vcov <- clubSandwich::vcovCR(
    model,
    cluster = model_data$id,
    type = "CR1"
  )

  coefficient_table <- clubSandwich::coef_test(
    model,
    vcov = clustered_vcov,
    test = "Satterthwaite"
  ) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("term") %>%
    transmute(
      Term = format_wtp_social_task_regression_term(term),
      `Estimate [SE]` = estimate_se_bracket(beta, SE, digits = 3),
      `Cluster t` = fmt_num(tstat, 3),
      df = fmt_num(df_Satt, 1),
      `p-value` = fmt_p(p_Satt)
    )

  comparison_table <- tryCatch(
    {
      clubSandwich::linear_contrast(
        model,
        vcov = clustered_vcov,
        contrasts = build_wtp_social_task_comparison_matrix(model),
        test = "Satterthwaite",
        p_values = TRUE
      ) %>%
        as.data.frame() %>%
        as_tibble() %>%
        transmute(
          Comparison = Coef,
          `ME diff [SE]` = estimate_se_bracket(Est, SE, digits = 3),
          `Cluster t` = fmt_num(Est / SE, 3),
          df = fmt_num(df, 1),
          `p-value` = fmt_p(p_val)
        )
    },
    error = function(e) {
      tibble(
        Comparison = c(
          "Low - Info gap",
          "Medium - Info gap",
          "High - Info gap",
          "Low - Medium",
          "Low - High",
          "Medium - High"
        ),
        `ME diff [SE]` = "",
        `Cluster t` = "",
        df = "",
        `p-value` = ""
      )
    }
  )

  task_terms <- names(coef(model))[names(coef(model)) != "(Intercept)"]
  f_test <- tryCatch(
    {
      clubSandwich::Wald_test(
        model,
        constraints = clubSandwich::constrain_zero(
          task_terms,
          coefs = coef(model)
        ),
        vcov = clustered_vcov,
        test = "HTZ"
      ) %>%
        as.data.frame() %>%
        transmute(
          Test = "Other dimension",
          `Statistic type` = "F",
          Statistic = Fstat,
          `Numerator df` = df_num,
          `Denominator df` = df_denom,
          `p value` = p_val
        )
    },
    error = function(e) {
      tibble(
        Test = "Other dimension",
        `Statistic type` = "F",
        Statistic = NA_real_,
        `Numerator df` = NA_real_,
        `Denominator df` = NA_real_,
        `p value` = NA_real_
      )
    }
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      Observations = nobs(model),
      Subjects = n_distinct(model_data$id),
      .before = 1
    )

  list(
    model = model,
    model_data = model_data,
    clustered_vcov = clustered_vcov,
    coefficients = coefficient_table,
    comparisons = comparison_table,
    f_test = f_test
  )
}

wtp_social_task_regression <- fit_wtp_social_task_regression(wtp_plot_data)

format_wtp_social_task_coarse_term <- function(term) {
  case_when(
    term == "(Intercept)" ~ "Intercept: Info-gap task, Info-gap condition",
    term == "TaskCoarseSpecified level" ~
      "Specified level vs Info-gap task",
    term == "ConditionPartInfo" ~ "Interval vs Info-gap condition",
    term == "TaskCoarseSpecified level:ConditionPartInfo" ~
      "Specified level x Interval",
    TRUE ~ term
  )
}

run_single_coefficient_wald_test <- function(model,
                                             vcov_matrix,
                                             coefficient_name,
                                             test_label) {
  if (!coefficient_name %in% names(coef(model))) {
    return(
      tibble(
        Test = test_label,
        Statistic = NA_real_,
        `Numerator df` = NA_real_,
        `Denominator df` = NA_real_,
        `p value` = NA_real_
      )
    )
  }

  tryCatch(
    {
      clubSandwich::Wald_test(
        model,
        constraints = clubSandwich::constrain_zero(
          coefficient_name,
          coefs = coef(model)
        ),
        vcov = vcov_matrix,
        test = "HTZ"
      ) %>%
        as.data.frame() %>%
        as_tibble() %>%
        transmute(
          Test = test_label,
          Statistic = Fstat,
          `Numerator df` = df_num,
          `Denominator df` = df_denom,
          `p value` = p_val
        )
    },
    error = function(e) {
      tibble(
        Test = test_label,
        Statistic = NA_real_,
        `Numerator df` = NA_real_,
        `Denominator df` = NA_real_,
        `p value` = NA_real_
      )
    }
  )
}

build_wtp_social_task_coarse_comparison_matrix <- function(model) {
  coefficient_names <- names(coef(model))
  cell_matrix <- matrix(
    0,
    nrow = 4,
    ncol = length(coefficient_names),
    dimnames = list(
      c(
        "Info-gap task, Silence",
        "Specified-level task, Silence",
        "Info-gap task, Interval",
        "Specified-level task, Interval"
      ),
      coefficient_names
    )
  )

  cell_matrix["Info-gap task, Silence", "(Intercept)"] <- 1
  cell_matrix[
    "Specified-level task, Silence",
    c("(Intercept)", "TaskCoarseSpecified level")
  ] <-
    1
  cell_matrix[
    "Info-gap task, Interval",
    c("(Intercept)", "ConditionPartInfo")
  ] <- 1
  cell_matrix[
    "Specified-level task, Interval",
    c(
      "(Intercept)",
      "TaskCoarseSpecified level",
      "ConditionPartInfo",
      "TaskCoarseSpecified level:ConditionPartInfo"
    )
  ] <- 1

  comparison_pairs <- tribble(
    ~Comparison, ~left, ~right,
    "Specified-level task, Silence - Info-gap task, Silence",
    "Specified-level task, Silence",
    "Info-gap task, Silence",
    "Info-gap task, Interval - Info-gap task, Silence",
    "Info-gap task, Interval",
    "Info-gap task, Silence",
    "Specified-level task, Interval - Info-gap task, Silence",
    "Specified-level task, Interval",
    "Info-gap task, Silence",
    "Info-gap task, Interval - Specified-level task, Silence",
    "Info-gap task, Interval",
    "Specified-level task, Silence",
    "Specified-level task, Interval - Specified-level task, Silence",
    "Specified-level task, Interval",
    "Specified-level task, Silence",
    "Specified-level task, Interval - Info-gap task, Interval",
    "Specified-level task, Interval",
    "Info-gap task, Interval"
  )

  comparison_matrix <- map2(
    comparison_pairs$left,
    comparison_pairs$right,
    ~ cell_matrix[.x, ] - cell_matrix[.y, ]
  ) %>%
    do.call(rbind, .)

  rownames(comparison_matrix) <- comparison_pairs$Comparison
  comparison_matrix
}

fit_wtp_social_task_coarse_regression <- function(data) {
  model_data <- data %>%
    filter(wtp_task == "Social", !is.na(wtp_value)) %>%
    mutate(
      TaskCoarse = case_when(
        wtp_level == "B1" ~ "Silence",
        wtp_level %in% c("L", "M", "H") ~ "Specified level",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      TaskCoarse = factor(TaskCoarse, levels = c("Silence", "Specified level")),
      Condition = factor(Condition, levels = condition_levels),
      id = factor(id)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(TaskCoarse), !is.na(Condition), !is.na(id)) %>%
    distinct(id, Condition, wtp_level, .keep_all = TRUE)

  model <- lm(wtp_value ~ TaskCoarse * Condition, data = model_data)
  clustered_vcov <- clubSandwich::vcovCR(
    model,
    cluster = model_data$id,
    type = "CR1"
  )

  coefficient_table <- clubSandwich::coef_test(
    model,
    vcov = clustered_vcov,
    test = "Satterthwaite"
  ) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("term") %>%
    transmute(
      Term = format_wtp_social_task_coarse_term(term),
      `Estimate [SE]` = estimate_se_bracket(beta, SE, digits = 3),
      `Cluster t` = fmt_num(tstat, 3),
      df = fmt_num(df_Satt, 1),
      `p-value` = fmt_p(p_Satt)
    )

  comparison_table <- tryCatch(
    {
      clubSandwich::linear_contrast(
        model,
        vcov = clustered_vcov,
        contrasts = build_wtp_social_task_coarse_comparison_matrix(model),
        test = "Satterthwaite",
        p_values = TRUE
      ) %>%
        as.data.frame() %>%
        as_tibble() %>%
        transmute(
          Comparison = Coef,
          `ME diff [SE]` = estimate_se_bracket(Est, SE, digits = 3),
          `Cluster t` = fmt_num(Est / SE, 3),
          df = fmt_num(df, 1),
          `p-value` = fmt_p(p_val)
        )
    },
    error = function(e) {
      tibble(
        Comparison = c(
          "Specified-level task, Silence - Info-gap task, Silence",
          "Info-gap task, Interval - Info-gap task, Silence",
          "Specified-level task, Interval - Info-gap task, Silence",
          "Info-gap task, Interval - Specified-level task, Silence",
          "Specified-level task, Interval - Specified-level task, Silence",
          "Specified-level task, Interval - Info-gap task, Interval"
        ),
        `ME diff [SE]` = "",
        `Cluster t` = "",
        df = "",
        `p-value` = ""
      )
    }
  )

  f_tests <- tribble(
    ~Test, ~coefficient_name,
    "Task coarse", "TaskCoarseSpecified level",
    "Info-gap format", "ConditionPartInfo",
    "Task coarse x info", "TaskCoarseSpecified level:ConditionPartInfo"
  ) %>%
    pmap_dfr(
      ~ run_single_coefficient_wald_test(
        model,
        clustered_vcov,
        ..2,
        ..1
      )
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Observations = nobs(model),
      Subjects = n_distinct(model_data$id),
      .before = 1
    )

  list(
    model = model,
    model_data = model_data,
    clustered_vcov = clustered_vcov,
    coefficients = coefficient_table,
    comparisons = comparison_table,
    f_tests = f_tests
  )
}

wtp_social_task_coarse_regression <- fit_wtp_social_task_coarse_regression(
  wtp_plot_data
)

      Subjects,
      Obs. = Observations,
      df = fmt_halo_df(`Numerator df`, `Denominator df`),
      F = fmt_num(Statistic, 3),
      `p-value` = fmt_p(`p value`)
    )
}

format_wtp_social_task_coarse_f_tests_for_export <- function(table_data) {
  table_data %>%
    transmute(
      Test,
      Subjects,
      Obs. = Observations,
      df = fmt_halo_df(`Numerator df`, `Denominator df`),
      F = fmt_num(Statistic, 3),
      `p-value` = fmt_p(`p value`)
    )
}

format_wtp_info_condition_mean_tests_for_export <- function(table_data) {
  table_data %>%
    mutate(
      .task_order = match(Treatment, wtp_task_levels),
      .level_order = match(Task, wtp_level_levels),
      .test_order = match(Test, c("Welch", "Mann-Whitney"))
    ) %>%
    arrange(.task_order, .level_order, .test_order) %>%
    transmute(
      Treatment,
      Test,
      `N Gap/Int` = paste(`No info n`, `Part info n`, sep = " / "),
      `Mean Gap/Int` = paste(
        fmt_num(`No info mean`, 3),
        fmt_num(`Part info mean`, 3),
        sep = " / "
      ),
      Diff = fmt_num(Difference, 3),
      Statistic = case_when(
        `Statistic type` == "t" ~ paste0("t=", fmt_num(Statistic, 3)),
        `Statistic type` == "W" ~ paste0(
          "W=",
          formatC(Statistic, format = "f", digits = 0)
        ),
        TRUE ~ ""
      ),
      df = fmt_num(df, 1),
      `p-value` = fmt_p(`p value`)
    )
}
```

The repeated-measures ANOVAs below are fitted separately for
environmental WTP and social WTP. The dependent variable is WTP.
Information condition is the between-subject factor, task is the
within-subject factor with levels information gap, low, medium, and
high, and the table reports the corresponding F-tests including their
interaction.

```{r wtp-repeated-anova-tests}
export_table(
  format_wtp_repeated_anova_tests_for_export(wtp_repeated_anova_tests),
  table_id = "wtp_repeated_anova_tests",
  caption = paste(
    "Repeated-measures ANOVA F-tests for WTP, fitted separately by dimension on which there is a different between options.",
    "Information-gap format is the between-subject factor and the accompanying precise value or information gap for the other dimension is the",
    "within-subject factor with levels information gap, low, medium, and high."
  ),
  digits = 3,
  column_widths = c(
    "0.15\\textwidth",
    "0.16\\textwidth",
    "0.075\\textwidth",
    "0.07\\textwidth",
    "0.085\\textwidth",
    "0.075\\textwidth",
    "0.075\\textwidth"
  ),
  latex_font_size = "\\scriptsize",
  latex_tabcolsep = "2pt"
)
```

The social WTP follow-up regression ignores information condition and
regresses WTP on task alone, with information gap as the reference task. Standard
errors are clustered by subject. The first table gives all pairwise
marginal-effect comparisons among the task levels, including comparisons
with the information-gap task. The final table gives the omnibus
clustered Wald F-test for the task terms.

```{r wtp-social-task-regression-comparisons}
    "brackets are participant-clustered robust standard errors."
  ),
  digits = 3,
  column_widths = c(
    "0.16\\textwidth",
    "0.13\\textwidth",
    "0.08\\textwidth",
    "0.07\\textwidth",
    "0.08\\textwidth"
  ),
  latex_font_size = "\\scriptsize",
  latex_tabcolsep = "2pt"
)
```

```{r wtp-social-task-regression-f-test}
export_table(
```

The next social WTP regression collapses task to a coarse two-level
variable: information gap for B1, and specified level for low, medium,
or high. The model is WTP on task coarse, information condition, and
their interaction, with the information-gap task and information-gap
condition as the reference cell. Standard errors are clustered by
subject. The first table gives the clustered coefficient tests, and the
second gives the clustered Wald F-tests.

The table below counts negative, zero, and positive lower-bound WTP
values by treatment, information condition, and task. These lower-bound
values are the `wtp_min_*` variables derived from the elicited WTP
intervals in the data cleaning file. The binomial p-value is a one-sided
exact count test of the null boundary that the probability of a positive
lower-bound WTP is 0.5, against the alternative that a positive
lower-bound WTP is more likely.

```{r wtp-sign-count-tests}
export_table(
  format_wtp_sign_count_tests_for_export(wtp_sign_count_tests),
  table_id = "wtp_sign_count_tests",

    "The counts use the WTP-min variables derived from the elicited WTP",
    "intervals. The binomial p-value tests whether positive lower-bound",
    "WTP is more likely than non-positive lower-bound WTP, using the null",
    "boundary probability 0.5."
  ),
  digits = 3,
  column_widths = c(
    "0.11\\textwidth",
    "0.08\\textwidth",
    "0.08\\textwidth",
    "0.045\\textwidth",
    "0.065\\textwidth",
    "0.065\\textwidth",
    "0.065\\textwidth",
    "0.07\\textwidth",
    "0.08\\textwidth"
  ),
  latex_font_size = "\\scriptsize",
  latex_tabcolsep = "2pt"
)
```

The next WTP table aggregates the same WTP-min indicators at the subject
level. Within each treatment and information condition it reports the
proportion of subjects with a positive lower-bound WTP for at least one
of the L, M, or H tasks, and the proportion with a positive lower-bound
WTP for at least one of information-gap B1, L, M, or H.

For B1 alone, the next table tests whether the proportion of subjects
with positive lower-bound WTP differs between Info gap and Interval within
each WTP treatment. The chi-square test is the Pearson test of the 2 by
2 table of positive versus non-positive B1 WTP-min by information
condition. This is equivalent to the large-sample two-proportion score
test when no continuity correction is used, but it is not equivalent to
the one-sample binomial tests above.

```{r wtp-b1-info-condition-tests}
export_table(
  format_wtp_min_b1_info_condition_tests_for_export(
    wtp_min_b1_info_condition_tests
  ),

  caption = paste(
    "B1 lower-bound WTP information-condition tests by treatment.",
    "The chi-square test compares the proportion of subjects with WTP-min",
    "greater than zero under Info gap and Interval."
  ),
  digits = 3,
  column_widths = c(
    "0.12\\textwidth",
    "0.085\\textwidth",
    "0.095\\textwidth",
    "0.095\\textwidth",
    "0.11\\textwidth",
    "0.09\\textwidth",
    "0.045\\textwidth",
    "0.085\\textwidth"
  ),
  latex_font_size = "\\scriptsize",
  latex_tabcolsep = "1pt"
)
```

The final chi-square test pools across Info gap and Interval and asks
whether the proportion of subjects with positive B1 WTP-min is the same
for environmental and social WTP tasks. The test is again a Pearson
chi-square test of a 2 by 2 table, now WTP task by positive versus
non-positive B1 WTP-min.

```{r supplementary-ceo-pay-ratio-kernel-data}
supplementary_hpc_pay_path <- first_existing_file(

supplementary_hpc_pay <- readr::read_csv(
  supplementary_hpc_pay_path,
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

supplementary_uk_ftse_100 <- supplementary_hpc_pay %>%
  mutate(
    company_clean = stringr::str_squish(as.character(company)),
    company_key = case_when(
      company_clean == "Imperial Brand" ~ "Imperial Brands",
      company_clean == "Dechra Pharmaceutical" ~ "Dechra Pharmaceuticals",
      TRUE ~ company_clean
    ),
    ftse_index = readr::parse_number(as.character(index)),
    year_end_date = suppressWarnings(lubridate::dmy(as.character(year_end))),
    pay_ratio = readr::parse_number(as.character(ceo_median_employee_ratio))
  ) %>%
  filter(
    #ftse_index == 100,
    !is.na(company_key),
    company_key != "",
    !is.na(year_end_date),
    !is.na(pay_ratio),
    pay_ratio > 0
  ) %>%
  group_by(company_key) %>%
  slice_max(year_end_date, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(year_end_date > as.Date("2024-01-01")) %>%
  mutate(company = company_key) %>%
  select(-company_clean, -company_key)

make_supplementary_ceo_pay_density <- function(x,
                                               label,
                                               side,
                                               x_max,
                                               bw = 50,
                                               amplitude = 0.62) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x) & x > 0 & x <= x_max]

  if (length(x) < 2) {
    stop(
      "Not enough observations under the plotting cap for density estimation.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  dens <- density(
    x,
    kernel = "epanechnikov",
    bw = bw,
    from = 0,
    to = x_max,
    n = 512
  )

  tibble(
    sample = label,
    pay_ratio = dens$x,
    density = side * amplitude * dens$y / max(dens$y)
  )
}

make_supplementary_ceo_pay_box_stats <- function(x, label, y_pos) {
  qs <- quantile(x, c(0.05, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 0.95), na.rm = TRUE)

  tibble(
    sample = label,
    y = y_pos,
    q05 = unname(qs[[1]]),
    q25 = unname(qs[[2]]),
    q50 = unname(qs[[3]]),
    q75 = unname(qs[[4]]),
    q95 = unname(qs[[5]])
  )
}

supplementary_ceo_pay_x_max <- 1500
supplementary_ceo_pay_us_label <- "U.S. Russell 3000 Consumer Discretionary"
supplementary_ceo_pay_uk_label <- "U.K. FTSE 100, latest company observation"

supplementary_ceo_pay_density_data <- bind_rows(
  make_supplementary_ceo_pay_density(
    actual_ceo_median_ratios$ratio,
    supplementary_ceo_pay_us_label,
    side = 1,
    x_max = supplementary_ceo_pay_x_max
  ),
  make_supplementary_ceo_pay_density(
    supplementary_uk_ftse_100$pay_ratio,
    supplementary_ceo_pay_uk_label,
    side = -1,
    x_max = supplementary_ceo_pay_x_max
  )
)

supplementary_ceo_pay_box_data <- bind_rows(
  make_supplementary_ceo_pay_box_stats(
    actual_ceo_median_ratios$ratio,
    supplementary_ceo_pay_us_label,
    y_pos = 0.82
  ),
  make_supplementary_ceo_pay_box_stats(
    supplementary_uk_ftse_100$pay_ratio,
    supplementary_ceo_pay_uk_label,
    y_pos = -0.82
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    q05_plot = pmin(q05, supplementary_ceo_pay_x_max),
    q95_plot = pmin(q95, supplementary_ceo_pay_x_max)
  )

supplementary_ceo_pay_reference_levels <- tibble(

  line_type = if_else(
    label %in% c("Lower Bound", "Midpoint", "Upper Bound"),

  )
```
